text:
Mas'ala-e-Rajm: Is bayan se ke hum ne is surat ko nazil farmaya hai, is surat ki buzurgi aur zaroorat ko zahir karta hai, lekin is se yeh maqsood nahin ke aur suratein zaroori aur buzurgi wali nahin. Faraznaha ke ma'ani Mujahid aur Qatadah (R.H) ne yeh bayan kiye hain ke halal-o-haram, amr-o-nahi aur hudood waghera ka is mein bayan hai. Imam Bukhari (R.H) farmate hain ise hum ne tum par aur tumhare baad walon par muqarrar kar diya hai. Is mein saaf saaf, khule khule, roshan ahkaam bayan farmaye hain taake tum nasihat-o-ibrat hasil karo, ahkaam-e-Ilahi ko yaad rakho aur phir un par amal karo. Phir zina kari ki shar'i saza farmayi. Zina kaar ya toh kunwara hoga ya shadi shuda hoga, ya'ni woh jo hurriyat, bulughat aur aql ki halat mein nikah-e-shar'i ke sath kisi aurat se mila ho. Aur jumhoor ulama ke nazdeek use ek saal ki jalawatni bhi di jayegi. Haan Imam Abu Hanifa ka qaul hai ke yeh jalawatni Imam ki raye par hai, agar woh chahe de, chahe na de. Jumhoor ki daleel toh Bukhari-o-Muslim ki woh hadith hai jis mein hai ke do a'rabi Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aaye, ek ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mera beta is ke yahan mulazim tha, woh is ki biwi se zina kar baitha, main ne is ke fidiye mein ek sau bakriyan aur ek laundi di. Phir main ne ulama se daryaft kiya toh mujhe maloom hua ke mere bete par shar'i saza sau kordon ki hai aur ek saal ki jalawatni aur is ki biwi par rajm ya'ni sang-sari hai. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya suno! Main tum mein Allah ki kitab ka sahih faisla karta hoon. Loundi aur bakriyan toh tujhe wapas dilwa di jayengi aur tere bache par sau korde aur ek saal ki jalawatni hai aur ae Unais! Tu is ki biwi ka bayan le. Yeh Hazrat Unais (R.A) qabila Aslam ke ek shakhs thay. Agar woh apni siyah kari ka iqrar kare toh tu use sangsar kar dena. Chunancha is biwi sahiba (R.A) ne iqrar kiya aur unhein rajm kar diya gaya (R.A). Is hadith se sabit hota hai ke kunware par sau kordon ke sath hi saal bhar tak ki jalawatni bhi hai aur agar shadi shuda hai toh woh rajm kar diya jayega. Chunancha Muwatta Malik mein hai ke Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne apne ek khutba mein hamd-o-sana ke baad farmaya ke logo! Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko haq ke sath bheja aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par apni kitab nazil farmayi. Is Kitabullah mein rajm karne ke hukm ki aayat bhi thi jise hum ne tilawat ki, yaad kiya, is par amal bhi kiya, khud Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke zamane mein bhi rajm hua aur hum ne bhi Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke baad rajm kiya. Mujhe dar lagta hai ke kuch zamana guzarne ke baad koi yeh na kehne lage ke hum rajm ko Kitabullah mein nahin paate, aisa na ho ke woh Allah ke is fareeze ko jise Allah ne apni kitab mein utara, chhod kar gumrah ho jayen. Kitabullah mein rajm ka hukm mutlaq haq hai. Is par jo zina kare aur shadi shuda ho, khwah mard ho, khwah aurat ho. Jab ke is ke zina par shar'i daleel ho ya hamal ho ya iqrar ho. Yeh hadith Bukhari-o-Muslim mein is se bhi mutawwal hai.

Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke aap ne apne khutbay mein farmaya log kehte hain ke rajam yani sangsari ka masla hum Quran mein nahin paate, Quran mein sirf koray maarne ka hukum hai. Yaad rakho khud Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne rajam kiya aur hum ne bhi aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke baad rajam kiya agar mujhe yeh khauf na hota ke log kahenge, Quran mein jo na tha, Umar ne likh diya toh main aayat-e-rajam ko isi tarah likh deta, jis tarah nazil hui thi. Yeh hadith Nasai Sharif mein bhi hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke aap ne apne khutbay mein rajam ka zikr kiya aur farmaya rajam zaroori hai woh Allah Ta'ala ki haddon mein se ek had hai, khud Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne rajam kiya aur hum ne bhi aap ke baad rajam kiya. Agar logon ke is kehne ka khatka na hota ke Umar ne Kitabullah mein ziyadati ki jo is mein na thi toh main Kitabullah ke ek taraf aayat-e-rajam likh deta. Umar bin Khattab, Abdullah bin Auf aur falan aur falan ki shahadat hai ke Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne rajam kiya aur hum ne bhi rajam kiya. Yaad rakho tumhare baad aise log aane wale hain jo rajam ko aur shafa'at ko aur azaab-e-qabr ko jhutlayenge. Aur is baat ko bhi ke kuch log jahannam se us ke baad nikale jayenge ke woh koiley honge. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Ameer-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne farmaya, rajam ke hukum ke inkar karne ki halakat se bachna. Imam Tirmidhi (R.H) bhi ise laye hain aur ise sahih kaha hai. Abu Ya'la Mosuli mein hai ke log Marwan ke paas baithe hue thay. Hazrat Zaid bin Thabit (R.A) ne farmaya, main tumhari tashaffi kar deta hoon. Ek shakhs Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aaya, us ne aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se hi zikr kiya aur rajam ka bayan kiya. Kisi ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aap rajam ki aayat likh lijiye. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya, ab toh main ise likh nahin sakta. Ya isi ke misl. Yeh riwayat Nasai mein bhi hai, pas in sab ahadith se sabit hua ke rajam ki aayat pehle likhi hui thi phir tilawat mein mansookh ho gayi aur hukum baqi raha. Wallahu A'lam. Khud Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne us shakhs ki biwi ke rajam ka hukum diya, jis ne apne mulazim se badkari karayi thi. Isi tarah Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Ma'iz (R.A) ko aur ek Ghamidiyah aurat ko rajam karaya. In sab waqiyat mein yeh mazkoor nahin ke rajam se pehle aap ne unhein koray bhi lagwaye hon. Balkeh in sab sahih aur saaf ahadith mein sirf rajam ka zikr hai kisi mein bhi korron ka bayan nahin. Isi liye jamhoor ulama-e-Islam ka yahi mazhab hai. Abu Hanifa (R.H), Malik (R.H), Shafi'i (Rahimahumullah) bhi isi taraf gaye hain. Imam Ahmad farmate hain pehle use koray maarne chahiye. Phir rajam karna chahiye taake Quran-o-Hadith dono par amal ho jaye jaise ke Hazrat Ameer-ul-Momineen Ali (R.A) se manqool hai ke jab aap ke paas Saraja layi gayi jo shadi shuda aurat thi aur zina kari mein aayi thi toh aap ne jumerat ke din toh use koray lagwaye aur jum'a ke din sangsar kara diya. Aur farmaya ke Kitabullah par amal karke main ne koray patwaye aur Sunnat-e-Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par amal karke sangsar karaya.

Musnad-e-Ahmad, Sunan-e-Arba'a aur Muslim Sharif mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya, meri baat le lo, meri baat le lo, Allah Ta'ala ne in ke liye rasta nikal diya. Kunwara kunwari ke sath zina kar le to sau kode aur saal bhar ki jalawatni aur shadi shuda shadi shuda ke sath kare to rajam. Phir farmaya Allah ke hukm ke mat-e-hat is had ke jari karne mein tumhein un par tars aur raham na khana chahiye. Dil ka raham aur cheez hai aur woh to zaroor hoga lekin had ke jari karne mein Imam ka saza mein kami karna aur susti karna buri cheez hai. Jab Imam yani Sultan ke paas koi aisa waqia jis mein had ho, pahunch jaye, to use chahiye ke had jari kare aur use na chhore. Hadith mein hai aapas mein hudood se dargarzar karo, jo baat mujh tak pahunchi aur is mein had ho to woh to wajib aur zaroori ho gayi. Aur hadith mein hai ke had ka zameen mein qaim hona, zameen walon ke liye chalees din ki barish se behtar hai. Yeh bhi qaul hai ke tars khakar, maar ko narm na kar do balkay darmiyana taur par kode lagao, yeh bhi na ho ke haddi tod do. Tohmat lagane wale ki had ke jari karne ke waqt us ke jism par kapray hone chahiyen. Haan zani par had ke jari karne ke waqt kapray na hon. Yeh qaul Hazrat Hammad bin Abu Suleman (Rahimahullah / R.H) ka hai. Ise bayan farma kar aap ne yahi jumla ayat (Wala ta'khuzkum-ul-ra'fatu...) parha to Hazrat Saeed bin Abi Arooba ne poocha yeh hukm mein hai? Kaha haan hukm mein hai aur kodon mein yani had ke qaim karne mein aur sakht chot maarne mein. Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ki laundi ne jab zina kiya to aap ne us ke pairon par aur kamar par kode maare to Hazrat Nafe' ne isi ayat ka yeh jumla tilawat kiya ke Allah ki had ke jari karne mein tumhein tars na aana chahiye to aap ne farmaya kya tere nazdeek main ne is par koi tars khaya hai? Suno Allah ne is ke maar daalne ka hukm nahin diya na yeh farmaya hai ke us ke sar par kode maare jayen. Main ne ise taqat se kode lagaye hain aur poori saza di hai. Phir farmaya agar tumhein Allah par aur Qayamat par iman hai to tumhein is hukm ki baja-awari karni chahiye aur zaniyon par hadein qaim karne mein pehlu-tahi na karni chahiye. Aur unhein zarb bhi shadeed maarni chahiye lekin haddi todne wali nahin taake woh apne is gunah se baaz rahein aur un ki yeh saza dusron ke liye bhi ibrat bane. Rajam buri cheez nahin. Ek hadith mein hai ke ek shakhs ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) main bakri ko zibah karta hoon lekin mera dil dukhta hai. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya, is raham par bhi tujhe ajr milega. Phir farmata hai un ki saza ke waqt musalmanon ka majma hona chahiye taake sab ke dil mein dar baith jaye aur zani ki ruswai bhi ho taake aur log is se ruk jayen. Ise alaniya saza di jaye, makhfi taur par maar peet kar na chhora jaye. Ek shakhs aur us se zyada bhi ho jayen to jama'at ho gayi aur ayat par amal ho gaya isi ko le kar Imam Muhammad ka mazhab hai ke ek shakhs bhi taifa hai. Ata (Rahimahullah / R.H) ka qaul hai ke do hone chahiyen. Saeed bin Jubair (Rahimahullah / R.H) kehte hain chaar hon.

Zuhri R.H kehte hain teen ya teen se zyada. Imam Malik R.H farmate hain chaar aur us se zyada kyunke zina mein chaar se kam gawah nahin hain, chaar hon ya us se zyada. Imam Shafi R.H ka mazhab bhi yahi hai. Rabi'ah R.H kehte hain paanch hon. Hasan Basri R.H ke nazdeek das. Qatadah R.H kehte hain ek jamaat ho taake nasihat, ibrat aur saza ho. Nasr bin Alqamah R.H ke nazdeek jamaat ki maujudgi ki illat yeh bayan ki hai ke woh un logon ke liye jin par had jaari ki ja rahi hai dua-e-maghfirat-o-rahmat karein.

Zuhri R.H kehte hain teen ya teen se zyada. Imam Malik R.H farmate hain chaar aur us se zyada kyunke zina mein chaar se kam gawah nahin hain, chaar hon ya us se zyada. Nasr bin Alqamah R.H ke nazdeek jamaat ki maujudgi ki illat yeh bayan ki hai ke woh un logon ke liye jin par had jaari ki ja rahi hai dua-e-maghfirat-o-rahmat karein.

Zani aur Zaniya aur akhlaqi mujrim Allah Ta'ala khabar deta hai ke zani se zina-kari par razamand wahi aurat hoti hai jo badkar ho ya mushrika ho ke woh is buray kaam ko aib hi nahin samajhti. Aisi badkar aurat se wahi mard milta hai jo isi jaisa bad-chalan ho ya mushrik ho jo is ki hurmat ka qail hi na ho. Ibn Abbas (R.A) se ba-sanad-e-sahih marwi hai ke yahan nikah se murad jama' hai yani zaniya aurat se zina-kar ya mushrik mard hi zina karta hai. Yehi qaul Mujahid, Ikrama, Saeed bin Jubair, Urwa bin Zubair, Zahhak, Makhool, Muqatil bin Hayyan aur bohat se buzurg mufassireen se marwi hai. Mominon par yeh haram hai yani zina-kari karna aur zaniya auraton se nikah karna ya afifa aur pak-daman auraton ko aisay zaniyon ke nikah mein dena. Ibn Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke badkar auraton se nikah karna musalmanon par haram hai jaisay aur ayat mein hai (Muhsanatin ghaira musafihatin wa la muttakhidati akhdan 25) (Surah (An-Nisa: 25) yani musalmanon ko jin auraton se nikah karna chahiye un mein yeh teenon ausaf honay chahiyen woh pak-daman hon, woh badkar na hon, na chori chhupe buray logon se mel-milap karne wali hon. Yehi teenon wasf mardon mein bhi honay ka bayan kiya gaya hai. Isi liye Imam Ahmad (R.H) ka farman hai ke nek aur pak-daman musalman ka nikah badkar aurat se sahih nahin hota jab tak ke woh tauba na karle, han baad az tauba aqd-e-nikah durust hai. Isi tarah bholi bhali, pak-daman, afifa auraton ka nikah zani aur badkar logon se mun'aqid hi nahin hota jab tak woh sachay dil se apnay is napak fe'l se tauba na karle kyunke farman-e-Ilahi hai ke yeh mominon par haram kardiya gaya hai. Ek shakhs ne Umm-e-Mahzool nami ek badkar aurat se nikah kar lene ki ijazat Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se talab ki to Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yehi ayat parh kar sunayi. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke is ki talab-e-ijazat par yeh ayat utri. Tirmidhi Sharif mein hai ke ek sahabi jin ka naam Marsad bin Abu Marsad tha, yeh Makkah se musalman qaidiyon ko utha laya karte thay aur Madinay pohancha diya karte thay. Ana'q nami ek badkar aurat Makkah mein raha karti thi. Jahiliyat ke zamanay mein un ka is aurat se talluq tha. Hazrat Marsad (R.A) farmatay hain ek martaba mein ek qaidi ko lanay ke liye Makkah Sharif gaya. Mein ek bagh ki deewar ke neechay pohancha raat ka waqt tha chandni chatki hui thi. Ittefaq se Ana'q aa pohanchi aur mujhay dekh liya balkay pehchan bhi liya aur awaz de kar kaha kya Marsad hai? Mein ne kaha han Marsad hoon. Us ne bari khushi zahir ki aur mujh se kehnay lagi chalo raat meray han guzarna. Mein ne kaha Ana'q Allah Ta'ala ne zina-kari haram kardi hai. Jab woh mayoos ho gayi to us ne mujhay pakarwanay ke liye ghul machana shuru kiya ke ae khaimay walo hoshiyar ho jao dekho chor aa gaya hai. Yehi hai jo tumharay qaidiyon ko chura kar le jaya karta hai. Log jaag uthay aur aath aadmi mujhay pakarnay ke liye meray peechay doray. Mein mutthiyan band kar ke khandaq ke rastay bhaga aur ek ghar mein ja chupa.

Yeh log bhi mere peeche hi peeche ghar par aapahunche lekin main unhein na mila. Yeh wahin peshab karne ko baithe wallah unka peshab mere sar par aa raha tha lekin Allah ne unhein andha kardiya. Unki nigahain mujh par na pareen. Idhar udhar dhoond bhaal kar wapas chale gaye. Main ne kuch der guzar kar jab yeh yaqeen karliya ke woh phir so gaye honge toh yahan se nikla, phir Makkah ki raah li aur wahin pahunch kar us musalman qaidi ko apni kamar par charhaya aur wahan se le bhaga. Chunki woh bhari badan ke thay. Main jab Azkhar mein pahuncha toh thak gaya main ne unhein kamar se utara unke bandhan khol diye aur azad kardiya. Ab uthata chalata Madine pahunch gaya. Chunki Ana'q ki mohabbat mere dil mein thi. Main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se ijazat chahi ke main us se nikah karlun. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) khamosh rahe. Main ne dobara yahi sawal kiya phir bhi Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) khamosh rahe aur yeh aayat utri. Toh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya, ae Marsad zaniya se nikah zani ya mushrik hi karta hai toh us se nikah ka irada chor de. Imam Abu Dawood aur Nasai bhi ise apni Sunan ki Kitab-un-Nikah mein laye hain. Abu Dawood waghera mein hai zani jis par kore lag chuke hon woh apne jaise se hi nikah karsakta hai. Musnad Imam Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain, teen qisam ke log hain jo jannat mein na jayenge aur jin ki taraf Allah Ta'ala nazar-e-rahmat se na dekhega. 001 Maa baap ka nafarman. 002 Woh auratein jo mardon ki mushabahat karein. 003 Aur Dayyus. Aur teen qisam ke log hain jin ki taraf Allah Ta'ala nazar-e-rahmat se na dekhega. 001 Maa baap ka nafarman. 002 Hamesha ka nashe ka aadi. 003 Aur Allah ki raah mein de kar ehsan jatane wala. Musnad mein hai Aap farmate hain teen qisam ke log hain jin par Allah Ta'ala ne jannat haram kardi hai 001 Hamesha ka sharabi. 002 Maa baap ka nafarman. 003 Aur apne ghar walon mein khabasat ko barqarar rakhne wala. Abu Dawood Tayalisi mein hai jannat mein koi Dayyus nahin jayega. Ibn Majah mein hai jo shakhs Allah Ta'ala se paak saaf ho kar milna chahta hai, use chahiye ke pakdaman aurton se nikah kare jo londiyan na hon. Is ki sanad zaeef hai. Dayyus kehte hain be-ghairat shakhs ko. Nasai mein hai ke ek shakhs Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aaya aur kehne laga mujhe apni biwi se bahut hi mohabbat hai lekin us mein yeh aadat hai ke kisi haath ko wapas nahin lotati. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya talaq de de. Us ne kaha mujhe toh sabr nahin aane ka. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya phir ja us se faida utha. Lekin yeh hadith sabit nahin is ka rawi Abdul Kareem qawi nahin. Dusra rawi is ka Haroon hai jo us se qawi hai magar un ki riwayat mursal hai aur yahi theek bhi hai. Yahi riwayat Musnad mein marwi hai lekin Imam Nasai (Rahimahullah / R.H) ka faisla yeh hai ke musnad karna khata hai aur sawab yahi hai ke yeh mursal hai. Yeh hadith ki aur kitabon mein hai aur sanadon se bhi marwi hai. Imam Ahmad (Rahimahullah / R.H) toh ise munkar kehte hain.

Imam Ibn-e-Qutaibah (R.H) is ki ta'weel karte hain ke yeh jo kaha hai ke woh kisi chhoone wale ke haath ko lautati nahin is se murad be-had sakhawat hai ke woh kisi sa'il se inkar hi nahin karti. Lekin agar yahi matlab hota toh hadith mein bajaye 'lamis' ke lafz ke 'multamis' ka lafz hona chahiye tha. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke us ki khaslat aisi maloom hoti thi na yeh ke woh burai karti thi kyunke agar yahi aib us mein hota toh phir Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ) us sahabi (R.A) ko us ke rakhne ki ijazat na dete kyunke yeh toh dayyusi hai. Jis par sakht wa'eed aayi hai. Haan yeh mumkin hai ke khawand ko us ki aadat aisi lagi ho aur us ka andesha zahir kiya ho toh Aap (ﷺ) ne mashwara diya ke phir talaq de do lekin jab us ne kaha ke mujhe us se bahut hi mohabbat hai toh Aap (ﷺ) ne basane ki ijazat de di kyunke mohabbat toh majood hai. Ise ek khatre ke sirf wahm par tod dena mumkin hai koi burai paida karde. Wallahu Subhanahu wa Ta'ala A'lam. Al-gharaz zaniya aurton se pak-daman musalmanon ko nikah karna mana hai haan jab woh tauba kar lein toh nikah halal hai. Chunancha Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se ek shakhs ne poocha ke ek aisi hi wahi aurat se mera bura ta'alluq tha. Lekin ab Allah Ta'ala ne hamein tauba ki taufiq di toh main chahta hoon ke us se nikah kar loon lekin ba'az log kehte hain ke zani hi zaniya aur mushrika se nikah karte hain. Aap ne farmaya is aayat ka yeh matlab nahin tum us se ab nikah kar sakte ho jao agar koi gunah ho toh mere zimme. Hazrat Yahya se jab yeh zikr aaya toh aap ne farmaya ke yeh aayat mansookh hai us ke baad ki aayat (Wa ankihul ayama minkum was-saliheena min ibadikum wa ima'ikum in yakunu fuqara'a yughnihimullahu min fadlihi wallahu wasi'un 'alim) (An-Nur: 32) se. Imam Abu Abdullah Muhammad bin Idris Shafi'i (R.H) bhi yahi farmate hain.)

Tohmat lagane wale mujrim: Jo log kisi aurat par ya kisi mard par zinakari ki tohmat lagayen aur suboot na de sakein, toh unhein assi (80) kode lagaye jayenge. Haan agar shahadat pesh kar dein toh had se bach jayenge aur jin par jurm sabit hua hai un par had jari ki jayegi. Agar shahadat na pesh kar sake toh assi (80) kode bhi lagenge aur aayinda ke liye hamesha unki shahadat ghair maqbool rahegi aur woh aadil nahin balkay fasiq samjhe jayenge. Is aayat mein jin logon ko makhsoos aur mustasna (exempt) kardiya hai toh baaz toh kehte hain ke yeh istisna sirf fasiq hone se hai, yani baad az tauba woh fasiq nahin rahenge. Baaz kehte hain na fasiq rahenge na mardood-ush-shahadat balkay phir unki shahadat bhi li jayegi. Haan had jo hai woh tauba se kisi tarah hat nahin sakti. Imam Malik, Ahmad aur Shafii (R.H) ka mazhab toh yeh hai ke tauba se shahadat ka mardood hona aur fisq hat jayega. Sayyid-ut-Tabi'een Hazrat Saeed bin Musayyib (R.H) aur salaf ki ek jamaat ka yahi mazhab hai, lekin Imam Abu Hanifa (R.H) farmate hain sirf fisq door ho jayega lekin shahadat qabool nahin ho sakti. Baaz aur log bhi yahi kehte hain. Sha'bi aur Zahhak kehte hain ke agar usne is baat ka iqrar karliya ke usne bohtan bandha tha aur phir tauba bhi poori ki toh uski shahadat uske baad maqbool hai. Wallahu A'lam.

Li'an se murad in aayaton mein Allah Ta'ala Rabb-ul-Aalameen ne un khawandon ke liye jo apni biwiyon ki nisbat aisi baat keh dein chhutkare ki surat bayan farmayi hai ke jab woh gawah pesh na kar sakein to li'an kar lein. Is ki surat yeh hai ke Imam ke samne aakar woh apna bayan de jab shahadat na pesh kar sake to hakim use char gawahon ke qaim-maqam char qasmein de ga aur yeh qasam khakar kahe ga ke woh sacha hai jo baat kehta hai woh haq hai. Panchwin dafa kahe ga ke agar woh jhoota ho to us par Allah ki la'nat. Itna kehte hi Imam Shafi'i (R.H) waghera ke nazdeek us ki aurat us se ba'in ho jaye gi aur hamesha ke liye haram ho jaye gi. Yeh mehar ada kar de ga aur us aurat par zina sabit ho jaye gi. Lekin agar woh aurat bhi samne mula'ana kare to had us par se hat jaye gi. Yeh bhi char martaba halfiya bayan de gi ke us ka khawand jhoota hai. Aur panchwin martaba kahe gi ke agar woh sacha ho to us par Allah ka ghazab nazil ho. Is nukta ko bhi khayal mein rakhiye ke aurat ke liye ghazab ka lafz kaha gaya is liye ke umooman koi mard nahin chahta ke woh apni biwi ko khwah-makhwah tohmat lagaye aur apne aap ko balkay apne kunbay ko bhi badnam kare umooman woh sacha hi hota hai aur apne sidq ki bina par hi woh ma'zoor samjha ja sakta hai. Is liye panchwin martaba mein us se yeh kehwaya gaya ke agar us ka khawand sacha ho to us par Allah ka ghazab aaye. Phir ghazab wale woh hote hain jo haq ko jaan kar phir us se rogardani karein. Phir farmata hai ke agar Allah ka fazl-o-rahm tum par na hota to aisi aasaniyan tum par na hotin balkay tum par mushaqqat utarti. Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ki tauba qabool farmaya karta hai go kaise hi gunah hon aur go kisi waqt bhi tauba ho woh Hakeem hai, apni shar' mein, apne hukmon mein, apni muman'at mein. Is aayat ke bare mein jo riwayatein hain woh bhi sun lijiye. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai jab yeh aayat utri to Hazrat Sa'ad bin Ubada (R.A) jo Ansar ke sardar hain kehne lage Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) kya yeh aayat isi tarah utari gayi hai? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya Ansariyo sunte nahin ho? Yeh tumhare sardar kya keh rahe hain? Unhon ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) aap darguzar farmaiye yeh sirf un ki barhi charhi ghairat ka ba'is hai aur kuch nahin. Un ki ghairat ka yeh haal hai ke unhein koi beti dene ki jurrat nahin karta. Hazrat Sa'ad (R.A) ne farmaya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) yeh to mera imaan hai ke yeh haq hai lekin agar main kisi ko us ke paon pakre hue dekh loon to bhi main use kuch nahin keh sakta yahan tak ke main char gawah laoon tab tak to woh apna kaam pura kar le ga. Is baat ko zara si hi der hui hogi ke Hazrat Hilal bin Umayya (R.A) aaye yeh un teen shakhson mein se ek ghair mard hai khud aap ne apni aankhon se dekha aur apne kanon se un ki baatein sunin.

Subh hi subh Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se yeh zikr kiya, aap (ﷺ) ko bahut bura maloom hua aur tabiyat par nihayat hi shaaq guzra. Sab Ansar jama ho gaye aur kehne lage Hazrat Sa'ad bin Ubada (R.A) ke qaul ki wajah se hum is aafat mein mubtala kiye gaye, magar is surat mein ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) Hilal bin Umayya ko tohmat ki had lagayein aur uski shahadat ko mardood thahrayein. Hazrat Hilal (R.A) kehne lage, Wallah main sacha hoon aur mujhe Allah Ta'ala se umeed hai ke Allah Ta'ala mera chhutkara karde ga. Kehne lage, Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ)! Main dekhta hoon ke mera kalam aap ki tabiyat par bahut giraan guzra. Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ)! Mujhe Allah ki qasam hai main sacha hoon, Allah khoob jaanta hai. Lekin chunke gawah pesh nahin kar sakte thay, qareeb tha ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) unhein had maarne ko farmate, itne mein wahi utarna shuru hui. Sahaba aap ke chehre ko dekh kar alamat se pehchan gaye ke is waqt wahi nazil ho rahi hai. Jab utar chuki to aap (ﷺ) ne Hazrat Hilal (R.A) ki taraf dekh kar farmaya, "Ae Hilal (R.A)! Khush ho jao, Allah Ta'ala ne tumhare liye kushadgi aur chhutti nazil farma di." Hazrat Hilal (R.A) kehne lage, Alhamdulillah! Mujhe Allah Raheem ki zaat se yahi umeed thi. Phir aap ne Hazrat Hilal (R.A) ki biwi ko bulwaya aur un dono ke samne aayat-e-mula'ana parh kar sunayi aur farmaya, "Dekho aakhirat ka azab duniya ke azab se sakht hai." Hilal (R.A) farmane lage, Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ)! Main bilkul sacha hoon. Us aurat ne kaha, Huzoor (ﷺ)! Yeh jhoot keh raha hai. Aap ne hukum diya ke acha li'an karo. To Hilal (R.A) ko kaha gaya ke is tarah chaar qasmein khao aur paanchvi dafa yun kaho. Hazrat Hilal (R.A) jab chaar baar keh chuke aur paanchvi baar ki naubat aayi to aap se kaha gaya ke, "Hilal! Allah se dar ja. Duniya ki saza aakhirat ke azabon se bahut halki hai, yeh paanchvi baar teri zaban se nikalte hi tujh par azab wajib ho jaye ga." To aap ne kaha, Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ)! Qasam Allah ki, jis tarah Allah ne mujhe duniya ki saza se meri sadaqat ki wajah se bachaya, isi tarah aakhirat ke azab se bhi meri sachayi ki wajah se mera Rab mujhe mehfooz rakhe ga. Phir paanchvi dafa ke alfaaz bhi zaban se ada kar diye. Ab us aurat se kaha gaya ke tu chaar dafa qasmein kha ke yeh jhoota hai. Jab woh charon qasmein kha chuki to Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne use paanchvi dafa ke is kalma ke kehne se roka aur jis tarah Hazrat Hilal (R.A) ko samjhaya gaya tha, us se bhi farmaya. To use kuch khayal paida ho gaya. Ruki, jhujhki, zaban ko sambhala, qareeb tha ke apne qusoor ka iqrar kar le lekin phir kehne lagi, "Main hamesha ke liye apni qaum ko ruswa nahin karne ki." Phir keh diya ke agar iska khawand sacha ho to is par Allah ka gazab nazil ho. Pas Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ) ne un dono mein judayi kara di aur hukum de diya ke is se jo aulad ho woh Hazrat Hilal (R.A) ki taraf mansoob na ki jaye. Na use haram ki aulad kaha jaye. Jo is bache ko harami kahe ya us aurat par tohmat rakhe, woh had lagaya jaye ga. Yeh bhi faisla diya ke iska koi naan-o-nafaqa iske khawand par nahin kyunke judayi kar di gayi hai.

Na talaq hui hai na khawand ka inteqal hua hai aur farmaya dekho agar yeh bacha surkh safaid rang moti pindliyon wala paida ho to to isay Hilal ka samajhna aur agar woh patli pindliyon wala siyahi mail rang ka paida ho to us shakhs ka samajhna jis ke sath is par ilzam qaim kiya gaya hai. Jab bacha hua to logon ne dekha ke woh is buri sifat par tha jo ilzam ki haqaniyat ki nishani thi. Is waqt Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya agar yeh masla qasmon par tay shuda na hota to main is aurat ko qatan had lagata. Yeh sahibzaday baray ho kar Misr ke wali banay aur un ki nisbat un ki maa ki taraf thi. (Abu Dawood) Is hadith ke aur bhi bohat se shahid hain. Bukhari Sharif mein bhi yeh hadith hai. Is mein hai ke Shareek bin Sahma ke sath tohmat lagayi gayi thi. Aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samnay jab Hazrat Hilal (R.A) ne zikr kiya to aap ne farmaya gawah pesh karo warna tumhari peeth par had lagay gi. Hazrat Hilal (R.A) ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ek shakhs apni biwi ko buray kaam par dekh kar gawah dhoondnay jaye? Lekin An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yahi farmatay rahay. Is mein yeh bhi hai ke dono ke samnay aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh bhi farmaya ke Allah khoob janta hai ke tum dono mein se ek zaroor jhoota hai. Kya tum mein se koi tauba kar ke apne jhoot se hat-ta hai? Aur riwayat mein hai ke panchwin dafa aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne kisi se kaha ke is ka munh band kar do phir isay nasihat ki. Aur farmaya Allah ki laanat se har cheez halki hai. Isi tarah is aurat ke sath kiya gaya. Saeed bin Jubair (R.H) farmatay hain ke li'an karne walay mard-o-aurat ki nisbat mujh se daryaft kiya gaya ke kya in mein judai kara di jaye? Yeh waqea hai Hazrat Ibn-e-Zubair (R.A) ki imarat ke zamana ka. Mujh se to is ka jawab kuch na ban para to main apne makan se chal kar Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) ki manzil par aaya aur un se yahi masla poocha to aap ne farmaya SubhanAllah sab se pehlay yeh baat falan bin falan ne daryaft ki thi ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) koi shakhs apni aurat ko kisi buray kaam par paye to agar zaban se nikale to bhi bari besharmi ki baat hai aur agar khamosh rahay to bhi bari beghairti ki khamoshi hai. Aap sun kar khamosh ho rahay. Phir woh aaya aur kehnay laga Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) main ne jo sawal janab se kiya tha afsos wahi waqea mere han pesh aaya. Pas Allah Ta'ala ne Surah Noor ki yeh aayatein nazil farmayin. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne dono ko paas bula kar ek ek ko alag alag nasihat ki. Bohat kuch samjhaya lekin har ek ne apna sacha hona zahir kiya phir dono ne aayat ke mutabiq qasmein khayin aur aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne in mein judai kara di. Is ki surat yeh hai ke Imam ke samne aakar woh apna bayan de jab shahadat na pesh kar sake to hakim use char gawahon ke qaim-maqam char qasmein de ga aur yeh qasam khakar kahe ga ke woh sacha hai jo baat kehta hai woh haq hai. Panchwin dafa kahe ga ke agar woh jhoota ho to us par Allah ki la'nat. Itna kehte hi Imam Shafi'i (R.H) waghera ke nazdeek us ki aurat us se ba'in ho jaye gi aur hamesha ke liye haram ho jaye gi. Yeh mehar ada kar de ga aur us aurat par zina sabit ho jaye gi. Lekin agar woh aurat bhi samne mula'ana kare to had us par se hat jaye gi. Yeh bhi char martaba halfiya bayan de gi ke us ka khawand jhoota hai. Aur panchwin martaba kahe gi ke agar woh sacha ho to us par Allah ka ghazab nazil ho. Is nukta ko bhi khayal mein rakhiye ke aurat ke liye ghazab ka lafz kaha gaya is liye ke umooman koi mard nahin chahta ke woh apni biwi ko khwah-makhwah tohmat lagaye aur apne aap ko balkay apne kunbay ko bhi badnam kare umooman woh sacha hi hota hai aur apne sidq ki bina par hi woh ma'zoor samjha ja sakta hai. Is liye panchwin martaba mein us se yeh kehwaya gaya ke agar us ka khawand sacha ho to us par Allah ka ghazab aaye. Phir ghazab wale woh hote hain jo haq ko jaan kar phir us se rogardani karein. Phir farmata hai ke agar Allah ka fazl-o-rahm tum par na hota to aisi aasaniyan tum par na hotin balkay tum par mushaqqat utarti. Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ki tauba qabool farmaya karta hai go kaise hi gunah hon aur go kisi waqt bhi tauba ho woh Hakeem hai, apni shar' mein, apne hukmon mein, apni muman'at mein. Is aayat ke bare mein jo riwayatein hain woh bhi sun lijiye. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai jab yeh aayat utri to Hazrat Sa'ad bin Ubada (R.A) jo Ansar ke sardar hain kehne lage Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) kya yeh aayat isi tarah utari gayi hai? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya Ansariyo sunte nahin ho? Yeh tumhare sardar kya keh rahe hain? Unhon ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) aap darguzar farmaiye yeh sirf un ki barhi charhi ghairat ka ba'is hai aur kuch nahin. Un ki ghairat ka yeh haal hai ke unhein koi beti dene ki jurrat nahin karta. Hazrat Sa'ad (R.A) ne farmaya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) yeh to mera imaan hai ke yeh haq hai lekin agar main kisi ko us ke paon pakre hue dekh loon to bhi main use kuch nahin keh sakta yahan tak ke main char gawah laoon tab tak to woh apna kaam pura kar le ga. Is baat ko zara si hi der hui hogi ke Hazrat Hilal bin Umayya (R.A) aaye yeh un teen shakhson mein se ek ghair mard hai khud aap ne apni aankhon se dekha aur apne kanon se un ki baatein sunin.

Subh hi subh Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se yeh zikr kiya, aap (ﷺ) ko bahut bura maloom hua aur tabiyat par nihayat hi shaaq guzra. Sab Ansar jama ho gaye aur kehne lage Hazrat Sa'ad bin Ubada (R.A) ke qaul ki wajah se hum is aafat mein mubtala kiye gaye, magar is surat mein ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) Hilal bin Umayya ko tohmat ki had lagayein aur uski shahadat ko mardood thahrayein. Hazrat Hilal (R.A) kehne lage, Wallah main sacha hoon aur mujhe Allah Ta'ala se umeed hai ke Allah Ta'ala mera chhutkara karde ga. Kehne lage, Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ)! Main dekhta hoon ke mera kalam aap ki tabiyat par bahut giraan guzra. Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ)! Mujhe Allah ki qasam hai main sacha hoon, Allah khoob jaanta hai. Lekin chunke gawah pesh nahin kar sakte thay, qareeb tha ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) unhein had maarne ko farmate, itne mein wahi utarna shuru hui. Sahaba aap ke chehre ko dekh kar alamat se pehchan gaye ke is waqt wahi nazil ho rahi hai. Jab utar chuki to aap (ﷺ) ne Hazrat Hilal (R.A) ki taraf dekh kar farmaya, "Ae Hilal (R.A)! Khush ho jao, Allah Ta'ala ne tumhare liye kushadgi aur chhutti nazil farma di." Hazrat Hilal (R.A) kehne lage, Alhamdulillah! Mujhe Allah Raheem ki zaat se yahi umeed thi. Phir aap ne Hazrat Hilal (R.A) ki biwi ko bulwaya aur un dono ke samne aayat-e-mula'ana parh kar sunayi aur farmaya, "Dekho aakhirat ka azab duniya ke azab se sakht hai." Hilal (R.A) farmane lage, Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ)! Main bilkul sacha hoon. Us aurat ne kaha, Huzoor (ﷺ)! Yeh jhoot keh raha hai. Aap ne hukum diya ke acha li'an karo. To Hilal (R.A) ko kaha gaya ke is tarah chaar qasmein khao aur paanchvi dafa yun kaho. Hazrat Hilal (R.A) jab chaar baar keh chuke aur paanchvi baar ki naubat aayi to aap se kaha gaya ke, "Hilal! Allah se dar ja. Duniya ki saza aakhirat ke azabon se bahut halki hai, yeh paanchvi baar teri zaban se nikalte hi tujh par azab wajib ho jaye ga." To aap ne kaha, Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ)! Qasam Allah ki, jis tarah Allah ne mujhe duniya ki saza se meri sadaqat ki wajah se bachaya, isi tarah aakhirat ke azab se bhi meri sachayi ki wajah se mera Rab mujhe mehfooz rakhe ga. Phir paanchvi dafa ke alfaaz bhi zaban se ada kar diye. Ab us aurat se kaha gaya ke tu chaar dafa qasmein kha ke yeh jhoota hai. Jab woh charon qasmein kha chuki to Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne use paanchvi dafa ke is kalma ke kehne se roka aur jis tarah Hazrat Hilal (R.A) ko samjhaya gaya tha, us se bhi farmaya. To use kuch khayal paida ho gaya. Ruki, jhujhki, zaban ko sambhala, qareeb tha ke apne qusoor ka iqrar kar le lekin phir kehne lagi, "Main hamesha ke liye apni qaum ko ruswa nahin karne ki." Phir keh diya ke agar iska khawand sacha ho to is par Allah ka gazab nazil ho. Pas Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ) ne un dono mein judayi kara di aur hukum de diya ke is se jo aulad ho woh Hazrat Hilal (R.A) ki taraf mansoob na ki jaye. Na use haram ki aulad kaha jaye. Jo is bache ko harami kahe ya us aurat par tohmat rakhe, woh had lagaya jaye ga. Yeh bhi faisla diya ke iska koi naan-o-nafaqa iske khawand par nahin kyunke judayi kar di gayi hai.

Na talaq hui hai na khawand ka inteqal hua hai aur farmaya dekho agar yeh bacha surkh safaid rang moti pindliyon wala paida ho to to isay Hilal ka samajhna aur agar woh patli pindliyon wala siyahi mail rang ka paida ho to us shakhs ka samajhna jis ke sath is par ilzam qaim kiya gaya hai. Jab bacha hua to logon ne dekha ke woh is buri sifat par tha jo ilzam ki haqaniyat ki nishani thi. Is waqt Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya agar yeh masla qasmon par tay shuda na hota to main is aurat ko qatan had lagata. Yeh sahibzaday baray ho kar Misr ke wali banay aur un ki nisbat un ki maa ki taraf thi. (Abu Dawood) Is hadith ke aur bhi bohat se shahid hain. Bukhari Sharif mein bhi yeh hadith hai. Is mein hai ke Shareek bin Sahma ke sath tohmat lagayi gayi thi. Aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samnay jab Hazrat Hilal (R.A) ne zikr kiya to aap ne farmaya gawah pesh karo warna tumhari peeth par had lagay gi. Hazrat Hilal (R.A) ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ek shakhs apni biwi ko buray kaam par dekh kar gawah dhoondnay jaye? Lekin An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yahi farmatay rahay. Is mein yeh bhi hai ke dono ke samnay aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh bhi farmaya ke Allah khoob janta hai ke tum dono mein se ek zaroor jhoota hai. Kya tum mein se koi tauba kar ke apne jhoot se hat-ta hai? Aur riwayat mein hai ke panchwin dafa aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne kisi se kaha ke is ka munh band kar do phir isay nasihat ki. Aur farmaya Allah ki laanat se har cheez halki hai. Isi tarah is aurat ke sath kiya gaya. Saeed bin Jubair (R.H) farmatay hain ke li'an karne walay mard-o-aurat ki nisbat mujh se daryaft kiya gaya ke kya in mein judai kara di jaye? Yeh waqea hai Hazrat Ibn-e-Zubair (R.A) ki imarat ke zamana ka. Mujh se to is ka jawab kuch na ban para to main apne makan se chal kar Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) ki manzil par aaya aur un se yahi masla poocha to aap ne farmaya SubhanAllah sab se pehlay yeh baat falan bin falan ne daryaft ki thi ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) koi shakhs apni aurat ko kisi buray kaam par paye to agar zaban se nikale to bhi bari besharmi ki baat hai aur agar khamosh rahay to bhi bari beghairti ki khamoshi hai. Aap sun kar khamosh ho rahay. Phir woh aaya aur kehnay laga Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) main ne jo sawal janab se kiya tha afsos wahi waqea mere han pesh aaya. Jab bacha hua to logon ne dekha ke woh is buri sifat par tha jo ilzam ki haqaniyat ki nishani thi. Is waqt Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya agar yeh masla qasmon par tay shuda na hota to main is aurat ko qatan had lagata. Yeh sahibzaday baray ho kar Misr ke wali banay aur un ki nisbat un ki maa ki taraf thi. (Abu Dawood) Is hadith ke aur bhi bohat se shahid hain. Bukhari Sharif mein bhi yeh hadith hai. Is mein hai ke Shareek bin Sahma ke sath tohmat lagayi gayi thi. Aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samnay jab Hazrat Hilal (R.A) ne zikr kiya to aap ne farmaya gawah pesh karo warna tumhari peeth par had lagay gi. Hazrat Hilal (R.A) ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ek shakhs apni biwi ko buray kaam par dekh kar gawah dhoondnay jaye? Lekin An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yahi farmatay rahay. Is mein yeh bhi hai ke dono ke samnay aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh bhi farmaya ke Allah khoob janta hai ke tum dono mein se ek zaroor jhoota hai. Kya tum mein se koi tauba kar ke apne jhoot se hat-ta hai? Aur riwayat mein hai ke panchwin dafa aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne kisi se kaha ke is ka munh band kar do phir isay nasihat ki. Aur farmaya Allah ki laanat se har cheez halki hai. Isi tarah is aurat ke sath kiya gaya. Saeed bin Jubair (R.H) farmatay hain ke li'an karne walay mard-o-aurat ki nisbat mujh se daryaft kiya gaya ke kya in mein judai kara di jaye? Yeh waqea hai Hazrat Ibn-e-Zubair (R.A) ki imarat ke zamana ka. Mujh se to is ka jawab kuch na ban para to main apne makan se chal kar Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) ki manzil par aaya aur un se yahi masla poocha to aap ne farmaya SubhanAllah sab se pehlay yeh baat falan bin falan ne daryaft ki thi ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) koi shakhs apni aurat ko kisi buray kaam par paye to agar zaban se nikale to bhi bari besharmi ki baat hai aur agar khamosh rahay to bhi bari beghairti ki khamoshi hai. Aap sun kar khamosh ho rahay. Phir woh aaya aur kehnay laga Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) main ne jo sawal janab se kiya tha afsos wahi waqea mere han pesh aaya. Pas Allah Ta'ala ne Surah Noor ki yeh aayatein nazil farmayin. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne dono ko paas bula kar ek ek ko alag alag nasihat ki. Bohat kuch samjhaya lekin har ek ne apna sacha hona zahir kiya phir dono ne aayat ke mutabiq qasmein khayin aur aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne in mein judai kara di. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke sahaba ka ek majma sham ke waqt jumma ke din masjid mein baitha hua tha ke ek Ansari ne kaha jab koi shakhs apni biwi ke sath kisi shakhs ko paye to agar woh isay maar dalay to tum isay maar dalogay aur agar zaban se nikalay ga to tum shahadat majood na honay ki wajah se isi ko koray lagao gay aur agar yeh andher dekh kar khamosh ho kar baitha rahay to yeh bari beghairti aur bari behayayi hai.

Wallah agar main subh tak zinda raha toh An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se is ki babat daryaft karunga. Chunancha us ne inhi lafzon mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se poocha aur dua ki ke ya Allah is ka faisla nazil farma. Pas aayat-e-li'an utri aur sab se pehle yahi shakhs is mein mubtala hua. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Uwaimir (R.A) ne Hazrat Asim bin Adi (R.A) se kaha ke zara jao Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se daryaft toh karo ke agar koi shakhs apni biwi ke sath kisi ko paye toh kya kare? Aisa toh nahin ke woh qatl kare toh use bhi qatl kiya jayega? Chunancha Asim (R.A) ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se daryaft kiya toh Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is sawal se bahut naraz huye. Jab Uwaimir (R.A) Asim (R.A) se mile toh poocha ke kaho tum ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se daryaft kiya? Aur aap ne kya jawab diya? Asim (R.A) ne kaha tum ne mujh se koi achi khidmat nahin li, afsos mere is sawal par Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne aib pakra aur bura mana. Uwaimir (R.A) ne kaha ab agar main ise apne ghar le jaun toh goya main ne is par jhoot tohmat bandhi thi. Pas aap ke hukum se pehle hi is aurat ko juda kar diya. Phir toh li'an karne walon ka yahi tareeqa muqarrar ho gaya. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke yeh aurat hamila thi aur un ke khawand ne is se inkar kiya ke yeh hamal un se hua. Is liye yeh bacha apni maa ki taraf mansoob hota raha, phir mansookh tareeqa yun jaari hua ke yeh apni maa ka waris hoga aur maa is ki waris hogi. Ek mursal aur ghareeb hadith mein hai ke aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Siddiq (R.A) aur Hazrat Umar (R.A) se poocha ke agar tumhare han aisi wardat ho toh kya karoge? Donon ne kaha gardan ura denge. Aise waqt chashm-poshi wahi kar sakte hain jo dayyus hon, is par yeh aayatein utrin. Ek riwayat mein hai ke sab se pehla li'an musalmanon mein Hilal bin Umayyah (R.A) aur un ki biwi ke darmiyan hua tha.

Li'an se murad in aayaton mein Allah Ta'ala Rabb-ul-Aalameen ne un khawandon ke liye jo apni biwiyon ki nisbat aisi baat keh dein chhutkare ki surat bayan farmayi hai ke jab woh gawah pesh na kar sakein to li'an kar lein. Is ki surat yeh hai ke Imam ke samne aakar woh apna bayan de jab shahadat na pesh kar sake to hakim use char gawahon ke qaim-maqam char qasmein de ga aur yeh qasam khakar kahe ga ke woh sacha hai jo baat kehta hai woh haq hai. Panchwin dafa kahe ga ke agar woh jhoota ho to us par Allah ki la'nat. Itna kehte hi Imam Shafi'i (R.H) waghera ke nazdeek us ki aurat us se ba'in ho jaye gi aur hamesha ke liye haram ho jaye gi. Yeh mehar ada kar de ga aur us aurat par zina sabit ho jaye gi. Lekin agar woh aurat bhi samne mula'ana kare to had us par se hat jaye gi. Yeh bhi char martaba halfiya bayan de gi ke us ka khawand jhoota hai. Aur panchwin martaba kahe gi ke agar woh sacha ho to us par Allah ka ghazab nazil ho. Is nukta ko bhi khayal mein rakhiye ke aurat ke liye ghazab ka lafz kaha gaya is liye ke umooman koi mard nahin chahta ke woh apni biwi ko khwah-makhwah tohmat lagaye aur apne aap ko balkay apne kunbay ko bhi badnam kare umooman woh sacha hi hota hai aur apne sidq ki bina par hi woh ma'zoor samjha ja sakta hai. Is liye panchwin martaba mein us se yeh kehwaya gaya ke agar us ka khawand sacha ho to us par Allah ka ghazab aaye. Phir ghazab wale woh hote hain jo haq ko jaan kar phir us se rogardani karein. Phir farmata hai ke agar Allah ka fazl-o-rahm tum par na hota to aisi aasaniyan tum par na hotin balkay tum par mushaqqat utarti. Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ki tauba qabool farmaya karta hai go kaise hi gunah hon aur go kisi waqt bhi tauba ho woh Hakeem hai, apni shar' mein, apne hukmon mein, apni muman'at mein. Is aayat ke bare mein jo riwayatein hain woh bhi sun lijiye. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai jab yeh aayat utri to Hazrat Sa'ad bin Ubada (R.A) jo Ansar ke sardar hain kehne lage Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) kya yeh aayat isi tarah utari gayi hai? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya Ansariyo sunte nahin ho? Yeh tumhare sardar kya keh rahe hain? Unhon ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) aap darguzar farmaiye yeh sirf un ki barhi charhi ghairat ka ba'is hai aur kuch nahin. Un ki ghairat ka yeh haal hai ke unhein koi beti dene ki jurrat nahin karta. Hazrat Sa'ad (R.A) ne farmaya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) yeh to mera imaan hai ke yeh haq hai lekin agar main kisi ko us ke paon pakre hue dekh loon to bhi main use kuch nahin keh sakta yahan tak ke main char gawah laoon tab tak to woh apna kaam pura kar le ga. Is baat ko zara si hi der hui hogi ke Hazrat Hilal bin Umayya (R.A) aaye yeh un teen shakhson mein se ek ghair mard hai khud aap ne apni aankhon se dekha aur apne kanon se un ki baatein sunin.

Subh hi subh Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se yeh zikr kiya, aap (ﷺ) ko bahut bura maloom hua aur tabiyat par nihayat hi shaaq guzra. Sab Ansar jama ho gaye aur kehne lage Hazrat Sa'ad bin Ubada (R.A) ke qaul ki wajah se hum is aafat mein mubtala kiye gaye, magar is surat mein ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) Hilal bin Umayya ko tohmat ki had lagayein aur uski shahadat ko mardood thahrayein. Hazrat Hilal (R.A) kehne lage, Wallah main sacha hoon aur mujhe Allah Ta'ala se umeed hai ke Allah Ta'ala mera chhutkara karde ga. Kehne lage, Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ)! Main dekhta hoon ke mera kalam aap ki tabiyat par bahut giraan guzra. Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ)! Mujhe Allah ki qasam hai main sacha hoon, Allah khoob jaanta hai. Lekin chunke gawah pesh nahin kar sakte thay, qareeb tha ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) unhein had maarne ko farmate, itne mein wahi utarna shuru hui. Sahaba aap ke chehre ko dekh kar alamat se pehchan gaye ke is waqt wahi nazil ho rahi hai. Jab utar chuki to aap (ﷺ) ne Hazrat Hilal (R.A) ki taraf dekh kar farmaya, "Ae Hilal (R.A)! Khush ho jao, Allah Ta'ala ne tumhare liye kushadgi aur chhutti nazil farma di." Hazrat Hilal (R.A) kehne lage, Alhamdulillah! Mujhe Allah Raheem ki zaat se yahi umeed thi. Phir aap ne Hazrat Hilal (R.A) ki biwi ko bulwaya aur un dono ke samne aayat-e-mula'ana parh kar sunayi aur farmaya, "Dekho aakhirat ka azab duniya ke azab se sakht hai." Hilal (R.A) farmane lage, Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ)! Main bilkul sacha hoon. Us aurat ne kaha, Huzoor (ﷺ)! Yeh jhoot keh raha hai. Aap ne hukum diya ke acha li'an karo. To Hilal (R.A) ko kaha gaya ke is tarah chaar qasmein khao aur paanchvi dafa yun kaho. Hazrat Hilal (R.A) jab chaar baar keh chuke aur paanchvi baar ki naubat aayi to aap se kaha gaya ke, "Hilal! Allah se dar ja. Duniya ki saza aakhirat ke azabon se bahut halki hai, yeh paanchvi baar teri zaban se nikalte hi tujh par azab wajib ho jaye ga." To aap ne kaha, Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ)! Qasam Allah ki, jis tarah Allah ne mujhe duniya ki saza se meri sadaqat ki wajah se bachaya, isi tarah aakhirat ke azab se bhi meri sachayi ki wajah se mera Rab mujhe mehfooz rakhe ga. Phir paanchvi dafa ke alfaaz bhi zaban se ada kar diye. Ab us aurat se kaha gaya ke tu chaar dafa qasmein kha ke yeh jhoota hai. Jab woh charon qasmein kha chuki to Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne use paanchvi dafa ke is kalma ke kehne se roka aur jis tarah Hazrat Hilal (R.A) ko samjhaya gaya tha, us se bhi farmaya. To use kuch khayal paida ho gaya. Ruki, jhujhki, zaban ko sambhala, qareeb tha ke apne qusoor ka iqrar kar le lekin phir kehne lagi, "Main hamesha ke liye apni qaum ko ruswa nahin karne ki." Phir keh diya ke agar iska khawand sacha ho to is par Allah ka gazab nazil ho. Pas Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ) ne un dono mein judayi kara di aur hukum de diya ke is se jo aulad ho woh Hazrat Hilal (R.A) ki taraf mansoob na ki jaye. Na use haram ki aulad kaha jaye.
