Hazrat Hilal (R.A) kehne lage, Wallah main sacha hoon aur mujhe Allah Ta'ala se umeed hai ke Allah Ta'ala mera chhutkara karde ga. Kehne lage, Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ)! Main dekhta hoon ke mera kalam aap ki tabiyat par bahut giraan guzra. Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ)! Mujhe Allah ki qasam hai main sacha hoon, Allah khoob jaanta hai. Lekin chunke gawah pesh nahin kar sakte thay, qareeb tha ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) unhein had maarne ko farmate, itne mein wahi utarna shuru hui. Sahaba aap ke chehre ko dekh kar alamat se pehchan gaye ke is waqt wahi nazil ho rahi hai. Jab utar chuki to aap (ﷺ) ne Hazrat Hilal (R.A) ki taraf dekh kar farmaya, "Ae Hilal (R.A)! Khush ho jao, Allah Ta'ala ne tumhare liye kushadgi aur chhutti nazil farma di." Hazrat Hilal (R.A) kehne lage, Alhamdulillah! Mujhe Allah Raheem ki zaat se yahi umeed thi. Phir aap ne Hazrat Hilal (R.A) ki biwi ko bulwaya aur un dono ke samne aayat-e-mula'ana parh kar sunayi aur farmaya, "Dekho aakhirat ka azab duniya ke azab se sakht hai." Hilal (R.A) farmane lage, Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ)! Main bilkul sacha hoon. Us aurat ne kaha, Huzoor (ﷺ)! Yeh jhoot keh raha hai. Aap ne hukum diya ke acha li'an karo. To Hilal (R.A) ko kaha gaya ke is tarah chaar qasmein khao aur paanchvi dafa yun kaho. Hazrat Hilal (R.A) jab chaar baar keh chuke aur paanchvi baar ki naubat aayi to aap se kaha gaya ke, "Hilal! Allah se dar ja. Duniya ki saza aakhirat ke azabon se bahut halki hai, yeh paanchvi baar teri zaban se nikalte hi tujh par azab wajib ho jaye ga." To aap ne kaha, Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ)! Qasam Allah ki, jis tarah Allah ne mujhe duniya ki saza se meri sadaqat ki wajah se bachaya, isi tarah aakhirat ke azab se bhi meri sachayi ki wajah se mera Rab mujhe mehfooz rakhe ga. Phir paanchvi dafa ke alfaaz bhi zaban se ada kar diye. Ab us aurat se kaha gaya ke tu chaar dafa qasmein kha ke yeh jhoota hai. Jab woh charon qasmein kha chuki to Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne use paanchvi dafa ke is kalma ke kehne se roka aur jis tarah Hazrat Hilal (R.A) ko samjhaya gaya tha, us se bhi farmaya. To use kuch khayal paida ho gaya. Ruki, jhujhki, zaban ko sambhala, qareeb tha ke apne qusoor ka iqrar kar le lekin phir kehne lagi, "Main hamesha ke liye apni qaum ko ruswa nahin karne ki." Phir keh diya ke agar iska khawand sacha ho to is par Allah ka gazab nazil ho. Pas Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ) ne un dono mein judayi kara di aur hukum de diya ke is se jo aulad ho woh Hazrat Hilal (R.A) ki taraf mansoob na ki jaye. Na use haram ki aulad kaha jaye. Jo is bache ko harami kahe ya us aurat par tohmat rakhe, woh had lagaya jaye ga. Yeh bhi faisla diya ke iska koi naan-o-nafaqa iske khawand par nahin kyunke judayi kar di gayi hai.

Na talaq hui hai na khawand ka inteqal hua hai aur farmaya dekho agar yeh bacha surkh safaid rang moti pindliyon wala paida ho to to isay Hilal ka samajhna aur agar woh patli pindliyon wala siyahi mail rang ka paida ho to us shakhs ka samajhna jis ke sath is par ilzam qaim kiya gaya hai. Jab bacha hua to logon ne dekha ke woh is buri sifat par tha jo ilzam ki haqaniyat ki nishani thi. Is waqt Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya agar yeh masla qasmon par tay shuda na hota to main is aurat ko qatan had lagata. Yeh sahibzaday baray ho kar Misr ke wali banay aur un ki nisbat un ki maa ki taraf thi. (Abu Dawood) Is hadith ke aur bhi bohat se shahid hain. Bukhari Sharif mein bhi yeh hadith hai. Is mein hai ke Shareek bin Sahma ke sath tohmat lagayi gayi thi. Aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samnay jab Hazrat Hilal (R.A) ne zikr kiya to aap ne farmaya gawah pesh karo warna tumhari peeth par had lagay gi. Hazrat Hilal (R.A) ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ek shakhs apni biwi ko buray kaam par dekh kar gawah dhoondnay jaye? Lekin An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yahi farmatay rahay. Is mein yeh bhi hai ke dono ke samnay aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh bhi farmaya ke Allah khoob janta hai ke tum dono mein se ek zaroor jhoota hai. Kya tum mein se koi tauba kar ke apne jhoot se hat-ta hai? Aur riwayat mein hai ke panchwin dafa aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne kisi se kaha ke is ka munh band kar do phir isay nasihat ki. Aur farmaya Allah ki laanat se har cheez halki hai. Isi tarah is aurat ke sath kiya gaya. Saeed bin Jubair (R.H) farmatay hain ke li'an karne walay mard-o-aurat ki nisbat mujh se daryaft kiya gaya ke kya in mein judai kara di jaye? Yeh waqea hai Hazrat Ibn-e-Zubair (R.A) ki imarat ke zamana ka. Mujh se to is ka jawab kuch na ban para to main apne makan se chal kar Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) ki manzil par aaya aur un se yahi masla poocha to aap ne farmaya SubhanAllah sab se pehlay yeh baat falan bin falan ne daryaft ki thi ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) koi shakhs apni aurat ko kisi buray kaam par paye to agar zaban se nikale to bhi bari besharmi ki baat hai aur agar khamosh rahay to bhi bari beghairti ki khamoshi hai. Aap sun kar khamosh ho rahay. Phir woh aaya aur kehnay laga Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) main ne jo sawal janab se kiya tha afsos wahi waqea mere han pesh aaya. Pas Allah Ta'ala ne Surah Noor ki yeh aayatein nazil farmayin. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne dono ko paas bula kar ek ek ko alag alag nasihat ki. Bohat kuch samjhaya lekin har ek ne apna sacha hona zahir kiya phir dono ne aayat ke mutabiq qasmein khayin aur aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne in mein judai kara di. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke sahaba ka ek majma sham ke waqt jumma ke din masjid mein baitha hua tha ke ek Ansari ne kaha jab koi shakhs apni biwi ke sath kisi shakhs ko paye to agar woh isay maar dalay to tum isay maar dalogay aur agar zaban se nikalay ga to tum shahadat majood na honay ki wajah se isi ko koray lagao gay aur agar yeh andher dekh kar khamosh ho kar baitha rahay to yeh bari beghairti aur bari behayayi hai.

Wallah agar main subh tak zinda raha toh An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se is ki babat daryaft karunga. Chunancha us ne inhi lafzon mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se poocha aur dua ki ke ya Allah is ka faisla nazil farma. Pas aayat-e-li'an utri aur sab se pehle yahi shakhs is mein mubtala hua. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Uwaimir (R.A) ne Hazrat Asim bin Adi (R.A) se kaha ke zara jao Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se daryaft toh karo ke agar koi shakhs apni biwi ke sath kisi ko paye toh kya kare? Aisa toh nahin ke woh qatl kare toh use bhi qatl kiya jayega? Chunancha Asim (R.A) ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se daryaft kiya toh Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is sawal se bahut naraz huye. Jab Uwaimir (R.A) Asim (R.A) se mile toh poocha ke kaho tum ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se daryaft kiya? Aur aap ne kya jawab diya? Asim (R.A) ne kaha tum ne mujh se koi achi khidmat nahin li, afsos mere is sawal par Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne aib pakra aur bura mana. Uwaimir (R.A) ne kaha ab agar main ise apne ghar le jaun toh goya main ne is par jhoot tohmat bandhi thi. Pas aap ke hukum se pehle hi is aurat ko juda kar diya. Phir toh li'an karne walon ka yahi tareeqa muqarrar ho gaya. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke yeh aurat hamila thi aur un ke khawand ne is se inkar kiya ke yeh hamal un se hua. Is liye yeh bacha apni maa ki taraf mansoob hota raha, phir mansookh tareeqa yun jaari hua ke yeh apni maa ka waris hoga aur maa is ki waris hogi. Ek mursal aur ghareeb hadith mein hai ke aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Siddiq (R.A) aur Hazrat Umar (R.A) se poocha ke agar tumhare han aisi wardat ho toh kya karoge? Donon ne kaha gardan ura denge. Aise waqt chashm-poshi wahi kar sakte hain jo dayyus hon, is par yeh aayatein utrin. Ek riwayat mein hai ke sab se pehla li'an musalmanon mein Hilal bin Umayyah (R.A) aur un ki biwi ke darmiyan hua tha.

Umm-ul-Momineen Ayesha Siddiqa (R.A) ki pakeezgi ki shahadat is aayat se le kar daswin aayat tak Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa (R.A) ke bare mein nazil hui hain jab ke munafiqeen ne aap par bohtan bandha tha jis par Allah ko ba-sabab qarabat-dari Rasool-ullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ghairat aayi aur yeh aayatein nazil farmayin taake Rasool-ullah (ﷺ) ki aabroo par harf na aaye. In bohtan bazon ki ek ratti thi. Is la'ni kaam mein sab se pesh-pesh Abdullah bin Ubayy bin Salool tha jo tamam munafiqon ka guru ghantal tha. Is be-imaan ne ek ek kaan mein bana-bana kar aur masala charh-charha kar yeh baatein khoob ghar-ghar kar pahunchayi thin. Yahan tak ke ba'az musalmanon ki zaban bhi khulne lagi thi aur yeh che-migoyiyan qareeb-qareeb mahine bhar tak chalti rahin. Yahan tak ke Quran-e-Kareem ki yeh aayatein nazil huin is waqiye ka poora bayan sahih ahadees mein majood hai. Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) farmati hain ke Rasool-ullah (ﷺ) ki aadat-e-mubarak thi ke safar mein jaane ke waqt aap (ﷺ) apni biwiyon ke naam ka qur'a daalte aur jis ka naam nikalta use apne sath le jaate. Chunancha ek ghazwe ke mauqe par mera naam nikla. Main aap ke sath chali, yeh waqiya parde ki aayatein utarne ke baad ka hai. Main apne haudaj mein baithi rehti aur jab qafila kahin utarta to mera haudaj utaar liya jaata. Main isi mein baithi rehti jab qafila chalta yunhi haudaj rakh diya jaata. Hum liye Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ) ke ghazwe se farigh hue, wapas laute, Madine ke qareeb aa gaye raat ko chalne ki aawaz lagayi gayi main qaza-e-hajat ke liye nikli aur lashkar ke parao se door ja kar main ne qaza-e-hajat ki. Phir wapas lauti, lashkar-gah ke qareeb aa kar main ne apne gale ko tatola to haar na paya. Main wapas us ke dhoondne ke liye chali aur talash karti rahi. Yahan yeh hua ke lashkar ne kooch kar diya jo log mera haudaj uthate the unhon ne yeh samajh kar ke main hasb-e-aadat andar hi hoon. Haudaj utha kar oopar rakh diya aur chal pade. Yeh bhi yaad rahe ke us waqt tak auratein na kuch aisa khati peeti thin na woh bhari badan ki bojhal thin. To mere haudaj ke uthane walon ko mere hone na hone ka mutlaq pata na chala. Aur main us waqt awail-e-umar ki to thi hi. Al-gharaz boht der ke baad mujhe mera haar mila jab main yahan pahunchi to kisi aadmi ka naam-o-nishan bhi na tha na koi pukarne wala, na jawab dene wala, main apne nishan ke mutabiq wahin pahunchi, jahan hamara oont bithaya gaya tha aur wahin intezar mein baith gayi taake aap (ﷺ) jab aage chal kar mere na hone ki khabar payenge to mujhe talash karne ke liye yahin aayenge. Mujhe baithe-baithe neend aa gayi. Ittefaq se Hazrat Safwan bin Mu'attal Sulami Zakwani (R.A) jo lashkar ke peeche rahe the aur pichli raat ko chale the, subah ki roshni mein yahan pahunch gaye. Ek sote hue aadmi ko dekh kar khayal aana hi tha. Gaur se dekha to chunke parde ke hukm se pehle mujhe unhon ne dekha hua tha.

Dekhte hi pehchan gaye aur ba-awaz buland unki zaban se Inna lillahi wa inna ilaihi raji'un nikla. Unki awaz sunte hi meri aankh khul gayi aur main apni chadar se apna munh dhanp kar sambhal baithi. Unhone jhat apne oont ko bithaya aur uske hath par apna paon rakha, main uthi aur oont par sawar ho gayi. Unhone oont ko khada kar diya aur bhagate hue le chale. Qasam Allah ki na woh mujhse kuch bole, na maine unse koi kalam kiya, na siwaye Inna lillahi ke maine unke munh se koi kalma suna. Dopehar ke qareeb hum apne qafle se mil gaye. Pas itni si baat ka halak hone walon ne batangad bana liya. Unka sab se bada aur badh-badh kar baatein banane wala Abdullah bin Ubayy bin Salool tha. Madine aate hi main bimar pad gayi aur mahine bhar tak bimari mein ghar hi mein rahi, na maine kuch suna, na kisi ne mujhse kaha jo kuch ghul-ghapara logon mein ho raha tha, main usse mahaz be-khabar thi. Albata mere ji mein yeh khayal baaz auqat guzarta tha ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki mehr-o-mohabbat mein kami ki kya wajah hai? Bimari mein aam taur par jo shafqat Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko mere sath hoti thi us bimari mein woh baat na pati thi. Mujhe ranj toh bahut tha magar koi wajah maloom na thi. Pas An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tashreef late, salam karte aur daryaft farmate tabiyat kaisi hai! Aur koi baat na karte, isse mujhe bada sadma hota magar bohtan bazon ki tohmat se main bilkul ghafil thi. Ab suniye us waqt tak gharon mein pakhane nahin hote the aur Arab ki qadeem aadat ke mutabiq hum log maidan mein qaza-e-hajat ke liye jaya karte the. Auratein umooman raat ko jaya karti thin. Gharon mein pakhane banane se aam taur par nafrat thi. Hasb-e-aadat main, Umm-e-Mistah bint Abi Rahm bin Abdul Muttalib bin Abd-e-Manaf ke sath qaza-e-hajat ke liye chali. Us waqt main bahut hi kamzor ho rahi thi, yeh Umm-e-Mistah mere walid sahab (R.A) ki khala thin, unki walida Sakhr bin Aamir ki ladki thin, unke ladke ka naam Mistah bin Asasa bin Abbad bin Abdul Muttalib tha. Jab hum wapas aane lage toh Hazrat Umm-e-Mistah ka paon chadar ke daman mein uljha aur be-sakhta unke munh se nikal gaya ke Mistah gharat ho. Mujhe bahut bura laga aur maine kaha ke tumne bahut bura kalma bola, tauba karo, tum use gali deti ho, jisne Jang-e-Badr mein shirkat ki. Us waqt Umm-e-Mistah (R.A) ne kaha bhooli bibi aapko kya maloom? Maine kaha kya baat hai? Unhone farmaya woh bhi un logon mein se hai jo aapko badnam karte phirte hain. Mujhe sakht hairat hui, main unke sar ho gayi ke kam az kam mujhse sara waqia toh kaho. Ab unhone bohtan baz logon ki tamam karastaniyan mujhe sunayin. Mere toh hathon ke tote ud gaye, ranj-o-gham ka pahad mujh par toot pada, mare sadme ke main toh aur bimar ho gayi. Bimar toh pehle se hi thi, is khabar ne toh nidhal kar diya, joon-toon karke ghar pahunchi. Ab sirf yeh khayal tha main apne maike jakar aur achi tarah maloom toh kar loon ke kya waqai meri nisbat aisi afwah phailayi gayi hai? Aur kya kya mashhoor kiya ja raha hai?

Itne mein Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mere paas aaye, salam kiya aur daryaft farmaya ke kya haal hai? Main ne kaha agar aap ijazat dein to apne walid sahab ke haan ho aaun. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ijazat de di, main yahan aayi, apni walida se poocha ke amma jaan logon mein kya baatein phail rahi hain? Unhon ne farmaya beti yeh to nihayat mamooli baat hai tum itna apna dil bhari na karo, kisi shakhs ki achi biwi jo usey mehboob ho aur us ki sokanein bhi hon wahan aisi baton ka khada hona to lazmi amr hai. Main ne kaha SubhanAllah kya waqai log meri nisbat aisi afwahein uda rahe hain? Ab to mujhe gham-o-ranj ne is qadar ghera ke bayan se bahar hai. Is waqt se jo rona shuru hua wallah ek dam bhar ke liye mere aansu nahin thamey, main sar daal kar roti rehti. Kiska khana peena, kiska sona baithna, kahan ki baat cheet, gham-o-ranj aur rona hai aur main hoon. Sari raat isi halat mein guzri ke aansu ki ladi na thami din ko bhi yahi haal raha. Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Ali (R.A) ko aur Hazrat Usama bin Zaid (R.A) ko bulwaya, wahi mein der hui, Allah ki taraf se aap ko koi baat maloom na hui thi, is liye aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne in dono hazrat se mashwara kiya ke aap mujhe alag kar dein ya kya? Hazrat Usama (R.A) ne to saaf kaha ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hum aap ki ahl par koi burai nahin jante. Hamare dil in ki iffat, izzat aur sharafat ki gawahi dene ke liye hazir hain. Haan Hazrat Ali (R.A) ne jawab diya ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Allah ki taraf se aap par koi tangi nahin, auratein in ke siwa bhi bahut hain. Agar aap ghar ki khadima se poochein to aap ko sahih waqia maloom ho sakta hai. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne isi waqt ghar ki khadima Hazrat Bareera (R.A) ko bulwaya aur un se farmaya ke Aisha ki koi baat shak-o-shuba wali kabhi bhi dekhi ho to batao. Bareera ne kaha Allah ki qasam jis ne aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko haq ke sath mab'oos farmaya hai main ne in se koi baat kabhi is qisam ki nahin dekhi. Haan sirf yeh baat hai ke kam umri ki wajah se aisa ho jata hai ke kabhi kabhi gundha hua aata yunhi rakha rehta hai aur so jati hain to bakri aa kar kha jati hai, is ke siwa main ne in ka koi qasoor kabhi nahin dekha. Chunke koi suboot is waqia ka na mila is liye isi din Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mimbar par khade hue aur majmay se mukhatib ho kar farmaya kaun hai? Jo mujhe is shakhs ki ezaon se bachaye jis ne mujhe ezaein pohanchate pohanchate ab to meri ghar waliyon mein bhi ezaein pohanchana shuru kar di hain. Wallah main jahan tak janta hoon mujhe apni ghar waliyon mein siwaye bhalai ke koi cheez maloom nahin, jis shakhs ka naam yeh log le rahe hain, meri danist to is ke mutaliq bhi siwaye bhalai ke aur kuch nahin woh mere sath hi ghar mein aata tha. Yeh sunte hi Hazrat Saad bin Mu'az (R.A) khade ho gaye aur farmane lage Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) main majood hoon agar woh qabeela Aus ka shakhs hai to abhi hum us ki gardan tan se alag karte hain aur agar woh hamare Khazraj bhaiyon se hai to bhi aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jo hukum dein hamein is ki tameel mein koi uzr na hoga.

Yeh sun kar Hazrat Sa'ad bin Ubada R.A kharay ho gaye, yeh qabeela-e-Khazraj ke sardar thay. Thay toh yeh baray naik bakht magar Hazrat Sa'ad bin Mu'az R.A se kehne lagay, na toh tu isay qatl kare ga na is ke qatl par tu qadir hai, agar woh tere qabeelay ka hota toh tu is ka qatl kiya jana kabhi pasand na karta. Yeh sun kar Hazrat Usaid bin Huzair R.A kharay ho gaye, yeh Hazrat Sa'ad bin Mu'az R.A ke bhatijay hotay thay, kehne lagay, "Ae Sa'ad bin Ubada! Tum jhoot kehte ho, hum isay zaroor maar dalein ge, aap munafiq aadmi hain ke munafiqon ki taraf-dari kar rahe hain." Ab un ki taraf se un ka qabeela aur un ki taraf se un ka qabeela ek dusre ke muqablay par aa gaya aur qareeb tha ke Aus-o-Khazraj ke yeh dono qabeelay aapas mein lar parein. Huzoor ﷺ ne mimbar par se hi unhein samjhana aur chup karana shuru kiya yahan tak ke dono taraf khamoshi ho gayi. Huzoor ﷺ bhi chupke ho rahe, yeh toh tha wahan ka waqea. Mera haal yeh tha ke yeh sara din bhi ronay mein hi guzra. Mere is ronay ne mere maa baap ke bhi hosh gum kar diye thay, woh samajh baithe thay ke yeh rona mera kaleja phaar de ga. Dono hairat zada maghmoom baithe hue thay aur mujhe ronay ke siwa aur koi kaam hi na tha. Itne mein Ansar ki ek aurat aayin aur woh bhi mere sath ronay lagi. Hum yunhi baithe hue thay ke achanak Rasool-e-Kareem ﷺ tashreef laye aur salam kar ke mere paas baith gaye. Qasam Allah ki, jab se yeh bohtan-bazi hui thi aaj tak Rasoolullah ﷺ mere paas kabhi nahi baithe thay. Mahina bhar guzar gaya tha ke Huzoor ﷺ ki yahi halat thi. Koi wahi nahi aayi thi ke faisla ho sakay. Aap ne baithte hi awwal toh tashahhud parha, phir 'Amma Ba'ad' farma kar farmaya ke, "Ae Aisha! Teri nisbat mujhe yeh khabar pahunchi hai. Agar tu waqai paak-daman hai toh Allah Ta'ala teri pakeezgi zahir farma de ga aur agar fil-haqeeqat tu kisi gunah mein aalooda ho gayi hai toh Allah Ta'ala se istighfar kar aur tauba kar, banda jab gunah kar ke apne gunah ke iqrar ke sath Allah ki taraf jhukta hai aur us se ma'afi talab karta hai toh Allah Ta'ala usay bakhash deta hai." Aap itna farma kar khamosh ho gaye. Yeh suntay hi mera rona dhona sab jata raha. Aansoo tham gaye yahan tak ke meri aankhon mein aansoo ka ek qatra bhi baqi na raha. Main ne awwal toh apne walid se darkhwast ki ke meri taraf se Rasoolullah ﷺ ko aap hi jawab dijiye, lekin unhon ne farmaya ke, "Wallah! Meri samajh mein nahi aata ke main Huzoor ﷺ ko kya jawab doon?" Ab main ne apni walida ki taraf dekha aur un se kaha ke aap Rasoolullah ﷺ ko jawab dijiye, lekin unhon ne bhi yahi kaha ke main nahi samajh sakti ke main kya jawab doon? Aakhir main ne khud hi jawab dena shuru kiya. Meri umar kuch aisi bari toh na thi aur na mujhe zyada Quran hifz tha. Main ne kaha, "Aap sab ne ek baat suni, isay aap ne dil mein bitha liya aur goya sach samajh liya. Ab agar main kahoon gi ke main is se bilkul bari hoon aur Allah khoob janta hai ke main bilkul be-gunah hoon toh tum abhi maan lo ge."

Meri aur tumhari misaal toh bilkul Hazrat Abu Yusuf A.S ka yeh qaul hai aayat (Fasabrun jameelun wallahul musta'anu ala ma tasifoon) pas sabr hi achha hai jis mein shikayat ka naam hi na ho aur tum jo baatein banate ho un mein Allah hi meri madad kare, itna keh kar main ne karwat pher li aur apne bistar par lait gayi. Allah ki qasam mujhe yaqeen tha ke chunke main paak hoon Allah Ta'ala meri bara'at apne Rasool ﷺ ko zaroor maloom kara dega lekin yeh toh mere guman mein bhi na tha ke mere bare mein Quran ki aayatein nazil hon. Main apne aap ko is se bahut kamtar jaanti thi ke mere bare mein Kalam-e-Ilahi ki aayatein utrein. Haan mujhe zyada se zyada yeh khayal hota tha ke mumkin hai khwab mein Allah Ta'ala Huzoor ﷺ ko meri bara'at dikha de. Wallah abhi toh na Rasool ﷺ apni jagah se hate thay aur na ghar walon mein se koi ghar se bahar nikla tha ke Huzoor ﷺ par wahi nazil honi shuru ho gayi. Aur chehre par wahi aasar zahir hue jo wahi ke waqt hote thay aur peshani se paseene ki paak boondein tapakne lagein. Sakht jaadon mein bhi wahi ke nuzool ki yahi kaifiyat hua karti thi, jab wahi utar chuki toh hum ne dekha ke Huzoor ﷺ ka chehra hansi se shagufta ho raha hai. Sab se pehle aap ne meri taraf dekh kar farmaya Ayesha khush ho jao Allah Ta'ala ne tumhari bara'at nazil farma di. Isi waqt meri walida ne farmaya bachi Huzoor ﷺ ke samne khadi ho jao. Main ne jawab diya ke wallah na toh main aap ke samne khadi hungi aur na siwaye Allah Ta'ala ke aur kisi ki tareef karungi isi ne meri bara'at aur pakeezgi nazil farmayi hai. Pas aayat (Innal ladheena ja'u bil ifki) se le kar das aayaton tak nazil huein. In aayaton ke utarne ke baad aur meri paak damani sabit ho chukne ke baad is shar ke phailane mein Hazrat Mistah bin Asasa R.A bhi shareek thay aur unhein mere walid sahab un ki mohtaji aur un ki qarabat dari ki wajah se hamesha kuch dete rehte thay. Ab unhon ne kaha jab is shakhs ne meri beti par tohmat bandhne mein hissa liya toh ab main is ke sath kuch bhi sulook na karunga. Is par aayat (Wala ya'tali ulul fadli...) nazil hui yani tum mein se jo log buzurgi aur wus'at wale hain, unhein na chahiye ke qarabat daron, maskeenon aur Allah ki rah ke muhajiron se sulook na karne ki qasam kha baithein. Kya tum nahin chahte ke yeh bakhshish wala aur meherbani wala Allah tumhein bakhsh de? Isi waqt is ke jawab mein Siddiq-e-Akbar R.A ne farmaya qasam Allah ki main toh Allah ki bakhshish ka khwahan hoon. Chunancha isi waqt Hazrat Mistah R.A ka wazifa jaari kar diya aur farma diya ke wallah ab umr bhar tak is mein kami ya kotahi na karunga. Mere is waqiye ke bare mein Rasool Allah ﷺ ne Hazrat Zainab bint Jahsh R.A se bhi jo aap ki biwi sahiba thin daryaft farmaya tha. Yahi biwi sahiba thin jo Huzoor ki tamam biwiyon mein mere muqable ki thin lekin yeh apni parhezgari aur deen dari ki wajah se saaf bach gayin aur jawab diya ke Huzoor ﷺ main toh siwaye behtari ke Ayesha R.A ke bare mein aur kuch nahin jaanti.

Main apne kanon ko aur apni nigah ko mehfooz rakhti hoon. Go unhein unki behan Hamna bint-e-Jahsh ne bahut kuch behlawe bhi diye balkay lad padin lekin unhon ne apni zaban se meri burai ka koi kalma nahin nikala. Haan unki behan ne toh zaban khol di aur mere bare mein halak hone walon mein shamil ho gayi. Yeh riwayat Bukhari, Muslim waghera hadith ki bahut si kitabon mein hai. Ek sanad se yeh bhi marwi hai ke Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apne is khutbay mein yeh bhi farmaya tha ke jis shakhs ki taraf mansoob karte hain, woh safar-o-hazar mein mere sath raha, meri adam-e-maujoodgi mein kabhi mere ghar nahin aaya. Is mein hai ke Sa'ad bin Mu'az (R.A) ke muqablay mein jo sahib kharay hue, unhi ke qabeelay mein Umm-e-Mistah thin. Is mein yeh bhi hai ke isi khutbay ke din ke baad raat ko main Umm-e-Mistah ke sath nikli thi. Is mein yeh bhi hai ke ek martaba yeh phislin aur unhon ne apne betay Mistah ko kosa, main ne mana kiya, phir phislin, phir kosa, main ne phir roka. Phir uljhin, phir kosa toh main ne unhein daantna shuru kiya. Is mein hai ke isi waqt se mujhe bukhar chadh aaya. Is mein hai ke meri walida ke ghar pohanchane ke liye mere sath Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek ghulam kar diya tha. Main jab wahan pohanchi toh mere walid oopar ke ghar mein thay, tilawat-e-Quran mein mashghool thay aur walida neeche ke makan mein thin. Mujhe dekhte hi meri walida ne daryaft farmaya! Aaj kaise aana hua? Toh main ne tamam bepta keh sunayi lekin main ne dekha ke unhein yeh baat na koi anokhi baat maloom hui na itna sadma aur ranj hua jis ki tawaqqa mujhe thi. Is mein hai ke main ne walida se poocha kya mere walid sahib ko bhi is ka ilm hai? Unhon ne kaha haan. Main ne kaha aur Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tak bhi yeh baat pohanchi hai? Jawab diya ke haan. Ab toh mujhe phoot phoot kar rona aane laga yahan tak ke meri awaz oopar mere walid sahib ke kaan mein bhi pohanchi, woh jaldi se neeche aaye, daryaft farmaya ke kya baat hai? Meri walida ne kaha ke unhein is tohmat ka ilm ho gaya hai jo un par lagayi gayi hai. Yeh sun kar aur meri halat dekh kar mere walid sahib (R.A) ki ankhon mein bhi ansoo bhar aaye aur mujh se kehne lage beti main tumhein qasam deta hoon ke abhi apne ghar laut jao. Chunancha main wapas chali gayi. Yahan mere peeche ghar ki khadima se bhi meri babat Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne aur logon ki maujoodgi mein daryaft farmaya. Jis par us ne jawab diya ke main Aisha mein koi burai nahin dekhti bajuz is ke ke woh aata gundha hua chhod kar uth khadi hoti hain, be-khabari se so jati hain. Basa auqat aata bakriyan kha jati hain. Balkay use ba'az logon ne bahut daanta daupta bhi ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne sach sach baat jo ho bata de, is par bahut sakhti ki lekin us ne kaha Wallah ek sunar khalis sonay mein jis tarah koi aib kisi tarah tapa tapa kar bhi bata nahin sakta, isi tarah main Siddiqa par koi ungli nahin utha sakti.

Jab us shakhs ko yeh ittila pahunchi jinhein badnaam kiya ja raha tha toh us ne kaha qasam Allah ki main ne toh aaj tak kisi aurat ka baazu kabhi khola hi nahin. Bil-aakhir yeh Allah ki raah mein shaheed hue R.A. Is mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ mere paas Asr ki namaz ke baad tashreef laye thay. Us waqt meri maa aur mere baap mere daayein baayein baithe hue thay. Aur woh Ansariya aurat jo aayi thin woh darwaze par baithi hui thin is mein hai ke jab Huzoor ﷺ ne mujhe nasihat shuru ki aur mujh se haqeeqat-e-haal daryaft ki toh main ne kaha haye kaisi besharmi ki baat hai? Us aurat ka bhi toh khayal nahin? Is mein hai ke main ne bhi Allah ki hamd-o-sana ke baad jawab diya tha. Is mein yeh bhi hai ke main ne us waqt harchand Hazrat Yaqub A.S ka naam talash kiya lekin wallah woh zaban par na chadha, isliye main ne Abu Yusuf keh diya. Is mein hai ke jab Huzoor ﷺ ne wahi ke utarne ke baad mujhe khushkhabri sunayi wallah us waqt mera gham bhara gussa bahut hi badh gaya tha. Main ne apne maa baap se bhi kaha tha ke main is mamle mein tumhari bhi shukr-guzar nahin. Tum sab ne ek baat suni lekin na tum ne inkaar kiya na tumhein zara ghairat aayi. Is mein hai ke is qisse ko zaban par lane wale Hamna bint Jahsh, Mistah, Hassan bin Thabit aur Abdullah bin Ubay munafiq thay. Yeh sab ka sarghana tha aur yahi zyada tar lagata bujhata tha aur hadith mein hai ke mere uzr ki yeh aayatein utarne ke baad Rasool Allah ﷺ ne do mardon aur ek aurat ko tohmat ki had lagayi yani Hassan bin Thabit, Mistah bin Asasa aur Hamna bint Jahsh ko. Ek riwayat mein hai ke jab Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Aisha Siddiqa R.A ko apne upar tohmat lagne ka ilm hua aur yeh bhi pata chala ke is ka ilm aap ke walid aur Huzoor ﷺ ko ho chuka hai toh aap behosh ho kar gir padin. Jab zara hosh mein aayin toh sara jism tap raha tha aur zor ka bukhar chadha hua tha aur kaanp rahi thin. Aap ki walida ne usi waqt lihaf odha diya. Aur Rasool Allah ﷺ aaye poocha yeh kya haal hai? Main ne kaha jaade se bukhar chadha hai. Aap ﷺ ne farmaya shayad is khabar ko sun kar yeh haal ho gaya hoga? Jab aap ke uzr ki aayatein utrin aur aap ne inhe sun kar farmaya ke yeh Allah ke fazl se hai na ke aap ke fazl se. Toh Hazrat Siddiq-e-Akbar R.A ne farmaya tum Rasool Allah ﷺ se is tarah kehti ho? Siddiqa R.A ne farmaya haan. Ab aayaton ka matlab suniye jo log jhoot bohtan ghadi hui baat le aaye aur woh hain bhi zyada use tum ae Aal-e-Abi Bakr R.A apne liye bura na samjho balkay anjaam ke lihaz se deen-o-duniya mein woh tumhare liye bhala hai. Duniya mein tumhari sadaqat sabit hogi, aakhirat mein buland maratib milenge. Hazrat Aisha ki baraat Quran-e-Kareem mein nazil hogi, jis ke aas paas bhi baatil nahin aa sakta.

Yahi wajah thi ke jab Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) Amman Sahiba (R.A) ke paas un ke aakhri waqt aaye toh farmane lage, Umm-ul-Momineen aap khush ho jaiye ke aap Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki zauja rahin aur Huzoor (ﷺ) mohabbat se pesh aate rahe aur Huzoor (ﷺ) ne aap ke siwa kisi aur bakirah se nikah nahin kiya aur aap ki bara'at aasman se nazil hui. Ek martaba Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) aur Hazrat Zainab (R.A) apne ausaf-e-hameeda ka zikr karne lagin toh Hazrat Zainab (R.A) ne farmaya mera nikah aasman se utra. Aur Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ne farmaya meri pakeezgi ki shahadat Quran mein aasman se utri jab ke Safwan bin Muattal (R.A) mujhe apni sawari par bitha laye thay. Hazrat Zainab (R.A) ne poocha yeh toh batao jab tum us oont par sawar hui thin toh tum ne kya kalmaat kahe thay? Aap ne farmaya Hasbiyallahu wa ni'mal wakeel, is par woh bol uthin ke tum ne mominon ka kalma kaha tha. Phir farmaya jis jis ne pak daman Siddiqa par tohmat lagayi hai har ek ko bada azab hoga. Aur jis ne is ki ibtida uthayi hai, jo ise idhar udhar phailata raha hai us ke liye sakht tar azab hain. Is se murad Abdullah bin Ubayy bin Salool mal'oon hai. Theek qaul yahi hai go kisi kisi ne kaha ke murad is se Hassan (R.A) hain lekin yeh qaul theek nahin. Chunke yeh qaul bhi hai is liye hum ne ise yahan bayan kar diya warna is ke bayan mein bhi chandan nafa nahin kyunke Hazrat Hassan (R.A) bade buzurg sahaba mein se hain. Un ki bahut si fazilatein aur buzurgiyan ahadees mein maujood hain. Yahi thay jo kafir shairon ki hajv ke sheron ka Allah ke Nabi (ﷺ) ki taraf se jawab dete thay. Inhi se Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya tha ke "Tum kuffar ki muzammat bayan karo, Jibraeel (A.S) tumhare saath hain." Hazrat Masrooq (R.A) ka bayan hai ke main Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ke paas tha ke Hazrat Hassan bin Sabit (R.A) aaye. Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ne unhein izzat ke saath bithaya. Hukm diya ke un ke liye gaddi bicha do, jab woh wapas chale gaye toh main ne kaha ke aap unhein kyun aane deti hain? Un ke aane se kya faida? Allah Ta'ala toh farmata hai ke un mein se jo tohmat ka wali hai us ke liye bada azab hai, toh Umm-ul-Momineen ne farmaya andha hone se bada azab aur kya hoga, yeh nabina ho gaye thay. Toh farmaya shayad yahi azab-e-azeem ho. Phir farmaya tumhein nahin khabar? Yahi toh Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ki taraf se kafiron ke hajv wale ashaar ka jawab dene par muqarrar thay. Ek riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Hassan (R.A) ne us waqt Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ki madh mein sher padha tha ke aap pakdaman, bholi, tamam oochay kamon se, gheebat aur burayi se parhez karne wali hain, toh aap ne farmaya tum toh aise na thay. Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) farmati hain mujhe Hazrat Hassan (R.A) ke sheron se zyada achay ashaar nazar nahin aate aur main jab kabhi in sheron ko padhti hoon toh mere dil mein khayal aata hai ke Hassan jannati hain. Woh Abu Sufyan bin Haris bin Abdul Muttalib ko khitab karke apne sheron mein farmate hain, tu ne Muhammad (ﷺ) ki hajv ki hai, jis ka main jawab deta hoon aur is ka badla Allah Ta'ala se paunga.

Mere baap dada aur meri izzat-e-aabru sab Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par qurban hai, main un sab ko fana karke bhi tumhari bad-zabaniyon ke muqable se hat nahin sakta. Tujh jaisa shakhs jo mere Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke kaf-e-pa ki hamsari bhi nahin kar sakta Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki hajv kare? Yaad rakho ke tum jaise bad Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jaise naik par fida hain. Jab tumne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki hajv ki hai to ab meri zaban se jo tez dhaar aur be-aib talwar se bhi tez hai, bach kar tum kahan jaoge? Umm-ul-Momineen (R.A) se poocha gaya ke kya yeh laghv kalam nahin? Aap (R.A) ne farmaya hargiz nahin, laghv kalam to shairon ki woh bakwas hai jo aurton waghera ke bare mein hoti hai. Aap (R.A) se poocha gaya kya Quran mein nahin ke is tohmat mein bada hissa lene wale ke liye bura azab hai? Farmaya haan lekin kya jo azab unhein hua bada nahin? Aankhein unki jaati rahin, talwar un par uthi, woh to kahiye Hazrat Safwan (R.A) ruk gaye warna ajab nahin ke unki nisbat yeh baat sun kar unhein qatl hi kar daalte.

Akhlaq-o-Adab ki taleem: In aayaton mein Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala mominon ko adab sikhata hai ke unhon ne Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ki shaan mein jo kalmaat munh se nikale woh un ki shayan-e-shaan na thay, balkay unhein chahiye tha ke yeh kalaam suntay hi apni shar'i maa ke sath kam-az-kam woh khayal karte jo apne nafs-on ke sath karte, jabke woh apne aap ko bhi aisay kaam ke laiq na patay toh shaan-e-Umm-ul-Momineen ko is se bohat aala aur bala jantay. Ek waqia bhi bilkul isi tarah ka hua tha. Hazrat Abu Ayyub Khalid bin Zaid Ansari (R.A) se un ki biwi sahiba Umm-e-Ayyub (R.A) ne kaha ke kya aap ne woh bhi suna jo Hazrat Ayesha ki nisbat kaha ja raha hai? Aap ne farmaya haan aur yeh yaqeenan jhoot hai. Umm-e-Ayyub tum hi batao kya tum kabhi aisa kar sakti ho? Unhon ne kaha ke nau'zubillah namumkin. Aap ne farmaya pas Hazrat Ayesha toh tum se kahin afzal aur behtar hain. Pas jab aayatein utrein toh pehle toh bohtan bazon ka zikr hua. Ya'ni Hazrat Hassan (R.A) aur un ke sathiyon ka, phir in aayaton ka zikr hua. Hazrat Abu Ayyub (R.A) aur un ki biwi sahiba ki is baat-cheet ka jo oopar mazkoor hui. Yeh bhi ek qaul hai ke yeh maqoola Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'ab (R.A) ka tha. Al-gharaz mominon ko saaf batin rehna chahiye aur achay khayal karne chahiyein, balkay zaban se bhi aisay waqia ki tardeed aur takzeeb kar deni chahiye. Is liye ke jo kuch waqia guzra us mein shak-shuba ki gunjaish bhi na thi. Umm-ul-Momineen (R.A) khullam-khulla sawari par sawar din diharay bharay lashkar mein pahunchi hain. Khud Rasool Allah (ﷺ) maujood hain, agar Allah na kare khakam-ba-dahan koi bhi aisi baat hoti toh yeh is tarah khulay bandon aam majmay mein na aatay balkay khufiya aur posheeda tor par shamil ho jatay jo kisi ko kanon-kan khabar tak na pahunchay. Pas saaf zahir hai ke bohtan bazon ki zaban ne jo qissa ghara woh mehez jhoot, bohtan aur iftira hai. Jis se unhon ne apne imaan aur apni izzat ko gharat kiya. Phir farmaya ke in bohtan bazon ne jo kuch kaha apni sachai par chaar gawah waqia ke kyun pesh nahin kiye? Aur jabke yeh gawah pesh na kar sakein toh shar'an Allah ke nazdeek woh jhootay hain, fasiq-o-fajir hain.

Farman hai ke ae woh logon jinhon ne Siddiqa (R.A) ki babat apni zabanon ko buri harkat di agar Allah Ta'ala ka fazl-o-karam tum par na hota ke woh duniya mein tumhari tauba ko qubool karle aur aakhirat mein tumhein tumhare iman ki wajah se maaf farma de to jis bohtan mein tum ne apni zabanen hilayin us mein tumhein bada bhari azab hota. Yeh ayat un logon ke haq mein hai jin ke dilon mein iman tha lekin rawadari mein kuch keh gaye thay jaise Hazrat Mistah, Hazrat Hassan, Hazrat Hamna (R.A). Lekin jin ke dil iman se khali thay jo is toofan ke uthane wale thay jaise Abdullah bin Ubay bin Salool waghera munafiqeen yeh log is hukm mein nahin thay. Kyunke na us ke paas iman tha na amal-e-saleh. Yeh bhi yaad rahe ke jis badi par jo wa'eed hai woh usi waqt sabit hoti hai jab tauba na ho aur us ke muqable mein us jaisi ya us se badi neki na ho. Jab ke tum is baat ko phaila rahe thay, is se sun kar us se kahi aur us ne sun kar dusre se kahi. Hazrat Aisha (R.A) ki qirat mein 'idha talaqqawnahu' hai yani jab ke tum is jhoot ki isha'at kar rahe thay. Pehli qirat jamhoor ki hai. Aur yeh qirat un ki hai jinhein is ayat ka zyada ilm tha. Aur tum woh baat zaban se nikalte thay, jis ka tumhein ilm na tha. Tum go is kalam ko halka samajhte rahe, lekin darasal Allah ke nazdeek woh bada bhari kalam tha. Kisi musalman aurat ki nisbat aisi tohmat jurm-e-azeem hai. Phir Allah ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ki zauja-e-mutahhara ke upar aisa kalma, samajh lo ke kitna bada kabira gunah hua? Isi liye Rab ki ghairat apne Nabi (ﷺ) ki wajah se josh mein aayi aur Allah Ta'ala ne wahi nazil farma kar Khatam-ul-Anbiya Sayyid-ul-Mursaleen (ﷺ) ki zauja-e-mutahhara (R.A) ki pakeezgi sabit farmayi. Har Nabi (A.S) ki biwi ko Allah Ta'ala ne is behayai se door rakha hai pas kaise mumkin tha ke tamam nabiyon ki biwiyon se afzal aur un ki sardar. Tamam nabiyon se afzal aur tamam aulad-e-Adam ke sardar Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa (ﷺ) ki biwi is mein aalooda hon. Hasha-o-Kalla. Pas tum go is kalam ko be-waqat samjho lekin haqeeqat is ke bar-aks hai. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke insan ba'az martaba Allah ki narazgi ka koi kalma keh kar guzarta hai, jis ki koi waqat us ke nazdeek nahin hoti lekin us ki wajah se woh jahannam ke itne neeche tabqe mein pahunch jata hai ke jitni neechi zameen aasman se hai balkay us se bhi zyada neecha hota hai.

Farman hai ke ae woh logon jinhon ne Siddiqa (R.A) ki babat apni zabanon ko buri harkat di agar Allah Ta'ala ka fazl-o-karam tum par na hota ke woh duniya mein tumhari tauba ko qubool karle aur aakhirat mein tumhein tumhare iman ki wajah se maaf farma de to jis bohtan mein tum ne apni zabanen hilayin us mein tumhein bada bhari azab hota. Yeh ayat un logon ke haq mein hai jin ke dilon mein iman tha lekin rawadari mein kuch keh gaye thay jaise Hazrat Mistah, Hazrat Hassan, Hazrat Hamna (R.A). Lekin jin ke dil iman se khali thay jo is toofan ke uthane wale thay jaise Abdullah bin Ubay bin Salool waghera munafiqeen yeh log is hukm mein nahin thay. Kyunke na us ke paas iman tha na amal-e-saleh. Yeh bhi yaad rahe ke jis badi par jo wa'eed hai woh usi waqt sabit hoti hai jab tauba na ho aur us ke muqable mein us jaisi ya us se badi neki na ho. Jab ke tum is baat ko phaila rahe thay, is se sun kar us se kahi aur us ne sun kar dusre se kahi. Hazrat Aisha (R.A) ki qirat mein 'idha talaqqawnahu' hai yani jab ke tum is jhoot ki isha'at kar rahe thay. Pehli qirat jamhoor ki hai. Aur yeh qirat un ki hai jinhein is ayat ka zyada ilm tha. Aur tum woh baat zaban se nikalte thay, jis ka tumhein ilm na tha. Tum go is kalam ko halka samajhte rahe, lekin darasal Allah ke nazdeek woh bada bhari kalam tha. Kisi musalman aurat ki nisbat aisi tohmat jurm-e-azeem hai. Phir Allah ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ki zauja-e-mutahhara ke upar aisa kalma, samajh lo ke kitna bada kabira gunah hua? Isi liye Rab ki ghairat apne Nabi (ﷺ) ki wajah se josh mein aayi aur Allah Ta'ala ne wahi nazil farma kar Khatam-ul-Anbiya Sayyid-ul-Mursaleen (ﷺ) ki zauja-e-mutahhara (R.A) ki pakeezgi sabit farmayi. Har Nabi (A.S) ki biwi ko Allah Ta'ala ne is behayai se door rakha hai pas kaise mumkin tha ke tamam nabiyon ki biwiyon se afzal aur un ki sardar. Tamam nabiyon se afzal aur tamam aulad-e-Adam ke sardar Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa (ﷺ) ki biwi is mein aalooda hon. Hasha-o-Kalla. Pas tum go is kalam ko be-waqat samjho lekin haqeeqat is ke bar-aks hai. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke insan ba'az martaba Allah ki narazgi ka koi kalma keh kar guzarta hai, jis ki koi waqat us ke nazdeek nahin hoti lekin us ki wajah se woh jahannam ke itne neeche tabqe mein pahunch jata hai ke jitni neechi zameen aasman se hai balkay us se bhi zyada neecha hota hai.

Pehle tahqeeq karo phir bolo. Pehle toh nek-gumani ka hukum diya. Yahan dusra hukum de raha hai ke bhale logon ki shaan mein koi burai ka kalma baghair tahqeeq hargiz na nikalna chahiye. Bure khayalat, gande ilzamat aur shaitani waswason se door rehna chahiye. Kabhi aise kalmaat zaban se na nikalne chahiyen, go dil mein koi aisa waswasa-e-shaitani paida bhi ho toh zaban qabu mein rakhni chahiye. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne meri ummat ke dilon mein paida hone wale waswason se darguzar farma liya hai, jab tak woh zaban se na kahein ya amal mein na layein (Bukhari-o-Muslim). Tumhein chahiye tha ke aise behuda kalam ko sunte hi keh dete ke hum aisi laghwiyat se apni zaban nahin bigarte. Hum se yeh beadbi nahin ho sakti ke Allah ke Khalil (A.S) aur uske Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki biwi sahiba ki nisbat koi aisi laghwiyat kahein, Allah ki zaat paak hai. Dekho khabardar aayinda kabhi aisi harkat na ho warna imaan ke zabt hone ka andesha hai. Haan agar koi shakhs imaan se hi kora ho toh woh toh beadab, gustakh aur bhale logon ki ahant karne wala hota hi hai. Ahkaam-e-Shari'ah ko Allah Ta'ala tumhare samne khol khol kar bayan farma raha hai. Woh apne bandon ki maslahaton se waqif hai. Uska koi hukum hikmat se khali nahin hota.

Burai ki tashheer na karo, yeh teesri tanbeeh hai ke jo shakhs koi aisi baat sune, usey iska phailana haram hai jo aisi buri khabron ko urate phirte hain. Dunyawi saza yani had bhi lagegi aur ukhrawi saza yani azab-e-jahannam bhi hoga. Allah Ta'ala aalim hai, tum be-ilm ho, pas tumhein Allah ki taraf tamam umoor lautane chahiyein. Hadees-e-Shareef mein hai bandagan-e-Allah ko eeza na do, unhein aar na dilao. Unki khufiya baaton ki toh mein na lage raho. Jo shakhs apne musalman bhai ke ayoob tatolega, Allah uske ayoob ke peeche par jayega aur usey yahan tak ruswa karega ke uske ghar wale bhi usey buri nazar se dekhne lagenge.

Shaitani rahon par mat chalo yani agar Allah ka fazl-o-karam, lutf-o-rahm na hota toh us waqt koi aur hi baat hojati magar usne tauba karne walon ki tauba qabool farma li. Paak hone walon ko bazariya-e-hadd-e-shar'i ke paak kardiya. Shaitani tariqon par shaitani rahon mein na chalo, uski baatein na mano. Woh toh burai ka, badi ka, badkari ka, behayai ka hukm deta hai. Pas tumhein uski baatein manne se parhez karna chahiye. Uske amal se bachna chahiye, uske waswason se door rehna chahiye. Allah ki har nafarmani mein qadam shaitan ki pairwi hai. Ek shakhs ne Hazrat Ibn-e-Mas'ood (R.A) se kaha ke maine falan cheez khane ki qasam kha li hai. Aap ne farmaya yeh shaitan ka behkawa hai, apni qasam ka kaffara de do aur use kha lo. Ek shakhs ne Hazrat Sha'bi se kaha ke maine apne bache ko zibah karne ki nazr mani hai. Aap ne farmaya, yeh shaitani harkat hai, aisa na karo, uske badle ek bhed zibah karo. Abu Rafi (R.A) kehte hain ek martaba mere aur meri biwi ke darmiyan jhagda ho gaya. Woh bigad kar kehne lagin ke ek din woh Yahudiya hai aur ek din Nasraniya hai aur uske tamam ghulam azad hain, agar tu apni biwi ko talaq na de. Main ne aakar Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) se yeh masla daryaft kiya toh aap ne farmaya yeh shaitani harkat hai. Zainab bint-e-Umm-e-Salama jo us waqt sab se zyada deeni samajh rakhne wali aurat thin, unhon ne bhi yahi fatwa diya aur Asim bin Amr ki biwi ne bhi yahi bataya. Phir farmata hai agar Allah ka fazl-o-karam na hota toh tum mein se ek bhi apne aap ko shirk-o-kufr, burai aur badi se na bacha sakta. Yeh Rabb ka ehsan hai ke woh tumhein tauba ki taufiq deta hai phir tum par meherbani se ruju karta hai aur tumhein paak saaf bana deta hai. Allah jise chahe paak karta hai aur jise chahe halakat ke gadhe mein dhakel deta hai. Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ki baatein sunne wala, unke ahwal ko janne wala hai. Hidayat yaab aur gumrah sab uski nigah mein hain aur is mein bhi us Hakeem-e-Mutlaq ki be-payan hikmat hai.

Daulat-mand afraad se khitab: Tum mein se jo kushada rozi wale, sahib-e-maqdarat hain, sadaqa aur ehsan karne wale hain, unhein is baat ki qasam na khani chahiye ke woh apne qarabat-daron, maskeenon, muhajiron ko kuch denge hi nahin. Is tarah unhein mutawaja farma kar phir aur narm karne ke liye farmaya ke un ki taraf se koi qasoor bhi sarzad ho gaya ho to unhein maaf kar dena chahiye. Un se koi eeza ya burai pahunchi ho to un se darguzar kar lena chahiye. Yeh bhi Allah Ta'ala ka hukm-o-karam aur lutf-o-rahm hai ke woh apne nek bandon ko bhalai ka hi hukm deta hai. Yeh aayat Hazrat Siddiq (R.A) ke bare mein utri hai jab ke aap ne Hazrat Mistah bin Asasa (R.A) ke sath kisi qisam ka sulook karne ki qasam kha li thi kyunke bohtan-e-Siddiqa mein yeh bhi shamil thay. Jaise ke pehle ki aayaton ki tafsir mein yeh waqia guzar chuka hai to jab haqeeqat Allah Ta'ala ne zahir kar di, Umm-ul-Momineen bari ho gayin, musalmanon ke dilon mein roshni ho gayi, mominon ki tauba qabool ho gayi, tohmat rakhne walon mein se baaz ko had-e-shar'i lag chuki. To Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Siddiq (R.A) ko Hazrat Mistah ki taraf mutawaja farmaya jo aap ki khala sahiba ke farzand thay aur maskeen shakhs thay. Hazrat Siddiq (R.A) hi un ki parwarish karte rehte thay, yeh muhajir thay lekin is bare mein ittefaqiya zaban khul gayi thi. Unhein tohmat ki had lagayi gayi thi. Hazrat Siddiq (R.A) ki sakhawat mashhoor thi. Kya apne kya ghair sab ke sath aap ka husn-e-sulook aam tha. Aayat ke yeh khusoosi alfaaz Hazrat Siddiq (R.A) ke kaan mein pade ke kya tum bakhshish-e-Ilahi ke talib nahin ho? Aap ki zaban se besakhta nikal gaya ke haan qasam hai Allah ki hamari to ain chahat hai ke Allah hamein bakhshe aur usi waqt se Mistah ko jo kuch diya karte thay, jaari kar diya. Goya in aayaton mein hamein talqeen hui ke jis tarah hum chahte hain ke hamari taqseerein maaf ho jayin, hamein chahiye ke dusron ki taqseeron se bhi darguzar kar liya karein. Yeh bhi khayal mein rahe ke jis tarah aap ne pehle yeh farmaya tha ke wallah main is ke sath kabhi bhi sulook na karunga, ab ahd kiya ke wallah main is se kabhi bhi is ka muqarrara rozina na rokunga. Sach hai Siddiq Siddiq hi thay (R.A).

Umm-ul-Momineen Ayesha Siddiqa R.A ke gustakh par Allah ki laanat, jabke aam musalman aurton par toofan uthane walon ki saza yeh hai to Anbiya ki biwiyon par jo musalmanon ki maayen hain, bohtan bandhne walon ki saza kya hogi? Aur khusoosan us biwi par jo Siddiq-e-Akbar R.A ki sahibzadi thin R.A. Ulama-e-Kiram ka is par ijma hai ke in aayaton ke nuzool ke baad bhi jo shakhs Umm-ul-Momineen ko is ilzaam se yaad kare, woh kafir hai kyunke usne Quran-e-Pak ke khilaf kiya. Aap ki aur azwaj-e-mutahharat ke bare mein sahih qaul yahi hai ke woh bhi misl-e-Siddiqa ke hain. Wallahu A'lam. Farmata hai ke aise moozi bohtan pardaz duniya aur aakhirat mein laanat-e-Allah ke mustahiq hain. Jaise aur aayat mein hai (Innal-lazina yu'zoonallaha wa rasulahu la'anahumullahu fid-dunya wal-akhirati wa a'adda lahum 'azaban muhina) (Surah (Al-Ahzab: 57), yani jo log Allah aur uske Rasool ﷺ ko eeza dete hain un par duniya aur aakhirat mein Allah ki phitkar hai aur unke liye ruswa karne wale azab tayyar hain. Baaz logon ka qaul hai ke yeh Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Ayesha R.A ke sath makhsoos hai. Ibn Abbas R.A yahi farmate hain. Saeed bin Jubair, Muqatil bin Hayyan ka bhi yahi qaul hai. Ibn Jarir R.H ne bhi Hazrat Ayesha R.A se yeh naqal kiya hai lekin phir jo tafseel-war riwayat laye hain us mein aap par tohmat lagne, Huzoor ﷺ par wahi aane aur is aayat ke nazil hone ka zikr hai lekin aap ke sath is hukm ke makhsoos hone ka zikr nahin. Pas sabab-e-nuzool go khas ho lekin hukm aam rehta hai. Mumkin hai Ibn Abbas R.A waghera ke qaul ka bhi yahi matlab ho. Wallahu A'lam. Baaz buzurg farmate hain ke kul azwaj-e-mutahharat ka to yeh hukm hai lekin aur momina aurton ka yeh hukm nahin. Ibn Abbas R.A se marwi hai ke is aayat se to murad Huzoor ﷺ ki biwiyan hain ke ahl-e-nifaq jo is tohmat mein the, sab randa-e-dargah hue. La'nati thehre aur ghazab-e-Allah ke mustahiq ban gaye. Iske baad aam momina aurton par badkari ka bohtan bandhne walon ke hukm mein aayat (Wallazina yarmunal-muhsanati summa lam ya'tu bi-arba'ati shuhada'a fajlidu-hum samani-na jaldatan wa la taqbalu lahum shahadatan abada, wa ula'ika humul-fasiqoon) (Surah (An-Nur: 4), utri pas unhein kode lagenge. Agar unhone tauba ki to tauba to qabool hai lekin gawahi unki hamesha tak ghair-mu'tabar rahegi. Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A ne ek martaba Surah Nur ki tafseer bayan karte hue farmaya ke yeh aayat to Huzoor ﷺ ki biwiyon ke bare mein utri hai. In bohtan bazon ki tauba bhi qabool nahin. Is aayat mein ibham hai. Aur char gawah na la sakne ki aayat aam imandar aurton par tohmat lagane walon ke haq mein hai, unki tauba maqbool hai, yeh sun kar aksar logon ka irada hua ke aap ki peshani choom lein. Kyunke aap ne nihayat hi umda tafseer ki thi. Ibham se murad yeh hai ke har pak daman aurat ki shaan mein hurmat-e-tohmat aam hai. Aur aise sab log mal'oon hain.

Hazrat Abdur Rahman (R.H) farmate hain har ek bohtan baaz is hukm mein shamil hai lekin Hazrat Aisha (R.A) bator-e-aula hain. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) bhi umoom hi ko pasand farmate hain aur yahi sahih bhi hai aur umoom ki ta'eed mein yeh hadith bhi hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain saat gunahon se bacho jo muhlik hain. Poocha gaya woh kya hain? Farmaya Allah ke sath shirk karna, jadoo, kisi ko bila-wajah maar daalna, sood khana, yateem ka maal khana, jihad se bhagna, paak daman bhooli momina par tohmat lagana. (Bukhari, Muslim). Aur hadith mein hai paak daman aurton par zina ki tohmat lagane wale ki sau saal ki nekiyan gharat hain. Aaza ki gawahi: Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ka farman hai ke jab mushrikeen dekhenge ke jannat mein siwaye namazon ke aur koi nahin bheja jata to woh kahenge aao hum bhi inkar kar dein chunancha apne shirk ka yeh inkar kar denge. Isi waqt unke munh par mohar lag jayegi aur hath paon gawahi dene lagenge aur Allah se koi baat chupa na sakenge. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain kafiron ke samne jab unki bada'amaliyan pesh ki jayengi to woh inkar kar jayenge aur apni beganahi bayan karne lagenge to kaha jayega yeh hain tumhare padosi yeh tumhare khilaf shahadat de rahe hain. Yeh kahenge yeh sab jhoote hain to kaha jayega ke achha khud tumhare kunbe ke qabile ke log maujood hain. Yeh keh denge yeh bhi jhoote hain to kaha jayega. Achha tum qasmein khao, yeh qasmein kha lenge phir Allah unhein gunga kar dega aur khud unke hath paon unki bada'amaliyon ki gawahi denge. Phir unhein jahannam mein bhej diya jayega. Hazrat Anas (R.A) farmate hain hum Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir thay ke aap hans diye aur farmane lage. Jante ho main kyun hansa? Humne kaha Allah hi janta hai. Aapne farmaya banda qayamat ke din apne Rab se jo hujjat bazi karega us par yeh kahega ke Allah kya tune mujhe zulm se nahin roka tha? Allah farmayega haan. To yeh kahega, bas aaj jo gawah main sacha manoon, usi ki shahadat mere bare mein motabar mani jaye. Aur woh gawah siwa mere aur koi nahin. Allah farmayega, achha yunhi sahi tu hi apna gawah reh. Ab munh par mohar lag jayegi aur aaza se sawal hoga to woh sare aqday khol denge. Us waqt banda kahega, tum gharat ho jao, tumhein barbadi aaye tumhari taraf se hi to main lad jhagad raha tha (Muslim). Qatada (R.H) farmate thay ae Ibn-e-Adam tu khud apni bada'amaliyon ka gawah hai, tere kul jism ke aaza tere khilaf bolenge, unka khayal rakh Allah se poshida aur zahiri mein darta reh. Uske samne koi cheez poshida nahin, andhera uske samne roshni ki manind hai. Chupa hua uske samne khula hua hai. Allah ke sath nek gumani ki halat mein maro. Allah hi ke sath hamari quwwatein hain. Yahan deen se murad hisab hai. Jamhoor ki qirat mein haq ka zabar hai kyunke woh deen ki sifat hai. Mujahid (R.H) ne haq padha hai is bina par ke yeh lughat jaan lenge ke Allah ke wade wa'eed haq hain. Iska hisab adl wala hai zulm se door hai.))

Umm-ul-Momineen Ayesha Siddiqa R.A ke gustakh par Allah ki laanat, jabke aam musalman aurton par toofan uthane walon ki saza yeh hai to Anbiya ki biwiyon par jo musalmanon ki maayen hain, bohtan bandhne walon ki saza kya hogi? Aur khusoosan us biwi par jo Siddiq-e-Akbar R.A ki sahibzadi thin R.A. Ulama-e-Kiram ka is par ijma hai ke in aayaton ke nuzool ke baad bhi jo shakhs Umm-ul-Momineen ko is ilzaam se yaad kare, woh kafir hai kyunke usne Quran-e-Pak ke khilaf kiya. Aap ki aur azwaj-e-mutahharat ke bare mein sahih qaul yahi hai ke woh bhi misl-e-Siddiqa ke hain. Wallahu A'lam. Farmata hai ke aise moozi bohtan pardaz duniya aur aakhirat mein laanat-e-Allah ke mustahiq hain. Jaise aur aayat mein hai (Innal-lazina yu'zoonallaha wa rasulahu la'anahumullahu fid-dunya wal-akhirati wa a'adda lahum 'azaban muhina) (Surah (Al-Ahzab: 57), yani jo log Allah aur uske Rasool ﷺ ko eeza dete hain un par duniya aur aakhirat mein Allah ki phitkar hai aur unke liye ruswa karne wale azab tayyar hain. Baaz logon ka qaul hai ke yeh Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Ayesha R.A ke sath makhsoos hai. Ibn Abbas R.A yahi farmate hain. Saeed bin Jubair, Muqatil bin Hayyan ka bhi yahi qaul hai. Ibn Jarir R.H ne bhi Hazrat Ayesha R.A se yeh naqal kiya hai lekin phir jo tafseel-war riwayat laye hain us mein aap par tohmat lagne, Huzoor ﷺ par wahi aane aur is aayat ke nazil hone ka zikr hai lekin aap ke sath is hukm ke makhsoos hone ka zikr nahin. Pas sabab-e-nuzool go khas ho lekin hukm aam rehta hai. Mumkin hai Ibn Abbas R.A waghera ke qaul ka bhi yahi matlab ho. Wallahu A'lam. Baaz buzurg farmate hain ke kul azwaj-e-mutahharat ka to yeh hukm hai lekin aur momina aurton ka yeh hukm nahin. Ibn Abbas R.A se marwi hai ke is aayat se to murad Huzoor ﷺ ki biwiyan hain ke ahl-e-nifaq jo is tohmat mein the, sab randa-e-dargah hue. La'nati thehre aur ghazab-e-Allah ke mustahiq ban gaye. Iske baad aam momina aurton par badkari ka bohtan bandhne walon ke hukm mein aayat (Wallazina yarmunal-muhsanati summa lam ya'tu bi-arba'ati shuhada'a fajlidu-hum samani-na jaldatan wa la taqbalu lahum shahadatan abada, wa ula'ika humul-fasiqoon) (Surah (An-Nur: 4), utri pas unhein kode lagenge. Agar unhone tauba ki to tauba to qabool hai lekin gawahi unki hamesha tak ghair-mu'tabar rahegi. Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A ne ek martaba Surah Nur ki tafseer bayan karte hue farmaya ke yeh aayat to Huzoor ﷺ ki biwiyon ke bare mein utri hai. In bohtan bazon ki tauba bhi qabool nahin. Is aayat mein ibham hai. Aur char gawah na la sakne ki aayat aam imandar aurton par tohmat lagane walon ke haq mein hai, unki tauba maqbool hai, yeh sun kar aksar logon ka irada hua ke aap ki peshani choom lein. Kyunke aap ne nihayat hi umda tafseer ki thi. Ibham se murad yeh hai ke har pak daman aurat ki shaan mein hurmat-e-tohmat aam hai. Aur aise sab log mal'oon hain.

Hazrat Abdur Rahman (R.H) farmate hain har ek bohtan baaz is hukm mein shamil hai lekin Hazrat Aisha (R.A) bator-e-aula hain. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) bhi umoom hi ko pasand farmate hain aur yahi sahih bhi hai aur umoom ki ta'eed mein yeh hadith bhi hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain saat gunahon se bacho jo muhlik hain. Poocha gaya woh kya hain? Farmaya Allah ke sath shirk karna, jadoo, kisi ko bila-wajah maar daalna, sood khana, yateem ka maal khana, jihad se bhagna, paak daman bhooli momina par tohmat lagana. (Bukhari, Muslim). Aur hadith mein hai paak daman aurton par zina ki tohmat lagane wale ki sau saal ki nekiyan gharat hain. Aaza ki gawahi: Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ka farman hai ke jab mushrikeen dekhenge ke jannat mein siwaye namazon ke aur koi nahin bheja jata to woh kahenge aao hum bhi inkar kar dein chunancha apne shirk ka yeh inkar kar denge. Isi waqt unke munh par mohar lag jayegi aur hath paon gawahi dene lagenge aur Allah se koi baat chupa na sakenge. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain kafiron ke samne jab unki bada'amaliyan pesh ki jayengi to woh inkar kar jayenge aur apni beganahi bayan karne lagenge to kaha jayega yeh hain tumhare padosi yeh tumhare khilaf shahadat de rahe hain. Yeh kahenge yeh sab jhoote hain to kaha jayega ke achha khud tumhare kunbe ke qabile ke log maujood hain. Yeh keh denge yeh bhi jhoote hain to kaha jayega. Achha tum qasmein khao, yeh qasmein kha lenge phir Allah unhein gunga kar dega aur khud unke hath paon unki bada'amaliyon ki gawahi denge. Phir unhein jahannam mein bhej diya jayega. Hazrat Anas (R.A) farmate hain hum Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir thay ke aap hans diye aur farmane lage. Jante ho main kyun hansa? Humne kaha Allah hi janta hai. Aapne farmaya banda qayamat ke din apne Rab se jo hujjat bazi karega us par yeh kahega ke Allah kya tune mujhe zulm se nahin roka tha? Allah farmayega haan. To yeh kahega, bas aaj jo gawah main sacha manoon, usi ki shahadat mere bare mein motabar mani jaye. Aur woh gawah siwa mere aur koi nahin. Allah farmayega, achha yunhi sahi tu hi apna gawah reh. Ab munh par mohar lag jayegi aur aaza se sawal hoga to woh sare aqday khol denge. Us waqt banda kahega, tum gharat ho jao, tumhein barbadi aaye tumhari taraf se hi to main lad jhagad raha tha (Muslim). Qatada (R.H) farmate thay ae Ibn-e-Adam tu khud apni bada'amaliyon ka gawah hai, tere kul jism ke aaza tere khilaf bolenge, unka khayal rakh Allah se poshida aur zahiri mein darta reh. Uske samne koi cheez poshida nahin, andhera uske samne roshni ki manind hai. Chupa hua uske samne khula hua hai. Allah ke sath nek gumani ki halat mein maro. Allah hi ke sath hamari quwwatein hain. Yahan deen se murad hisab hai. Jamhoor ki qirat mein haq ka zabar hai kyunke woh deen ki sifat hai. Mujahid (R.H) ne haq padha hai is bina par ke yeh lughat jaan lenge ke Allah ke wade wa'eed haq hain. Iska hisab adl wala hai zulm se door hai.))

Bhali baat ke haqdar bhale log hi hain. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke aisi buri baat bure logon ke liye hai. Bhali baat ke haqdar bhale log hote hain. Ya'ni Ahl-e-Nifaq ne Siddiqa (R.A) par jo tohmat bandhi aur unki shaan mein jo bad-alfazi ki uske laiq wahi hain isliye ke wahi bad hain aur khabees hain. Siddiqa (R.A) chunke paak hain isliye woh paak kalmon ke laiq hain, woh na-paak bohtan se bari hain. Yeh aayat bhi Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ke bare mein nazil hui hai. Aayat ka saaf matlab yeh hai ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jo har tarah se tayyab hain, namumkin hai ke unke nikah mein Allah kisi aisi aurat ko de jo khabeesa ho. Khabeesa auratein toh khabees mardon ke liye hoti hain. Isliye farmaya ke yeh log un tamam tohmaton se paak hain jo dushmanan-e-Allah bandh rahe hain. Unhein unki bad-kalamiyon se jo ranj-o-eeza pahunchi woh bhi unke liye ba'is-e-maghfirat-e-gunah ban jayegi. Aur yeh chunke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki biwi hain, Jannat-e-Adan mein bhi aap ke sath hi rahengi. Ek martaba Aseer bin Jabir Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) ke paas aakar kehne lage aaj toh main ne Waleed bin Uqba se ek nihayat hi umda baat suni toh Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) ne farmaya theek hai. Momin ke dil mein paak baat utarti hai aur woh uske seene mein aa jati hai phir woh use zaban se bayan karta hai, woh baat chunke bhali hoti hai, bhale sunne wale use apne dil mein bitha lete hain aur isi tarah buri baat bure logon ke dilon se seenon tak aur wahan se zabanon tak aati hai, bure log use sunte hain aur apne dil mein bitha lete hain. Phir aap ne isi aayat ki tilawat farmayi. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hadith hai ke jo shakhs bahut si baatein sune, phir un mein jo sab se kharab ho use bayan kare, uski misaal aisi hai jaise koi shakhs kisi bakriyon wale se ek bakri mange woh use kahe ke ja is rewar mein se tujhe jo pasand ho le le. Yeh jaye aur rewar ke kutte ka kaan pakad kar le jaye aur hadith mein hai hikmat ka kalma momin ki gum-gashta daulat hai jahan se paye le le.
