Aur yeh chunke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki biwi hain, Jannat-e-Adan mein bhi aap ke sath hi rahengi. Ek martaba Aseer bin Jabir Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) ke paas aakar kehne lage aaj toh main ne Waleed bin Uqba se ek nihayat hi umda baat suni toh Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) ne farmaya theek hai. Momin ke dil mein paak baat utarti hai aur woh uske seene mein aa jati hai phir woh use zaban se bayan karta hai, woh baat chunke bhali hoti hai, bhale sunne wale use apne dil mein bitha lete hain aur isi tarah buri baat bure logon ke dilon se seenon tak aur wahan se zabanon tak aati hai, bure log use sunte hain aur apne dil mein bitha lete hain. Phir aap ne isi aayat ki tilawat farmayi. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hadith hai ke jo shakhs bahut si baatein sune, phir un mein jo sab se kharab ho use bayan kare, uski misaal aisi hai jaise koi shakhs kisi bakriyon wale se ek bakri mange woh use kahe ke ja is rewar mein se tujhe jo pasand ho le le. Yeh jaye aur rewar ke kutte ka kaan pakad kar le jaye aur hadith mein hai hikmat ka kalma momin ki gum-gashta daulat hai jahan se paye le le.

Haram cheezon par nigah na daalo. Hukm hota hai ke jin cheezon ka dekhna main ne haram kar diya hai un par nigahein na daalo. Haram cheezon se aankhein neechi kar lo. Agar bilfarz nazar pad jaye toh bhi dobara ya nazar bhar kar na dekho. Sahih Muslim mein hai Hazrat Jareer bin Abdullah Bajli (R.A) ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se achanak nigah pad jaane ki babat poocha toh Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya apni nigah foran hata lo. Neechi nigah karna ya idhar udhar dekhne lag jana Allah ki haram karda cheez ko na dekhna aayat ka maqsood hai. Hazrat Ali (R.A) se Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya, "Ali (R.A) nazar par nazar na jamao, achanak jo pad gayi woh toh maaf hai qasdan maaf nahin." Huzoor (ﷺ) ne ek martaba farmaya, "Raston par baithne se bacho." Logon ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ) kaam kaaj ke liye woh toh zaroori hai. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya, "Acha toh raston ka haq ada karte raho." Unhon ne kaha woh kya? Farmaya, "Neechi nigah rakhna, kisi ko eza na dena, salam ka jawab dena, achi baton ki taleem karna, buri baton se rokna." Aap (ﷺ) farmate hain chhe cheezon ke tum zamin ho jao main tumhare liye jannat ka zamin hota hoon. Baat karte hue jhoot na bolo. Amanat mein khayanat na karo. Wada khilafi na karo. Nazar neechi rakho. Hathon ko zulm se bachaye rakho. Apni sharmgahon ki hifazat karo. Sahih Bukhari mein hai jo shakhs zaban aur sharmgah ko Allah ke farman ke mat-hat rakhe, main us ke liye jannat ka zamin hoon. Ubaida ka qaul hai ke jis cheez ka natija nafarmani-e-Rabb ho, woh kabira gunah hai. Chunke nigah padne ke baad dil mein fasad khada hota hai, is liye sharmgah ko bachane ke liye nazrein neechi rakhne ka farman hua. Nazar bhi Iblees ke teeron mein se ek teer hai. Pas zina se bachna bhi zaroori hai aur nigah neechi rakhna bhi zaroori hai. Huzoor (ﷺ) farmate hain, "Apni sharmgah ki hifazat karo magar apni biwiyon aur londiyon se." Mahramat ko na dekhne se dil paak hota hai aur deen saaf hota hai. Jo log apni nigah haram cheezon par nahin daalte, Allah un ki aankhon mein noor bhar deta hai aur un ke dil bhi noorani kar deta hai. Aap (ﷺ) farmate hain jis ki nazar kisi aurat ke husn-o-jamal par pad jaye phir woh apni nigah hata le, Allah Ta'ala us ke badle ek aisi ibadat use ata farmata hai jis ki lazzat woh apne dil mein pata hai. Is hadith ki sanadein toh zaeef hain magar yeh raghbat dilane ke bare mein hai aur aisi ahadith mein sanad ki itni zyada dekh bhaal nahin hoti. Tabrani mein hai ke ya toh tum apni nigahein neechi rakhoge aur apni sharmgahon ki hifazat karoge aur apne munh seedhe rakhoge ya Allah Ta'ala tumhari soortein badal dega (A'azana Allah min kulli azabihi). Farmate hain, nazar Ibleesi teeron mein se ek teer hai, jo shakhs Allah ke khauf se apni nigah rok rakhe, Allah us ke dil ke bhedon ko janta hai. Huzoor (ﷺ) farmate hain, "Ibn-e-Adam ke zimme us ka zina ka hissa likh diya gaya hai jise woh la-mahalah pa le ga, aankhon ka zina dekhna hai, zaban ka zina bolna hai, kanon ka zina sunna hai, hathon ka zina thamna hai, pairon ka zina chalna hai."

Dil khwahish, tamanna aur aarzoo karta hai. Phir sharmgah toh sab ko saccha kar deti hai ya sab ko jhoota bana deti hai. (Rawah-ul-Bukhari Ta'liqan). Aksar salaf ladkon ko ghoora-ghari se bhi mana karte thay. Aksar aimma-e-sufiya ne is baare mein bahut kuch sakhti ki hai. Ahl-e-ilm ki jamaat ne is ko mutlaq haram kaha hai aur baaz ne ise kabeera gunah farmaya hai. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain har aankh Qayamat ke din royegi magar woh aankh jo Allah ki haram karda cheezon ke dekhne se band rahe aur woh aankh jo Allah ki raah mein jaagti rahe aur woh aankh jo Allah ke khauf se roye. Go is mein se aansu sirf makkhi ke sar ke barabar hi nikla ho.

Mumina auraton ko takeed: Yahan Allah Ta'ala mumina auraton ko chand hukum deta hai taake unke baghairat mardon ko taskeen ho aur jahiliyat ki buri rasmein nikal jayen. Marwi hai ke Asma bint-e-Murshid (R.A) ka makan Banu Harisa ke mohallay mein tha. Unke paas auratein aati thin aur dastoor ke mutabiq apne pairon ke zevar, seenay aur baal kholay aaya karti thin. Hazrat Asma (R.A) ne kaha yeh kaisi buri baat hai? Is par yeh aayatein utrin. Pas hukum hota hai ke musalman auraton ko bhi apni nigahain neechi rakhni chahiyein. Siwa apne khawand ke kisi ko ba-nazar-e-shahwat na dekhna chahiye. Ajnabi mardon ki taraf toh dekhna hi haram hai khwah shahwat se ho khwah baghair shahwat ke. Abu Dawood aur Tirmidhi mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas Hazrat Umme Salma aur Hazrat Maimoona (R.A) baithi thin ke Ibn-e-Umme Maktoom (R.A) tashreef le aaye. Yeh waqia parday ki aayatein utarne ke baad ka hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne unse farmaya ke parda karlo. Unhone kaha Ya Rasool Allah! Woh toh nabina hain, na hamain dekhenge, na pehchanenge. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya tum toh nabina nahin ho ke usko na dekho? Haan ba'az ulama ne be-shahwat nazar karna haram nahin kaha. Unki daleel woh hadith hai jismein hai ke eid wale din habshi logon ne masjid mein hathiyaron ke kartab shuru kiye aur Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ko Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apne peeche khara karliya, aap dekh hi rahi thin yahan tak ke jee bhar gaya aur thak kar chali gayin. Auraton ko bhi apni ismat ka bachao chahiye, badkari se door rahein, apna aap kisi ko na dikhayen. Ajnabi ghair mardon ke samne apni zeenat ki kisi cheez ko zahir na karein, haan jiska chupana mumkin hi na ho, uski aur baat hai jaise chadar aur oopar ka kapra waghera jinka posheeda rakhna auraton ke liye namumkinat se hai. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke isse murad chehra, pahunchon tak ke hath aur angoothi hai. Lekin hosakta hai ke isse murad yeh ho ke yahi zeenat ke woh mahal hain, jinke zahir karne se shariat ne mumanat kardi hai. Jabke Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) se riwayat hai ke woh apni zeenat zahir na karein yani baaliyan, haar, paon ka zevar waghera. Farmate hain zeenat do tarah ki hai, ek toh woh jise khawand hi dekhe jaise angoothi aur kangan aur doosri zeenat woh jise ghair bhi dekhein jaise oopar ka kapra. Zuhri (R.H) farmate hain ke isi aayat mein jin rishtedaron ka zikr hai unke samne toh kangan, dupatta, baaliyan khul jayen toh haraj nahin lekin aur logon ke samne sirf angoothiyan zahir hojayen toh pakar nahin. Aur riwayat mein angoothiyon ke sath hi pair ke khalkhal ka bhi zikr hai. Hosakta hai ke 'ma zahara minha' ki tafseer Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ne munh aur pahunchon se ki ho. Jaise Abu Dawood mein hai ke Asma bint-e-Abi Bakr (R.A) Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aayin, kapray bareek pehne hue thin toh aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne munh pher liya aur farmaya jab aurat balughat ko pahunch jaye toh siwa iske aur iske yani chehra ke aur pahunchon ke uska koi uzw dikhana theek nahin. Lekin yeh mursal hai.

Khalid bin Duraik (R.H) isay Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) se riwayat karte hain aur un ka Umm-ul-Momineen se mulaqat karna sabit nahin. Wallahu A'lam. Aurton ko chahiye ke apne dupaton se ya aur kapray se bakal maar lein taake seena aur galay ka zevar chupa rahay. Jahiliyat mein is ka bhi riwaj na tha. Auratein apne seenon par kuch nahin dalti thin, basa auqat gardan aur baal, choti, baliyan waghera saaf nazar aati thin. Ek aur aayat mein hai, "Ae Nabi (ﷺ) apni biwiyon se, apni betiyon se aur Musalman aurton se keh dijiye ke apni chadarein apne oopar latka liya karein taake woh pehchan li jayen aur satayi na jayen." Khumur, khimar ki jama hai, khimar kehte hain har us cheez ko jo dhanp le. Chunke dupata sar ko dhanp leta hai is liye isay bhi khimar kehte hain. Pas aurton ko chahiye ke apni orhni se ya kisi aur kapray se apna gala aur seena bhi chupaye rakhein. Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) farmati hain, Allah Ta'ala un aurton par raham farmaye jinhon ne shuru shuru hijrat ki thi ke jab yeh aayat utri unhon ne apni chadaron ko phaad kar dupatay banaye. Baaz ne apne tahmad ke kinaray kaat kar un se sar dhak liya. Ek martaba Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ke paas aurton ne Quraish aurton ki fazeelat bayan karni shuru ki to aap (R.A) ne farmaya, "Un ki fazeelat ki qail main bhi hoon lekin wallah main ne Ansar ki aurton se afzal auratein nahin dekhein, un ke dilon mein jo Kitabullah ki tasdeeq aur us par kamil iman hai, woh beshak qabil-e-qadr hai." Surah Noor ki aayat (Walyadribna bi khumurihin) jab nazil hui aur un ke mardon ne ghar mein ja kar yeh aayat unhein sunayi, usi waqt un aurton ne is par amal kar liya aur subah ki namaz mein woh aaein to sab ke saron par dupatay majood thay, goya dol rakhay hue hain. Is ke baad un mardon ka bayan farmaya jin ke samne aurat ho sakti hai aur baghair banao singhar ke un ke samne sharm-o-haya ke sath aa sakti hai go baaz zahiri zeenat ki cheezon par bhi un ki nazar par jaye. Siwaye khawand ke ke us ke samne to aurat apna poora singhar zeb-e-zeenat karay. Go chacha aur mamoon bhi zi-mahram hain lekin un ka naam yahan is liye nahin liya gaya ke mumkin hai woh apne beton ke samne un ke mahasin bayan karein. Is liye un ke samne baghair dupatay ke na aana chahiye. Phir farmaya tumhari auratein yani Musalman aurton ke samne bhi is zeenat ke izhar mein koi haraj nahin. Ahl-e-Zimma ki aurton ke samne is liye rukhsat nahin di gayi ke bohat mumkin hai woh apne mardon mein un ki khoobsurti aur zeenat ka zikr karein. Go Momin aurton se bhi yeh khauf hai magar shariat ne chunke isay haram qarar diya hai is liye Musalman auratein to aisa na karein gi lekin zimmi kafiron ki aurton ko is se kaun si cheez rok sakti hai? Bukhari Muslim mein hai ke kisi aurat ko jaiz nahin ke dusri aurat se mil kar us ke ausaf apne khawand ke samne is tarah bayan karay ke goya woh usay dekh raha hai.

Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar bin Khattab R.A ne Hazrat Abu Ubaidah R.A ko likha ke mujhe maloom hua hai ke baaz Musalman auratein hammam mein jaati hain, unke saath mushrika auratein bhi hoti hain. Suno kisi Musalman aurat ko halal nahin ke woh apna jism kisi ghair muslima aurat ko dikhaye. Hazrat Mujahid R.H bhi ayat (wa nisa-i-hinna) ki tafsir mein farmate hain murad is se Musalman auratein hain to unke samne woh zeenat zahir kar sakti hai jo apne zi-mehram rishtedaron ke samne zahir kar sakti hai. Yani gala-baliyan aur haar. Pas Musalman aurat ko nange sar kisi mushrika aurat ke samne hona jaiz nahin. Ek riwayat mein hai ke jab Sahaba Bait-ul-Muqaddas pohanche to unki biwiyon ke liye daya Yahudiya aur Nasraniya auratein hi thin. Pas agar yeh sabit ho jaye to mahmool hoga zaroorat par ya un auraton ki zillat par. Phir is mein ghair zaroori jism ka khulna bhi nahin. Wallahu A'lam. Haan mushrika auraton mein jo londiyan bandiyan hon woh is hukm se kharij hain. Baaz kehte hain ghulamon ka bhi yahi hukm hai. Abu Dawood mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ Hazrat Fatima R.A ke paas unhein dene ke liye ek ghulam lekar aaye. Hazrat Fatima R.A use dekh kar apne aap ko apne dupatte mein chupane lagin. Lekin chunke kapda chota tha, sar dhanpti thin to pair khul jaate the aur pair dhanpti thin to sar khul jaata tha. Aan-Hazrat ﷺ ne yeh dekh kar farmaya beti kyun takleef karti ho main to tumhara walid hoon aur yeh tumhara ghulam hai. Ibn-e-Asakir ki riwayat mein hai ke is ghulam ka naam Abdullah bin Mas'adah tha. Yeh Fazari the. Sakht siyah-faam. Hazrat Fatima-tuz-Zahra R.A ne unhein parwarish kar ke azad kar diya tha. Siffeen ki jang mein yeh Hazrat Muawiyah R.A ke saath the aur Hazrat Ali R.A ke bahut mukhalif the. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne auraton se farmaya. Tum mein se jis kisi ka mukatib ghulam ho jis se yeh shart ho gayi ho ke itna rupiya de de to tu azad, phir uske paas itni raqam bhi jama ho gayi ho to chahiye ke us se parda kare phir bayan farmaya ke naukar chakar kaam kaaj karne wale un mardon ke samne jo mardangi nahin rakhte auraton ki khwahish jinhein nahin. Is matlab ke hi woh nahin, unka hukm bhi zi-mehram mardon ka hai yani unke samne bhi apni zeenat ke izhar mein muzaiqa nahin. Yeh woh log hain jo sust ho gaye hain auraton ke kaam ke hi nahin. Lekin woh mukhannas aur hijre jo bad-zaban aur burai ke phailane wale hote hain unka yeh hukm nahin. Jaise ke Bukhari Muslim waghera mein hai ke ek aisa hi shakhs Huzoor ﷺ ke ghar aaya tha chunke use isi ayat ke matehat aap ki azwaj-e-mutahharat ne samjha use mana na kiya tha. Ittefaq se usi waqt Rasool Allah ﷺ aa gaye, us waqt woh Hazrat Umme Salma R.A ke bhai Abdullah se keh raha tha ke Allah Ta'ala jab Taif ko fath karaye ga to main tujhe Ghailan ki ladai dikhaunga ke aate hue uske pet par char shikanen padti hain aur wapas jaate hue aath nazar aati hain. Use sunte hi Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya khabardar aise logon ko hargiz na aane diya karo. Is se parda kar lo.

Chunancha use Madine se nikal diya gaya. Baida mein yeh rehne laga wahan se Jumma ke roz aa jata aur logon se khane peene ko kuch le jata. Chote bachon ke samne hone ki ijazat hai jo ab tak aurton ke makhsoos ausaf se waqif na hon. Aurton par un ki lalchai hui nazrein na padti hon. Haan jab woh is umar ko pahunch jayen ke un mein tameez aa jaye. Aurton ki khubiyan un ki nigahon mein jachne lagen, khubsurat bad-surat ka farq maloom kar len. Phir un se bhi parda hai go woh pure jawan na bhi hue hon. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya logon! Aurton ke paas jane se bacho pucha gaya ke Ya Rasool Allah dewar jeth? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya woh to maut hai. Phir farmaya ke aurtein apne pairon ko zameen par zor zor se maar maar kar na chalein jahiliyat mein aksar aisa hota tha ke woh zor se paon zameen par rakh kar chalti thin taake pair ka zevar baje. Islam ne is se mana farma diya. Pas aurat ko har ek aisi harkat mana hai jis se us ka koi chupa hua singhar khul sake. Pas use ghar se itar aur khushbu laga kar bahar nikalna bhi mamnoo hai. Tirmidhi mein hai ke har aankh zaniya hai. Abu Dawood mein hai ke Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A ko ek aurat khushbu se mehakti hui mili. Aap R.A ne us se pucha kya tu masjid se aa rahi hai? Us ne kaha haan farmaya kya tum ne khushbu lagayi hai? Us ne kaha haan. Aap R.A ne farmaya. Main ne apne Habeeb Abul Qasim ﷺ se suna hai ke jo aurat is masjid mein aane ke liye khushbu lagaye, us ki namaz na-maqbool hai jab ke woh laut kar janabat ki tarah ghusal na kar le. Tirmidhi mein hai ke apni zeenat ko ghair jagah zahir karne wali aurat ki misaal Qayamat ke us andhere jaisi hai jis mein noor na ho. Abu Dawood mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne mardon aurton ko raaste mein mile jule chalte hue dekh kar farmaya aurto! Tum idhar udhar ho jao, tumhein beech raah mein na chalna chahiye. Yeh sun kar aurtein deewar se lag kar chalne lagen yahan tak ke un ke kapde deewaron se ragadte the. Phir farmata hai ke ae momino! Meri baat par amal karo, in nek sifaton ko le lo, jahiliyat ki bad-khaslaton se ruk jao. Puri falah aur najaat aur kamyabi isi ke liye hai jo Allah ka farmanbardar ho, us ke mana karda kamon se ruk jata ho, Allah hi se hum madad chahte hain.

Nikah aur sharm-o-haya ki taleem. Is mein Allah Ta'ala ne bahut se ahkaam bayan farma diye hain, awwalan nikah ka. Ulama ki jamaat ka khayal hai ke jo shakhs nikah ki qudrat rakhta ho us par nikah karna wajib hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka irshad hai ke ae naujawano! Tum mein se jo shakhs nikah ki taqat rakhta ho, use nikah kar lena chahiye. Nikah nazar ko neechi rakhne wala, sharmgah ko bachane wala hai aur jise taqat na ho woh lazmi taur par rozay rakhay, yahi us ke liye khasi hona hai (Bukhari, Muslim). Sunan mein hai aap farmatay hain zyada aulad jin se hone ki umeed ho un se nikah karo taake nasl barhay, mein tumhare sath aur ummaton mein fakhr karne wala hoon. Ek riwayat mein hai yahan tak ke kachay giray huay bachay ki ginti ke sath bhi. Ayami jama hai Ayyim ki. Jauhari kehte hain ahl-e-lughat ke nazdeek be-biwi ka mard aur be-khawand ki aurat ko "Ayyim" kehte hain, khwah woh shadi shuda ho ya ghair shadi shuda ho. Phir mazeed raghbat dilatay huay farmata hai ke agar woh maskeen bhi honge to Allah unhein apne fazl-o-karam se maal-dar bana de ga. Khwah woh azad hon khwah ghulam hon. Siddiq-e-Akbar (R.A) ka qaul hai tum nikah ke baray mein Allah ka hukum mano, woh tum se apna wada pura kare ga. Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) farmatay hain ameeri ko nikah mein talab karo. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmatay hain, teen qisam ke logon ki madad ka Allah ke zimmay haq hai: Nikah karne wala jo haram-kari se bachne ki niyat se nikah karay. Woh likhat likh dene wala ghulam jis ka irada adaigi ka ho. Woh ghazi jo Allah ki rah mein nikla ho (Tirmidhi waghera). Isi ki ta'eed mein woh riwayat hai jis mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne us shakhs ka nikah ek aurat se kara diya, jis ke paas siwaye tehband ke aur kuch na tha yahan tak ke lohay ki angoothi bhi us ke paas se nahin nikli thi. Is faqiri aur muflisi ke bawajood aap ne us ka nikah kar diya aur mehar yeh thehraya ke jo Quran usay yaad hai, apni biwi ko yaad kara de. Yeh isi bina par ke nazrein Allah ke fazl-o-karam par thin ke woh Malik unhein wus'at de ga aur itni rozi pohanchaye ga ke usay aur us ki biwi ko kafalat ho. Ek hadith aksar log warid kiya karte hain ke faqiri mein bhi nikah kiya karo Allah tumhein ghani kar de ga, meri nigah se to yeh hadith nahin guzri. Na kisi qawi sanad se na za'eef sanad se. Aur na hamein aisi la-pata riwayat ke is mazmoon mein koi zaroorat hai kyunke Quran ki is ayat aur un ahadith mein yeh cheez majood hai, falhamdulillah. Phir hukum diya ke jinhein nikah ka maqdoor nahin woh haram-kari se bachein. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmatay hain ae jawan logo! Tum mein se jo nikah ki wus'at rakhte hon, woh nikah kar lein, yeh nigah neechi karne wala, sharmgah ko bachane wala hai aur jise is ki taqat na ho woh apne zimmay rozon ka rakhna zaroori kar le, yahi is ke liye khasi hona hai. Yeh ayat mutlaq hai aur Surah Nisa ki ayat is se khaas hai yani yeh farman ayat (Wa man lam yastati' minkum taulan an yankihal muhsanatil mu'minati) (4:25).

(An-Nisa: 25) Pas laundiyon se nikah karne se sabr karna behtar hai. Is liye ke is surat mein aulad par ghulami ka harf aata hai. Ikrama (R.H) farmate hain ke jo mard kisi aurat ko dekhe aur us ke dilon mein khwahish paida ho use chahiye ke agar us ki biwi maujood ho to us ke paas chala jaye warna Allah ki makhlooq mein nazrein daal aur sabr kare yahan tak ke Allah use ghani kar de. Is ke baad Allah Ta'ala un logon se farmata hai jo ghulamon ke maalik hain ke agar un ke ghulam un se apni azadgi ki babat koi tehreer karni chahein to woh inkar na karein. Ghulam apni kamai se woh maal jama kar ke apne aaqa ko de de ga aur azad ho jaye ga. Aksar ulama farmate hain yeh hukm zaroori nahin, farz-o-wajib nahin balkeh bator-e-istihbab ke aur khair khwahi ke hai. Aaqa ko ikhtiyar hai ke ghulam jab koi hunar janta ho aur woh kahe ke mujh se isi qadar rupiya le lo aur mujhe azad kar do to use ikhtiyar hai khwah is qisam ka ghulam us se apni azadgi ki babat tehreer chahe woh us ki baat ko qabool kar le. Hazrat Umar (R.A) ke zamane mein, Hazrat Anas (R.A) ka ghulam Sireen ne jo maldar tha un se darkhwast ki ke mujh se meri azadi ki kitabat kar lo. Hazrat Anas (R.A) ne inkar kar diya, darbar-e-Farooqi mein muqadma gaya, aap ne Hazrat Anas (R.A) ko hukm diya aur un ke na manne par koday lagwaye aur yahi aayat tilawat farmayi yahan tak ke unhon ne tehreer likhwa di. (Bukhari) Atta (R.H) se dono qaul marwi hain. Imam Shafi (R.H) ka qaul yahi tha lekin naya qaul yeh hai ke wajib nahin. Kyunke hadith mein hai musalman ka maal baghair us ki dili khushi ke halal nahin. Imam Malik (R.H) farmate hain yeh wajib nahin. Main ne nahin suna ke kisi imam ne kisi aaqa ko majboor kiya ho ke woh apne ghulam ki azadgi ki tehreer kar de, Allah ka yeh hukm bator-e-ijazat ke hai na ke bator-e-wujub ke. Yahi qaul Imam Abu Hanifa (R.H) waghera ka hai. Imam Ibn Jarir (R.H) ke nazdeek mukhtar qaul wujub ka hai. Khair se murad amanat dari, sachai, maal aur maal ke hasil karne par qudrat waghera hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain agar tum apne ghulamon mein jo tum se mukatib karna chahein, maal ke kamane ki salahiyat dekho to un ki is khwahish ko poori karo warna nahin kyunke is surat mein woh logon par apna bojh dalein ge yani un se sawal karein ge aur raqam poori karna chahein ge is ke baad farmaya hai ke unhein apne maal mein se kuch do. Yani jo raqam theher chuki hai, us mein se kuch maaf kar do. Chauthai ya tihai ya aadha ya kuch hissa. Yeh matlab bhi bayan kiya gaya hai ke maal-e-zakat se un ki madad karo aaqa bhi aur dusre musalman bhi use maal-e-zakat dein taake woh muqarrar raqam poori kar ke azad ho jaye. Pehle hadith guzar chuki hai ke jin teen qisam ke logon ki madad Allah par barhaq hai un mein se ek yeh bhi hai lekin pehla qaul zyada mashhoor hai.

Hazrat Umar R.H ke ghulam Abu Umayyah ne mukatbah kiya tha jab woh apni raqam ki pehli qist lekar aya toh ap ne farmaya jao apni is raqam mein doosron se bhi madad talab karo us ne jawab diya ke Ameer-ul-Mumineen ap akhri qist tak toh mujhe hi mehnat karne dijiye. Farmaya nahi mujhe dar hai ke kahin Allah ke is farman ko hum chhor na baithein ke unhein Allah ka woh maal do jo us ne tumhein de rakha hai. Pas yeh pehli qistein thien jo Islam mein ada ki gain. Ibn-e-Umar R.H ki aadat thi ke shuru shuru mein ap nah kuch dete the nah maaf farmate the kyunki khayal hota tha ke aisa nah ho akhir mein yeh raqam poori nah kar sake toh mera diya hua mujhe hi wapas a jaye. Han akhri qistein hotin toh jo chahte apni taraf se maaf kar dete. Aik ghareeb marfoo' hadees mein hai ke chouthai chhor do. Lekin sahih yahi hai ke woh Hazrat Ali R.H ka qaul hai. Phir farmata hai ke apni londiyon se zabardasti badkarian nah karao. Jahiliyat ke badtareen tareeqon mein aik tareeqa yeh bhi tha ke woh apni londiyon ko majboor karte the ke woh zina kari karayen aur woh raqam apne malikon ko dein. Islam ne akar is bad rasm ko tora. Manqool hai ke yeh ayat Abdullah bin Ubayy bin Salool munafiq ke bare mein utri hai, woh aisa hi karta tha taake rupiya bhi miley aur londiyon zadon se shan-e-riyasat bhi barhe. Us ki londiyon ka naam Mu'azah tha. Aur riwayat mein hai is ka naam Museekah tha. Aur yeh badkari se inkar karti thi. Jahiliyat mein toh yeh kaam chalta raha yahan tak ke use najayaz aulad bhi hui lekin Islam lane ke baad us ne inkar kar diya, is par us munafiq ne use zad-o-kob kiya. Pas yeh ayat utri. Marwi hai ke Badr ka aik Quraishi qaidi Abdullah bin Ubayy ke pas tha woh chahta tha ke is ki londi se miley, londi wajah-e-Islam ke haram kari se bachti thi. Abdullah ki khwahish thi ke yeh is Quraishi se miley, is liye use majboor karta tha aur marta peetta tha. Pas yeh ayat utri. Aur riwayat mein hai ke yeh sardar munafiqin apni is londi ko apne mehmanon ki khatir tawazo ke liye bhej diya karta tha. Islam ke baad is londi se jab yeh irada kiya gaya toh us ne inkar kar diya aur Hazrat Siddique Akbar R.H se apni yeh museebat bayan ki. Hazrat Siddique R.H ne darbar-e-Muhammadi mein yeh baat pohanchai. Ap ne hukum diya ke is londi ko is ke han nah bhejo. Us ne logon mein ghul machana shuru kiya ke dekho Muhammad ﷺ hamari londiyon ko chheen leta hai is par yeh asmani hukum utra. Aik riwayat mein hai ke Museekah aur Mu'az do londiyan do shakhson ki thin, jo un se badkari karaate the. Islam ke baad Museekah aur us ki maan ne akar Huzoor ﷺ se shikayat ki, is par yeh ayat utri. Yeh jo farmaya gaya hai ke agar woh londiyan pak damni ka irada karein is se yeh matlab nah liya jaye ke agar un ka irada yeh nah ho toh phir koi harj nahi kyunki us waqt waqia yahi tha is liye yun farmaya gaya. Pas aksariyat aur ghalba ke taur par yeh farmaya gaya hai koi qaid aur shart nahi hai.

Is se gharz un ki yeh thi ke maal hasil ho, auladein hon jo londiyan ghulam banein. Hadith mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne pichne lagane ki ujrat, badkari ki ujrat, kahin ki ujrat se mana farma diya. Ek aur riwayat mein hai zina ki kharchi aur pichne lagane wali ki qeemat aur kutte ki qeemat khabeeth hai. Phir farmata hai jo shakhs in londiyon par jabr kare to unhein to Allah bajah un ki majboori bakhsh de ga aur un malikon ko jinhon ne un par dabao zor zabardasti dali thi unhein pakar le ga. Is surat mein yahi gunahgar rahen ge. Balkeh Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood (R.A) ki qirat mein Raheem ke baad aayat (Wa ismuhunna ala man akrahahun) hai. Yani is halat mein jabr aur zabardasti karne walon par gunah hai. Marfoo hadith mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne meri ummat ki khata se, bhool se aur jin kamon par woh majboor kar diye jayen, un par zabardasti ki jaye un se darguzar farma liya hai. In ahkaam ko tafseel-war bayan karne ke baad bayan hota hai ke hum ne apne kalam Quran-e-Kareem ki yeh roshan-o-wazeh aayat tumhare samne bayan farma dein. Agle logon ke waqiat bhi tumhare samne aa chuke ke un ki mukhalifat-e-haq ka anjam kya aur kaisa hua? Woh ek afsana bana diye gaye aur aane walon ke liye ibratnak waqia bana diye gaye ke muttaqi un se ibrat hasil karein aur Allah ki nafarmaniyon se bachein. Hazrat Ali (R.A) farmate thay, Quran mein tumhare ikhtilaf ke faisle majood hain. Tum se pehle zamana ke logon ki khabrein majood hain. Baad mein hone wale umoor ke ahwal ka bayan hai. Yeh mufassal hai bakwas nahin ise jo bhi be-parwahi se chore ga, use Allah barbad kar de ga aur jo is ke siwa dusri kitab mein hidayat talash kare ga use Allah gumrah kar de ga.

Ulama ki jamaat ka khayal hai ke jo shakhs nikah ki qudrat rakhta ho us par nikah karna wajib hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka irshad hai ke ae naujawano! Tum mein se jo shakhs nikah ki taqat rakhta ho, use nikah kar lena chahiye. Nikah nazar ko neechi rakhne wala, sharmgah ko bachane wala hai aur jise taqat na ho woh lazmi taur par rozay rakhay, yahi us ke liye khasi hona hai (Bukhari, Muslim). Phir hukum diya ke jinhein nikah ka maqdoor nahin woh haram-kari se bachein. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmatay hain ae jawan logo! Aur na hamein aisi la-pata riwayat ke is mazmoon mein koi zaroorat hai kyunke Quran ki is ayat aur un ahadith mein yeh cheez majood hai, falhamdulillah. Phir hukum diya ke jinhein nikah ka maqdoor nahin woh haram-kari se bachein. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmatay hain ae jawan logo! Tum mein se jo nikah ki wus'at rakhte hon, woh nikah kar lein, yeh nigah neechi karne wala, sharmgah ko bachane wala hai aur jise is ki taqat na ho woh apne zimmay rozon ka rakhna zaroori kar le, yahi is ke liye khasi hona hai. Yeh ayat mutlaq hai aur Surah Nisa ki ayat is se khaas hai yani yeh farman ayat (Wa man lam yastati' minkum taulan an yankihal muhsanatil mu'minati) (4:25).

(An-Nisa: 25) Pas laundiyon se nikah karne se sabr karna behtar hai. Is liye ke is surat mein aulad par ghulami ka harf aata hai. Ikrama (R.H) farmate hain ke jo mard kisi aurat ko dekhe aur us ke dilon mein khwahish paida ho use chahiye ke agar us ki biwi maujood ho to us ke paas chala jaye warna Allah ki makhlooq mein nazrein daal aur sabr kare yahan tak ke Allah use ghani kar de. Is ke baad Allah Ta'ala un logon se farmata hai jo ghulamon ke maalik hain ke agar un ke ghulam un se apni azadgi ki babat koi tehreer karni chahein to woh inkar na karein. Ghulam apni kamai se woh maal jama kar ke apne aaqa ko de de ga aur azad ho jaye ga. Aksar ulama farmate hain yeh hukm zaroori nahin, farz-o-wajib nahin balkeh bator-e-istihbab ke aur khair khwahi ke hai. Aaqa ko ikhtiyar hai ke ghulam jab koi hunar janta ho aur woh kahe ke mujh se isi qadar rupiya le lo aur mujhe azad kar do to use ikhtiyar hai khwah is qisam ka ghulam us se apni azadgi ki babat tehreer chahe woh us ki baat ko qabool kar le. Hazrat Umar (R.A) ke zamane mein, Hazrat Anas (R.A) ka ghulam Sireen ne jo maldar tha un se darkhwast ki ke mujh se meri azadi ki kitabat kar lo. Hazrat Anas (R.A) ne inkar kar diya, darbar-e-Farooqi mein muqadma gaya, aap ne Hazrat Anas (R.A) ko hukm diya aur un ke na manne par koday lagwaye aur yahi aayat tilawat farmayi yahan tak ke unhon ne tehreer likhwa di. (Bukhari) Atta (R.H) se dono qaul marwi hain. Imam Shafi (R.H) ka qaul yahi tha lekin naya qaul yeh hai ke wajib nahin. Kyunke hadith mein hai musalman ka maal baghair us ki dili khushi ke halal nahin. Imam Malik (R.H) farmate hain yeh wajib nahin. Main ne nahin suna ke kisi imam ne kisi aaqa ko majboor kiya ho ke woh apne ghulam ki azadgi ki tehreer kar de, Allah ka yeh hukm bator-e-ijazat ke hai na ke bator-e-wujub ke. Yahi qaul Imam Abu Hanifa (R.H) waghera ka hai. Imam Ibn Jarir (R.H) ke nazdeek mukhtar qaul wujub ka hai. Khair se murad amanat dari, sachai, maal aur maal ke hasil karne par qudrat waghera hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain agar tum apne ghulamon mein jo tum se mukatib karna chahein, maal ke kamane ki salahiyat dekho to un ki is khwahish ko poori karo warna nahin kyunke is surat mein woh logon par apna bojh dalein ge yani un se sawal karein ge aur raqam poori karna chahein ge is ke baad farmaya hai ke unhein apne maal mein se kuch do. Yani jo raqam theher chuki hai, us mein se kuch maaf kar do. Chauthai ya tihai ya aadha ya kuch hissa. Yeh matlab bhi bayan kiya gaya hai ke maal-e-zakat se un ki madad karo aaqa bhi aur dusre musalman bhi use maal-e-zakat dein taake woh muqarrar raqam poori kar ke azad ho jaye. Pehle hadith guzar chuki hai ke jin teen qisam ke logon ki madad Allah par barhaq hai un mein se ek yeh bhi hai lekin pehla qaul zyada mashhoor hai.

Hazrat Umar R.H ke ghulam Abu Umayyah ne mukatbah kiya tha jab woh apni raqam ki pehli qist lekar aya toh ap ne farmaya jao apni is raqam mein doosron se bhi madad talab karo us ne jawab diya ke Ameer-ul-Mumineen ap akhri qist tak toh mujhe hi mehnat karne dijiye. Farmaya nahi mujhe dar hai ke kahin Allah ke is farman ko hum chhor na baithein ke unhein Allah ka woh maal do jo us ne tumhein de rakha hai. Pas yeh pehli qistein thien jo Islam mein ada ki gain. Ibn-e-Umar R.H ki aadat thi ke shuru shuru mein ap nah kuch dete the nah maaf farmate the kyunki khayal hota tha ke aisa nah ho akhir mein yeh raqam poori nah kar sake toh mera diya hua mujhe hi wapas a jaye. Han akhri qistein hotin toh jo chahte apni taraf se maaf kar dete. Aik ghareeb marfoo' hadees mein hai ke chouthai chhor do. Lekin sahih yahi hai ke woh Hazrat Ali R.H ka qaul hai. Phir farmata hai ke apni londiyon se zabardasti badkarian nah karao. Jahiliyat ke badtareen tareeqon mein aik tareeqa yeh bhi tha ke woh apni londiyon ko majboor karte the ke woh zina kari karayen aur woh raqam apne malikon ko dein. Islam ne akar is bad rasm ko tora. Manqool hai ke yeh ayat Abdullah bin Ubayy bin Salool munafiq ke bare mein utri hai, woh aisa hi karta tha taake rupiya bhi miley aur londiyon zadon se shan-e-riyasat bhi barhe. Us ki londiyon ka naam Mu'azah tha. Aur riwayat mein hai is ka naam Museekah tha. Aur yeh badkari se inkar karti thi. Jahiliyat mein toh yeh kaam chalta raha yahan tak ke use najayaz aulad bhi hui lekin Islam lane ke baad us ne inkar kar diya, is par us munafiq ne use zad-o-kob kiya. Pas yeh ayat utri. Marwi hai ke Badr ka aik Quraishi qaidi Abdullah bin Ubayy ke pas tha woh chahta tha ke is ki londi se miley, londi wajah-e-Islam ke haram kari se bachti thi. Abdullah ki khwahish thi ke yeh is Quraishi se miley, is liye use majboor karta tha aur marta peetta tha. Pas yeh ayat utri. Aur riwayat mein hai ke yeh sardar munafiqin apni is londi ko apne mehmanon ki khatir tawazo ke liye bhej diya karta tha. Islam ke baad is londi se jab yeh irada kiya gaya toh us ne inkar kar diya aur Hazrat Siddique Akbar R.H se apni yeh museebat bayan ki. Hazrat Siddique R.H ne darbar-e-Muhammadi mein yeh baat pohanchai. Ap ne hukum diya ke is londi ko is ke han nah bhejo. Us ne logon mein ghul machana shuru kiya ke dekho Muhammad ﷺ hamari londiyon ko chheen leta hai is par yeh asmani hukum utra. Aik riwayat mein hai ke Museekah aur Mu'az do londiyan do shakhson ki thin, jo un se badkari karaate the. Islam ke baad Museekah aur us ki maan ne akar Huzoor ﷺ se shikayat ki, is par yeh ayat utri. Yeh jo farmaya gaya hai ke agar woh londiyan pak damni ka irada karein is se yeh matlab nah liya jaye ke agar un ka irada yeh nah ho toh phir koi harj nahi kyunki us waqt waqia yahi tha is liye yun farmaya gaya. Pas aksariyat aur ghalba ke taur par yeh farmaya gaya hai koi qaid aur shart nahi hai.

Is se gharz un ki yeh thi ke maal hasil ho, auladein hon jo londiyan ghulam banein. Hadith mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne pichne lagane ki ujrat, badkari ki ujrat, kahin ki ujrat se mana farma diya. Ek aur riwayat mein hai zina ki kharchi aur pichne lagane wali ki qeemat aur kutte ki qeemat khabeeth hai. Phir farmata hai jo shakhs in londiyon par jabr kare to unhein to Allah bajah un ki majboori bakhsh de ga aur un malikon ko jinhon ne un par dabao zor zabardasti dali thi unhein pakar le ga. Is surat mein yahi gunahgar rahen ge. Balkeh Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood (R.A) ki qirat mein Raheem ke baad aayat (Wa ismuhunna ala man akrahahun) hai. Yani is halat mein jabr aur zabardasti karne walon par gunah hai. Marfoo hadith mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne meri ummat ki khata se, bhool se aur jin kamon par woh majboor kar diye jayen, un par zabardasti ki jaye un se darguzar farma liya hai. In ahkaam ko tafseel-war bayan karne ke baad bayan hota hai ke hum ne apne kalam Quran-e-Kareem ki yeh roshan-o-wazeh aayat tumhare samne bayan farma dein. Agle logon ke waqiat bhi tumhare samne aa chuke ke un ki mukhalifat-e-haq ka anjam kya aur kaisa hua? Woh ek afsana bana diye gaye aur aane walon ke liye ibratnak waqia bana diye gaye ke muttaqi un se ibrat hasil karein aur Allah ki nafarmaniyon se bachein. Hazrat Ali (R.A) farmate thay, Quran mein tumhare ikhtilaf ke faisle majood hain. Tum se pehle zamana ke logon ki khabrein majood hain. Baad mein hone wale umoor ke ahwal ka bayan hai. Yeh mufassal hai bakwas nahin ise jo bhi be-parwahi se chore ga, use Allah barbad kar de ga aur jo is ke siwa dusri kitab mein hidayat talash kare ga use Allah gumrah kar de ga.

Mudabbir-e-Kainat Noor hi Noor hai. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain: Allah Haadi hai, aasman walon aur zameen walon ka. Wohi in donon mein suraj, chand aur sitaron ki tadbeer karta hai. Hazrat Anas bin Malik (R.A) farmate hain Allah ka noor hidayat hai. Ibn-e-Jareer isi ko ikhtiyar karte hain. Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'ab (R.A) farmate hain is ke noor ki misaal yani is ka noor rakhne wale momin ki misaal jin ke seene mein imaan-o-Quran hai, is ki misaal Allah Ta'ala ne bayan farmayi hai. Awalan apne noor ka zikr kiya phir momin ki nooraniyat ka ke Allah par imaan rakhne wale ke noor ki misaal, balkeh Hazrat Ubayy (R.A) is ko is tarah parhte thay aayat (Masalu noori man amana bihi). Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ka is tarah parhna bhi marwi hai aayat (Kazalika nooru man amana billah). Baaz ki qira'at mein Allah noor hai yani us ne aasman-o-zameen ko noorani bana diya hai. Suddi (R.H) farmate hain isi ke noor se aasman-o-zameen roshan hain. Seerat-e-Muhammad bin Ishaq mein hai ke jis din Ahl-e-Taif ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko bohat eeza pahunchayi thi aap ne apni dua mein farmaya tha dua (A'uzu bi-noori wajhikal lazi ashraqat lahu-z-zulumaatu wa salaha alaihi amru-d-dunya wal-aakhirati an yahilla bi ghadabuka aw yanzila bi sakhatuka laka-l-utba hatta tarda wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah). Is dua mein hai ke tere chehre ke is noor ki panah mein aa raha hoon jo andheron ko roshan kar deta hai aur jis par dunya-o-aakhirat ki salahiyat mauqoof hai, al-kh. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) raat ko tahajjud ke liye uthte tab yeh farmate ke "Allah tere hi liye hai sab tareef sazawar hai, tu aasman aur zameen aur jo kuch in mein hai sab ka noor hai". Ibn-e-Mas'ood (R.A) farmate hain tumhare Rabb ke yahan raat aur din nahin, us ke chehre ke noor ki wajah se us ke arsh ka noor hai. Noor-e-ha ki zameer ka marja baaz ke nazdeek to lafz-e-Allah hi hai yani Allah ki hidayat jo momin ke dil mein hai is ki misaal yeh hai aur baaz ke nazdeek momin hai jis par siyaq-e-kalam ki dalalat hai yani momin ke dil ke noor ki misaal misl-e-taaq ke hai. Jaise farman hai ke ek shakhs hai jo apne Rabb ki daleel aur sath hi shahadat liye hue hai, pas momin ke dil ki safayi ko balloor ke fanoos se mushabahat di aur phir Quran aur shariat se jo madad use milti rehti hai is ki zaitoon ke us tel se tashbeeh di jo khud saaf shaffaf chamkila aur roshan hai. Pas taaq aur taaq mein chiragh aur woh bhi roshan chiragh. Yahudiyon ne aitraazan kaha tha ke Allah ka noor aasmanon ke paar kaise hota hai? To misaal de kar samjhaya gaya ke jaise fanoos ke sheeshe se roshni. Pas farmaya ke Allah aasman-o-zameen ka noor hai. Mishkat ke ma'ani ghar ke taaq ke hain, yeh misaal Allah ne apni farmanbardari ki di hai aur apni ita'at ko noor farmaya hai phir is ke aur bhi bohat se naam hain. Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain: Habsha ki lughat mein ise taaq kehte hain. Baaz kehte hain aisa taaq jis mein koi aur soorakh waghera na ho. Farmate hain isi mein qandeel rakhi jaati hai. Pehla qaul zyada qawi hai yani qandeel rakhne ki jagah. Chunancha Quran mein bhi hai ke is mein chiragh hai.

Pas Misbah se murad noor hai yani Quran aur Imaan jo Musalman ke dil mein hota hai. Suddi R.H kehte hain chiragh murad hai phir farmaya yeh roshni jis mein bahut hi khubsurti hai, yeh saaf qandeel mein hai, yeh Momin ke dil ki misaal hai. Phir woh qandeel aisi hai jaise moti jaisa chamkila roshan sitara. Is ki dusri qira'at durri aur dara'i bhi hai. Yeh makhooz hai dar se jis ke ma'ani dafa ke hain. Matlab chamakdar aur roshan sitara toot-ta hai us waqt woh bahut roshan hota hai aur jo sitare ghair maroof hain unhein bhi Arab darari kehte hain. Matlab chamakdar aur roshan sitara hai jo khoob zahir ho aur bada ho. Phir us chiragh mein tel bhi mubarak darakht zaitoon ka ho. Zaitoonata ka lafz badal hai ya atf-e-bayan hai. Phir woh zaitoon ka darakht bhi na mashriqi hai ke awwal din se us par dhoop aa jaye. Aur na maghribi hai ke ghuroob-e-suraj se pehle us par se saya hat jaye balkay wast jagah mein hai. Subh se sham tak suraj ki saaf roshni mein rahe. Pas us ka tel bhi bahut saaf, chamakdar aur mo'tadil hota hai. Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain matlab yeh hai ke woh darakht maidan mein hai koi darakht, pahad, ghar ya koi aur cheez usay chupaye hue nahin hai. Is wajah se us darakht ka tel bahut saaf hota hai. Ikrama R.H farmate hain ke subh se sham tak khuli hawa aur saaf dhoop usay pahunchti rehti hai kyunke woh khule maidan mein darmiyan ki jagah hai. Isi wajah se us ka tel bahut paak saaf aur roshan chamakdar hota hai aur usay na mashriqi keh sakte hain na maghribi. Aisa darakht bahut sarsabz aur khula hota hai pas jaise yeh darakht aafton se bacha hua hota hai, isi tarah Momin fitnon se mehfooz hota hai agar kisi fitne ki aazmaish mein padta bhi hai to Allah Ta'ala usay sabit qadam rakhta hai. Pas usay chaar sifatein qudrat de deti hain 001 baat mein sach 002 hukm mein adl 003 bala par sabr 004 ne'mat par shukr phir woh aur tamam insaanon mein aisa hota hai jaise koi zinda jo murdon mein ho. Hasan Basri R.H farmate hain agar yeh darakht duniya mein zameen par hota to zaroor tha ke mashriqi hota ya maghribi lekin yeh to Noor-e-Ilahi ki misaal hai. Ibn Abbas R.A se marwi hai ke yeh misaal hai nek mard ki jo na Yahudi hai na Nasrani. In sab aqwal mein behtareen qaul pehla hai ke woh darmiyana zameen mein hai ke subh se sham tak be-rok hawa aur dhoop pahunchti hai kyunke charon taraf se koi aad nahin to lamahala aise darakht ka tel bahut zyada saaf hoga aur lateef aur chamakdar hoga. Isi liye farmaya ke khud woh tel itna lateef hai ke goya baghair jalaye roshni de. Noor-un-ala-noor hai. Yani Imaan ka noor phir us par nek a'maal ka noor. Khud zaitoon ka tel roshan phir woh jal raha hai aur roshni de raha hai pas usay paanch noor hasil ho jate hain us ka kalaam noor hai us ka amal noor hai. Us ka aana noor us ka jaana noor hai aur us ka aakhri thikana noor hai yani Jannat. Ka'ab R.H se marwi hai ke yeh misaal hai Rasool Allah ﷺ ki ke aap ki nabuwat is qadar zahir hai ke go aap zabani na bhi farmayein taham logon par zahir ho jaye. Jaise yeh zaitoon ke baghair roshan kiye roshan hai.

Toh dono yahan jama hain, ek zaitoon ka, ek aag ka. In ke majmoo'e se roshni hasil hoti hui. Isi tarah noor-e-Quran, noor-e-iman jama ho jate hain aur momin ka dil roshan ho jata hai. Allah Ta'ala jise pasand farmaye, apni hidayat ki raah laga deta hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Allah Ta'ala ne makhlooqat ko ek andhere mein paida kiya phir us din un par apna noor dala, jaise woh noor pahuncha us ne raah payi aur jo mehroom raha woh gumrah hua. Is liye kehta hoon ke qalam Allah ke ilm ke mutabiq chal kar khushk ho gaya. (Musnad waghera). Allah Ta'ala ne momin ke dil ki hidayat ki misaal noor se de kar phir farmaya ke Allah yeh misalein logon ke samajhne ke liye bayan farma raha hai, us ke ilm mein bhi koi is jaisa nahin, woh hidayat-o-zalalat ke har mustahiq ko bakhoobi janta hai. Musnad ki ek hadith mein hai dilon ki chaar qismein hain: ek toh saaf aur roshan, ek ghilaf-dar aur bandha hua, ek ulta aur oondha, ek phira hua ulta seedha. Pehla dil toh momin ka dil hai jo noorani hota hai. Aur doosra dil kafir ka dil hai aur teesra dil munafiq ka dil hai ke us ne jana phir anjaan ho gaya. Pehchan liya phir munkir ho gaya. Chautha dil woh dil hai jis mein iman bhi hai aur nifaq bhi hai. Iman ki misaal toh is mein tarkari ke darakht ki manind hai ke achha pani use barha deta hai aur is mein nifaq ki misaal dar-asal phoore ke hai ke khoon peep use ubhar deti hai. Ab in mein se jo ghalib aa gaya woh is dil par chha jata hai.

Momin ke dil se mumasilat momin ke dil ki aur is mein jo hidayat-o-ilm hai us ki misaal oopar wali aayat mein us roshan charagh se di thi jo sheesha ki handi mein ho aur saaf zaitoon ke roshan tel se jal raha hai. Is liye yahan is ki ibadat ki jati hai aur is ki tauheed bayan ki jati hai. Jin ki nigahbani aur paak saaf rakhne ka aur behuda aqwal-o-afaal se bachane ka hukum Allah ne diya hai. Ibn Abbas (R.A) waghera farmate hain ke 'an turfa' ke ma'ani is mein behudgi na karne ke hain. Qatada (R.H) farmate hain murad is se yahi masajid hain jin ki tameer, aabadi, adab aur pakeezgi ka hukum Allah ne diya hai. Ka'ab (R.H) kaha karte the ke Taurat mein likha hua hai ke zameen par masajid mera ghar hain, jo bhi bawazu mere ghar par meri mulaqat ke liye aayega, main us ki izzat karunga. Har us shakhs par jis se milne ke liye koi us ke ghar aaye haq hai ke woh us ki takreem kare (Tafsir Ibn Abi Hatim). Masajidon ke banane aur un ka adab-o-ehtram karne, unhein khushbudar aur paak saaf rakhne ke bare mein bahut si hadeesain warid hui hain jinhein bihamdillah main ne ek mustaqil kitab mein likha hai, yahan bhi un mein se thodi bahut warid karta hoon, Allah madad kare isi par bharosa aur tawakkul hai. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain jo shakhs Allah Ta'ala ki raza hasil karne ki niyat se masjid banaye Allah Ta'ala us ke liye isi jaisa ghar jannat mein banata hai (Bukhari-o-Muslim). Farmate hain naam Allah ke zikr kiye jaane ke liye jo shakhs masjid banaye Allah us ke liye jannat mein ghar banata hai (Ibn Majah). Huzoor (ﷺ) ne hukum diya ke mohallon mein masajid banayi jayen aur paak saaf aur khushbudar rakhi jayen (Tirmidhi Sharif). Hazrat Umar (R.A) ka farman hai logon ke liye masajid banao jahan unhein jagah mile lekin surkh ya zard rang se bacho taake log fitne mein na padein (Bukhari Sharif). Ek zaeef sanad se marwi hai ke jab tak kisi qoum ne apni masajidon ko teep-taap wala, naqsh-o-nigar aur rang-o-roghan wala na banaya un ke a'maal bure nahin hue (Ibn Majah), is ki sanad zaeef hai. Aap (ﷺ) farmate hain mujhe masajidon ko buland-o-bala aur pukhta banane ka hukum nahin diya gaya. Ibn Abbas (R.A) rawi-e-hadees farmate hain ke tum yaqeenan masajidon ko muzayyan, munaqqash aur rang-dar karoge jaise ke Yahood-o-Nasara ne kiya (Abu Dawood). Farmate hain Qayamat qaim na hogi jab tak ke log masajidon ke bare mein aapas mein ek dusre par fakhr-o-ghuroor na karne lagein (Abu Dawood waghera). Ek shakhs masjid mein apne oont ko dhoondta hua aaya aur kehne laga hai koi jo mujhe mere surkh rang ke oont ka pata de. Aap (ﷺ) ne bad-dua ki ke Allah kare tujhe na mile. Masajid to jis matlab ke liye banayi gayi hain, usi kaam ke liye hain (Muslim). Huzoor (ﷺ) ne masajidon mein khareed-o-farokht, tijarat karne se aur wahan ashaar ke gaye jaane se mana farma diya hai (Ahmad waghera). Farman hai ke jise masjid mein khareed-o-farokht karte hue dekho to kaho ke Allah teri tijarat mein nafa na de aur jab kisi ko gum shuda janwar masjid mein talash karta hua pao to kaho ke Allah kare na mile.

(Tirmidhi) Bohat si baatein masjid ke laiq nahin, masjid ko rasta na banaya jaye, na teer phailaye jayen na kacha gosht laya jaye, na yahan had maari jaye, na yahan baatein aur qissay kahe jayen na isay bazaar banaya jaye (Ibn Majah). Farman hai ke hamari masjidon se apne bachon ko, deewanon ko, khareed-o-farokht ko, ladai jhagray ko aur buland aawaz se bolne ko aur had jaari karne ko aur talwaron ke nangi karne ko roko. In ke darwazon par wuzu waghera ki jagah banao aur jumma ke din inhein khushbu se mehka do (Ibn Majah). Is ki sanad zaeef hai. Baaz ulama ne bila zaroorat ke masjidon ko guzar-gah banana makrooh kaha hai. Ek asar mein hai ke jo shakhs baghair namaz parhay masjid se guzar jaye, farishtay us par ta'ajjub karte hain. Hathiyaron aur teeron se jo mana farmaya yeh is liye ke musalman wahan bakasrat jama hote hain aisa na ho ke kisi ke lag jaye. Isi liye Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka hukum hai ke teer ya neza le kar guzray to usay chahiye ke us ka phal apne hath mein rakhay taake kisi ko eza na pohanchay. Kacha gosht lana is liye mana hai ke khauf hai is mein se khoon na tapkay jaisay ke haiza aurat ko bhi isi wajah se masjid mein aanay ki mumanat kar di gayi hai. Masjid mein had lagana aur qisas lena is liye mana kiya gaya hai ke kahin aisa na ho ke woh shakhs masjid ko najis na kar de. Bazaar banana is liye mana hai ke woh khareed-o-farokht ki jagah hai aur masjid mein yeh dono baatein mana hain. Kyunke masjidein zikr-e-Allah aur namaz ki jagah hain. Jaisay ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne us a'arabi se farmaya tha, jis ne masjid ke goshay mein peshab kar diya tha ke masjidein is liye nahin banein, balkay woh Allah ke zikr aur namaz ki jagah hai. Phir us ke peshab par ek bada dol pani ka bahaane ka hukum diya. Dusri hadith mein hai apne bachon ko apni masjidon se roko is liye ke khel kood hi un ka kaam hai aur masjid mein yeh munasib nahin. Chunancha Farooq-e-Azam (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) jab kisi bachay ko masjid mein khelta hua dekh letay to usay korday se peet-tay aur Isha ki namaz ke baad masjid mein kisi ko na rehnay detay. Deewanon ko bhi masjidon se roka gaya kyunke woh be-aqal hote hain aur logon ke mazaq ka zariya hote hain aur masjid is tamashay ke laiq nahin. Aur yeh bhi hai ke un ki najasat waghera ka khauf hai. Bai-o-Shira se roka gaya kyunke woh zikr-e-Allah se mani hai. Jhagron ki musalahati majlis mun'aqid karne se is liye mana kar diya gaya ke is mein aawazein buland hoti hain aisay alfaaz bhi nikal jatay hain jo aadaab-e-masjid ke khilaf hain. Aksar ulama ka qaul hai ke faislay masjid mein na kiye jayen isi liye is jumlay ke baad buland aawaz se mana farmaya. Saib bin Yazeed Kundi (Rahimahullah / R.H) farmatay hain "Main masjid mein khada tha ke achanak mujh par kisi ne kankar phenka, main ne dekha to woh Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) thay mujh se farmanay lagay, jao in dono shakhson ko mere paas lao, jab main aap ke paas inhein laya to aap ne un se daryaft farmaya. Tum kaun ho? Ya poocha ke "Tum kahan ke ho"? Unhon ne kaha "Hum Taif ke rehnay walay hain".

Aap ne farmaya "Agar tum yahan rehne wale hote toh main tumhein sakht saza deta, tum Masjid-e-Nabvi mein oonchi oonchi awazon se bol rahe ho?" (Bukhari). Ek shakhs ki oonchi awaz sun kar Janab-e-Farooq-e-Azam (R.A) ne farmaya tha: "Janta bhi hai tu kahan hai?" (Nasa'i). Aur masjid ke darwazon par wuzu karne wale aur pakeezgi hasil karne ki jagah banane ka hukum diya. Masjid-e-Nabvi ke qareeb hi kunwein thay jin mein se pani khench kar peete thay aur wuzu aur pakeezgi hasil karte thay. Aur Jumma ke din ise khushbudar karne ka hukum hua hai kyunke is din log bakasrat jama hote hain. Chunancha Abu Ya'la Mosuli mein hai ke Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) har Jumma ke din Masjid-e-Nabvi ko mehkaya karte thay. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke jamaat ki namaz insaan ki akeli namaz par jo ghar mein ya dukan par padhi jaye, pachees darje zyada sawab rakhti hai, yeh is liye ke jab woh achi tarah se wuzu karke sirf namaz ke irade se chalta hai toh har ek qadam ke uthane par uska ek darja badhta hai aur ek gunah maaf hota hai aur jab namaz padh chukta hai phir jab tak woh apni namaz ki jagah rahe, farishtay us par durood bhejte rehte hain. Kehte hain ke Aye Allah is par apni rahmat nazil farma aur is par raham kar. Aur jab tak jamaat ke intezar mein rahe namaz ka sawab milta rehta hai". Dar Qutni mein hai masjid ke padosi ki namaz masjid ke siwa nahin hoti. Sunan mein hai andheron mein masjid jaane walon ko khushkhabri sunado ke unhein Qayamat ke din poora poora noor milega. Yeh bhi mustahab hai ke masjid mein jaane wala pehle apna dahina qadam rakhe aur yeh dua padhe. Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jab masjid mein aate yeh kehte dua: (A'uzu billahil Azeem wa bi-wajhihil Kareem wa sultanihil Qadeem minash Shaitanir Rajeem). Farman hai ke jab koi shakhs yeh padhta hai Shaitan kehta hai mere shar se yeh tamam din mehfooz ho gaya. Muslim mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman marwi hai ke tum mein se koi masjid mein jaana chahe yeh dua padhe: (Allahum-maftah li abwaba rahmatik) Aye Allah mere liye apni rahmat ke darwaze khol de. Ibn-e-Majah wagaira mein hai ke jab tum mein se koi masjid mein jaye toh Allah ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par salam bheje phir dua (Allahum-maftah li abwaba rahmatik) padhe aur jab masjid se nikle toh Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par salam bhej kar dua (Allahum-ma'simni minash Shaitanir Rajeem) padhe. Tirmidhi wagaira mein hai ke jab aap masjid mein aate toh durood padh kar dua (Allahummaghfirli zunubi waftah li abwaba rahmatik) padhte aur jab masjid se nikalte toh durood ke baad dua (Allahummaghfirli zunubi waftah li abwaba fadlik) padhte. Is hadith ki sanad muttasil nahin. Al-garaz yeh aur in jaisi aur bahut si hadeesein is aayat ke mutaliq hain jo masjid aur ahkam-e-masjid ke sath talluq rakhti hain. Aur aayat mein hai tum har masjid mein apna munh seedha rakho. Aur khuloos ke sath sirf Allah ko pukaro. Ek aur aayat mein hai ke masjidein Allah hi ki hain. Uska naam un mein liya jaye yani Kitabullah ki tilawat ki jaye.

Subh-o-sham wahan us Allah ki tasbeeh bayan karte hain. Aasal jama hai aseel ki, sham ke waqt ko aseel kehte hain. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain jahan kahin Quran mein tasbeeh ka lafz hai wahan murad namaz hai. Pas yahan murad subh ki aur asr ki namaz hai. Pehle pehle yahi do namazein farz hui thin pas wahi yaad dilayi gayin. Ek qirat mein yusabbihu hai aur us qirat par aasal par poora waqf hai aur rijal se phir dusri baat shuru hai goya ke woh mufassir hai fa'il-e-mahzoof ke liye. To goya kaha gaya ke wahan tasbeeh kaun karte hain? To jawab diya gaya ke aise log aur yusabbihu ki qirat par rijal fa'il hai to waqf fa'il ke bayan ke baad chahiye. Kehte hain rijal ishara hai un ke behtareen maqasid aur un ki pak niyaton aur aala kamon ki taraf. Yeh Allah ke gharon ke abad rakhne wale hain. Is ki ibadat ki jaghein un se zeenat pati hain, tauheed aur shukr guzari karne wale hain. Jaise farman hai ayat (Minal mu'mineena rijalun sadaqu ma 'ahadullaha 'alaihi) (Surah (Al-Ahzab: 23), yani mominon mein aise bhi mard hain jinhon ne jo 'ahd Allah Ta'ala se kiye the unhein poore kar dikhaya. Haan aurton ki behtareen masjid ghar ke andar ka kona hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Hazrat Abu Humaid Sa'idi (R.A) ki biwi sahiba (R.A) Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ki khidmat mein hazir huin aur kaha huzoor (ﷺ) main aap ke sath namaz ada karna bahut pasand karti hoon. Aap ne farmaya yeh mujhe bhi maloom hai lekin masla yeh hai ke teri apne ghar ki namaz sehan ki namaz se aur hujre ki namaz ghar ki namaz se aur ghar ki kothri ki namaz hujre ki namaz se afzal hai. Aur mohalle ki masjid se afzal ghar ki namaz hai aur mohalle ki masjid ki namaz meri masjid ki namaz se afzal hai. Yeh sun kar mai sahiba ne apne ghar ke bilkul intehai hisse mein ek jagah ko bator-e-masjid ke muqarrar kar liya aur aakhri ghari tak wahin namaz parhti rahin (R.A). Haan albatta aurton ke liye bhi masjid mein mardon ke sath namaz parhna jaiz zaroor hai. Bashart-e-ke mardon par apni zeenat zahir na hone dein aur na khushbu laga kar niklein. Sahih hadith mein farman-e-Rasool (ﷺ) hai ke Allah ki bandiyon ko Allah ki masjidon se na roko (Bukhari, Muslim waghera). Abu Dawood mein hai ke aurton ke liye un ke ghar afzal hain. Aur hadith mein hai ke woh khushbu istemal kar ke na niklein. Sahih Muslim Shareef mein hai ke aap ne aurton se farmaya jab tum mein se koi masjid aana chahe to khushbu ko hath bhi na lagaye. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke musalman aurtein subh ki namaz mein aati thin phir woh apni chadaron mein lipti hui chali jati thin aur bojah raat ke andhere ki wajah se woh pehchani nahin jati thin. Siddiqa (R.A) farmati hain ke aurton ne yeh jo nayi nayi baatein nikali hain agar Rasool Allah (ﷺ) in baton ko pa lete to unhein masjidon mein aane se rok dete jaise ke Bani Israel ki aurtein rok di gayin. (Bukhari, Muslim). Aise log jinhein khareedo-farokht yaad-e-Ilahi se nahin rokti. Jaise irshad hai iman walo, maal-o-aulad tumhein zikr-e-Allah se ghafil na kar de.

Surah Jumu'ah mein hai ke Jumu'ah ki azan sun kar Zikr-e-Allah ki taraf chal paro aur tijarat chor do. Matlab yeh hai ke in nek logon ko duniya aur mata-e-akhirat aur Zikr-e-Allah se ghafil na kar sakti, unhein akhirat aur akhirat ki nematon par yaqeen-e-kamil hai aur unhein hamesha rehne wala samajhte hain aur yahan ki cheezon ko fani jante hain is liye unhein chor kar is taraf tawajjah karte hain. Allah Ta'ala ki ita'at ko, us ki mohabbat ko, us ke ahkaam ko muqaddam karte hain. Hazrat Ibn-e-Mas'ud (R.A) ne ek martaba tijarat pesha hazraat ko azan sun kar apne kaam kaaj chor kar masjid ki taraf jate hue dekh kar yahi ayat tilawat farmayi aur farmaya yeh log inhi mein se hain. Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) se bhi yahi marwi hai. Abu Darda (R.A) farmate hain ke main saudagari ya tijarat karoon agarche is mein mujhe har din teen sau ashrafiyan milti hon lekin main namazon ke waqt yeh sab chor kar zaroor chala jaunga. Mera matlab yeh hargiz nahin ke tijarat karna haram hai balkeh yeh hai ke hum mein yeh wasf hona chahiye, jo is ayat mein bayan ho raha hai. Salim bin Abdullah namaz ke liye ja rahe the. Dekha ke Madina Sharif ke saudagar apni apni dukanon par kapre dhak kar namaz ke liye gaye hue hain aur koi bhi dukan par majood nahin to yahi ayat parhi aur farmaya yeh inhi mein se hain jin ki tareef Janab-e-Bari ne farmayi hai. Is baat ka salaf mein yahan tak khayal tha ke tarazu uthaye tol rahe hain aur azan kaan mein pari to tarazu rakh di aur masjid ki taraf chal diye. Farz namaz ba-jama'at masjid mein ada karne ka unhein ishq tha. Woh namaz ke auqat ki arkaan aur adab ki hifazat ke sath namazon ke paband the. Yeh is liye ke dilon mein khauf-e-Ilahi tha, Qayamat ka aana bar-haq jante the, us din ki khaufnaki se waqif the ke sakht tar ghabrahat aur kamil pareshani aur be-had uljhan ki wajah se aankhein pathra jayengi, dil ur jayenge, kaleje dehal jayenge. Jaise farman hai ke mere nek bande meri mohabbat ki bina par maskeenon, yateemon aur qaidiyon ko khana khilate hain aur keh dete hain ke hum tumhein mehez Allah ki raza-joi ke liye khila rahe hain, hamara maqsad tum se shukriya talab karne ya badla lene ka nahin. Hamein to apne Parwardigar se us din ka dar hai jab ke log mare ranj-o-gham ke munh basore hue aur tewariyan badle hue honge. Pas Allah hi unhein us din ki museebaton se nijat de ga aur unhein taro-tazgi, bashashat, hansi khushi aur rahat-o-aram se mila de ga. Aur un ke sabr ke badle unhein jannat aur reshmi libas ata farmaye ga. Yahan bhi farmata hai ke un ki nekiyan maqbool hain, buraiyan maaf hain, un ke ek ek amal ka behtareen badla ma' ziyadati aur Allah ke fazl ke unhein zaroor milna hai. Jaise farman hai Allah Ta'ala ba-qadr-e-ek zarre ke bhi zulm nahin karta. Aur ayat mein hai neki das guna kar di jati hai. Aur ayat mein hai jo Allah ko achha qarz de ga, use Allah Ta'ala barha charha kar zyada se zyada kar ke de ga. Farman hai ayat (Yuda'ifu liman yasha'u) (2:261).

(Al-Baqarah: 261) Woh barha deta hai jis ke liye chahey. Yahan farman hai woh jisay chahay be-hisab deta hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Mas'ood (Razi Allahu Anhu) ke paas ek martaba doodh laya gaya, aap ne apni majlis ke sathiyon mein se har ek ko pilana chaha magar sab rozay se thay. Is liye aap hi ke paas phir bartan aaya. Aap ne yahi aayat 'yakh-foon' se parhi aur pee liya. Rasool Allah (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmatay hain Qayamat ke din jab ke awwal-o-aakhir sab jama honge, Allah Ta'ala ek munadi ko hukum de ga jo ba-aawaz-e-buland nida kare ga jisay tamam ahl-e-mahshar sunenge ke aaj sab ko maloom ho jaye ga ke Allah ke haan sab se zyada buzurg kaun hai? Phir farmaye ga woh log kharay ho jayenge jinhein len-den aur tijarat zikr-e-Allah se rokta na tha, pas woh kharay ho jayenge aur woh bohat hi kam honge, sab se pehle unhein hisab se farigh kiya jaye ga. Aap farmatay hain un ki nekiyon ka ajar yani Jannat bhi unhein mile gi aur mazeed fazl-e-Ilahi yeh hoga ke jin logon ne un ke sath ehsan kiye honge aur woh mustahiq-e-shafa'at honge un sab ki shafa'at ka mansab unhein hasil ho jaye ga.)

Momin ke dil se mumasilat momin ke dil ki aur is mein jo hidayat-o-ilm hai us ki misaal oopar wali aayat mein us roshan charagh se di thi jo sheesha ki handi mein ho aur saaf zaitoon ke roshan tel se jal raha hai. Is liye yahan is ki ibadat ki jati hai aur is ki tauheed bayan ki jati hai. Jin ki nigahbani aur paak saaf rakhne ka aur behuda aqwal-o-afaal se bachane ka hukum Allah ne diya hai. Ibn Abbas (R.A) waghera farmate hain ke 'an turfa' ke ma'ani is mein behudgi na karne ke hain. Qatada (R.H) farmate hain murad is se yahi masajid hain jin ki tameer, aabadi, adab aur pakeezgi ka hukum Allah ne diya hai. Ka'ab (R.H) kaha karte the ke Taurat mein likha hua hai ke zameen par masajid mera ghar hain, jo bhi bawazu mere ghar par meri mulaqat ke liye aayega, main us ki izzat karunga. Har us shakhs par jis se milne ke liye koi us ke ghar aaye haq hai ke woh us ki takreem kare (Tafsir Ibn Abi Hatim). Masajidon ke banane aur un ka adab-o-ehtram karne, unhein khushbudar aur paak saaf rakhne ke bare mein bahut si hadeesain warid hui hain jinhein bihamdillah main ne ek mustaqil kitab mein likha hai, yahan bhi un mein se thodi bahut warid karta hoon, Allah madad kare isi par bharosa aur tawakkul hai. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain jo shakhs Allah Ta'ala ki raza hasil karne ki niyat se masjid banaye Allah Ta'ala us ke liye isi jaisa ghar jannat mein banata hai (Bukhari-o-Muslim). Farmate hain naam Allah ke zikr kiye jaane ke liye jo shakhs masjid banaye Allah us ke liye jannat mein ghar banata hai (Ibn Majah). Huzoor (ﷺ) ne hukum diya ke mohallon mein masajid banayi jayen aur paak saaf aur khushbudar rakhi jayen (Tirmidhi Sharif). Hazrat Umar (R.A) ka farman hai logon ke liye masajid banao jahan unhein jagah mile lekin surkh ya zard rang se bacho taake log fitne mein na padein (Bukhari Sharif). Ek zaeef sanad se marwi hai ke jab tak kisi qoum ne apni masajidon ko teep-taap wala, naqsh-o-nigar aur rang-o-roghan wala na banaya un ke a'maal bure nahin hue (Ibn Majah), is ki sanad zaeef hai. Aap (ﷺ) farmate hain mujhe masajidon ko buland-o-bala aur pukhta banane ka hukum nahin diya gaya. Ibn Abbas (R.A) rawi-e-hadees farmate hain ke tum yaqeenan masajidon ko muzayyan, munaqqash aur rang-dar karoge jaise ke Yahood-o-Nasara ne kiya (Abu Dawood). Farmate hain Qayamat qaim na hogi jab tak ke log masajidon ke bare mein aapas mein ek dusre par fakhr-o-ghuroor na karne lagein (Abu Dawood waghera). Ek shakhs masjid mein apne oont ko dhoondta hua aaya aur kehne laga hai koi jo mujhe mere surkh rang ke oont ka pata de. Aap (ﷺ) ne bad-dua ki ke Allah kare tujhe na mile. Masajid to jis matlab ke liye banayi gayi hain, usi kaam ke liye hain (Muslim). Huzoor (ﷺ) ne masajidon mein khareed-o-farokht, tijarat karne se aur wahan ashaar ke gaye jaane se mana farma diya hai (Ahmad waghera). Farman hai ke jise masjid mein khareed-o-farokht karte hue dekho to kaho ke Allah teri tijarat mein nafa na de aur jab kisi ko gum shuda janwar masjid mein talash karta hua pao to kaho ke Allah kare na mile.

Chunancha Abu Ya'la Mosuli mein hai ke Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) har Jumma ke din Masjid-e-Nabvi ko mehkaya karte thay. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke jamaat ki namaz insaan ki akeli namaz par jo ghar mein ya dukan par padhi jaye, pachees darje zyada sawab rakhti hai, yeh is liye ke jab woh achi tarah se wuzu karke sirf namaz ke irade se chalta hai toh har ek qadam ke uthane par uska ek darja badhta hai aur ek gunah maaf hota hai aur jab namaz padh chukta hai phir jab tak woh apni namaz ki jagah rahe, farishtay us par durood bhejte rehte hain. Kehte hain ke Aye Allah is par apni rahmat nazil farma aur is par raham kar. Aur jab tak jamaat ke intezar mein rahe namaz ka sawab milta rehta hai". Dar Qutni mein hai masjid ke padosi ki namaz masjid ke siwa nahin hoti. Sunan mein hai andheron mein masjid jaane walon ko khushkhabri sunado ke unhein Qayamat ke din poora poora noor milega. Yeh bhi mustahab hai ke masjid mein jaane wala pehle apna dahina qadam rakhe aur yeh dua padhe. Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jab masjid mein aate yeh kehte dua: (A'uzu billahil Azeem wa bi-wajhihil Kareem wa sultanihil Qadeem minash Shaitanir Rajeem). Farman hai ke jab koi shakhs yeh padhta hai Shaitan kehta hai mere shar se yeh tamam din mehfooz ho gaya. Muslim mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman marwi hai ke tum mein se koi masjid mein jaana chahe yeh dua padhe: (Allahum-maftah li abwaba rahmatik) Aye Allah mere liye apni rahmat ke darwaze khol de. Ibn-e-Majah wagaira mein hai ke jab tum mein se koi masjid mein jaye toh Allah ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par salam bheje phir dua (Allahum-maftah li abwaba rahmatik) padhe aur jab masjid se nikle toh Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par salam bhej kar dua (Allahum-ma'simni minash Shaitanir Rajeem) padhe. Tirmidhi wagaira mein hai ke jab aap masjid mein aate toh durood padh kar dua (Allahummaghfirli zunubi waftah li abwaba rahmatik) padhte aur jab masjid se nikalte toh durood ke baad dua (Allahummaghfirli zunubi waftah li abwaba fadlik) padhte. Is hadith ki sanad muttasil nahin. Al-garaz yeh aur in jaisi aur bahut si hadeesein is aayat ke mutaliq hain jo masjid aur ahkam-e-masjid ke sath talluq rakhti hain. Aur aayat mein hai tum har masjid mein apna munh seedha rakho. Aur khuloos ke sath sirf Allah ko pukaro. Ek aur aayat mein hai ke masjidein Allah hi ki hain. Uska naam un mein liya jaye yani Kitabullah ki tilawat ki jaye.

Subh-o-sham wahan us Allah ki tasbeeh bayan karte hain. Aasal jama hai aseel ki, sham ke waqt ko aseel kehte hain. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain jahan kahin Quran mein tasbeeh ka lafz hai wahan murad namaz hai. Pas yahan murad subh ki aur asr ki namaz hai. Pehle pehle yahi do namazein farz hui thin pas wahi yaad dilayi gayin. Ek qirat mein yusabbihu hai aur us qirat par aasal par poora waqf hai aur rijal se phir dusri baat shuru hai goya ke woh mufassir hai fa'il-e-mahzoof ke liye. To goya kaha gaya ke wahan tasbeeh kaun karte hain? To jawab diya gaya ke aise log aur yusabbihu ki qirat par rijal fa'il hai to waqf fa'il ke bayan ke baad chahiye. Kehte hain rijal ishara hai un ke behtareen maqasid aur un ki pak niyaton aur aala kamon ki taraf. Yeh Allah ke gharon ke abad rakhne wale hain. Is ki ibadat ki jaghein un se zeenat pati hain, tauheed aur shukr guzari karne wale hain. Jaise farman hai ayat (Minal mu'mineena rijalun sadaqu ma 'ahadullaha 'alaihi) (Surah (Al-Ahzab: 23), yani mominon mein aise bhi mard hain jinhon ne jo 'ahd Allah Ta'ala se kiye the unhein poore kar dikhaya. Haan aurton ki behtareen masjid ghar ke andar ka kona hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Hazrat Abu Humaid Sa'idi (R.A) ki biwi sahiba (R.A) Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ki khidmat mein hazir huin aur kaha huzoor (ﷺ) main aap ke sath namaz ada karna bahut pasand karti hoon. Aap ne farmaya yeh mujhe bhi maloom hai lekin masla yeh hai ke teri apne ghar ki namaz sehan ki namaz se aur hujre ki namaz ghar ki namaz se aur ghar ki kothri ki namaz hujre ki namaz se afzal hai. Aur mohalle ki masjid se afzal ghar ki namaz hai aur mohalle ki masjid ki namaz meri masjid ki namaz se afzal hai. Yeh sun kar mai sahiba ne apne ghar ke bilkul intehai hisse mein ek jagah ko bator-e-masjid ke muqarrar kar liya aur aakhri ghari tak wahin namaz parhti rahin (R.A). Haan albatta aurton ke liye bhi masjid mein mardon ke sath namaz parhna jaiz zaroor hai. Bashart-e-ke mardon par apni zeenat zahir na hone dein aur na khushbu laga kar niklein. Sahih hadith mein farman-e-Rasool (ﷺ) hai ke Allah ki bandiyon ko Allah ki masjidon se na roko (Bukhari, Muslim waghera). Abu Dawood mein hai ke aurton ke liye un ke ghar afzal hain. Aur hadith mein hai ke woh khushbu istemal kar ke na niklein. Sahih Muslim Shareef mein hai ke aap ne aurton se farmaya jab tum mein se koi masjid aana chahe to khushbu ko hath bhi na lagaye. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke musalman aurtein subh ki namaz mein aati thin phir woh apni chadaron mein lipti hui chali jati thin aur bojah raat ke andhere ki wajah se woh pehchani nahin jati thin. Siddiqa (R.A) farmati hain ke aurton ne yeh jo nayi nayi baatein nikali hain agar Rasool Allah (ﷺ) in baton ko pa lete to unhein masjidon mein aane se rok dete jaise ke Bani Israel ki aurtein rok di gayin. (Bukhari, Muslim). Aise log jinhein khareedo-farokht yaad-e-Ilahi se nahin rokti. Jaise irshad hai iman walo, maal-o-aulad tumhein zikr-e-Allah se ghafil na kar de.

Surah Jumu'ah mein hai ke Jumu'ah ki azan sun kar Zikr-e-Allah ki taraf chal paro aur tijarat chor do. Matlab yeh hai ke in nek logon ko duniya aur mata-e-akhirat aur Zikr-e-Allah se ghafil na kar sakti, unhein akhirat aur akhirat ki nematon par yaqeen-e-kamil hai aur unhein hamesha rehne wala samajhte hain aur yahan ki cheezon ko fani jante hain is liye unhein chor kar is taraf tawajjah karte hain. Allah Ta'ala ki ita'at ko, us ki mohabbat ko, us ke ahkaam ko muqaddam karte hain. Hazrat Ibn-e-Mas'ud (R.A) ne ek martaba tijarat pesha hazraat ko azan sun kar apne kaam kaaj chor kar masjid ki taraf jate hue dekh kar yahi ayat tilawat farmayi aur farmaya yeh log inhi mein se hain. Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) se bhi yahi marwi hai. Abu Darda (R.A) farmate hain ke main saudagari ya tijarat karoon agarche is mein mujhe har din teen sau ashrafiyan milti hon lekin main namazon ke waqt yeh sab chor kar zaroor chala jaunga. Mera matlab yeh hargiz nahin ke tijarat karna haram hai balkeh yeh hai ke hum mein yeh wasf hona chahiye, jo is ayat mein bayan ho raha hai. Salim bin Abdullah namaz ke liye ja rahe the. Dekha ke Madina Sharif ke saudagar apni apni dukanon par kapre dhak kar namaz ke liye gaye hue hain aur koi bhi dukan par majood nahin to yahi ayat parhi aur farmaya yeh inhi mein se hain jin ki tareef Janab-e-Bari ne farmayi hai. Is baat ka salaf mein yahan tak khayal tha ke tarazu uthaye tol rahe hain aur azan kaan mein pari to tarazu rakh di aur masjid ki taraf chal diye. Farz namaz ba-jama'at masjid mein ada karne ka unhein ishq tha. Woh namaz ke auqat ki arkaan aur adab ki hifazat ke sath namazon ke paband the. Yeh is liye ke dilon mein khauf-e-Ilahi tha, Qayamat ka aana bar-haq jante the, us din ki khaufnaki se waqif the ke sakht tar ghabrahat aur kamil pareshani aur be-had uljhan ki wajah se aankhein pathra jayengi, dil ur jayenge, kaleje dehal jayenge. Jaise farman hai ke mere nek bande meri mohabbat ki bina par maskeenon, yateemon aur qaidiyon ko khana khilate hain aur keh dete hain ke hum tumhein mehez Allah ki raza-joi ke liye khila rahe hain, hamara maqsad tum se shukriya talab karne ya badla lene ka nahin. Hamein to apne Parwardigar se us din ka dar hai jab ke log mare ranj-o-gham ke munh basore hue aur tewariyan badle hue honge. Pas Allah hi unhein us din ki museebaton se nijat de ga aur unhein taro-tazgi, bashashat, hansi khushi aur rahat-o-aram se mila de ga. Aur un ke sabr ke badle unhein jannat aur reshmi libas ata farmaye ga. Yahan bhi farmata hai ke un ki nekiyan maqbool hain, buraiyan maaf hain, un ke ek ek amal ka behtareen badla ma' ziyadati aur Allah ke fazl ke unhein zaroor milna hai. Jaise farman hai Allah Ta'ala ba-qadr-e-ek zarre ke bhi zulm nahin karta. Aur ayat mein hai neki das guna kar di jati hai. Aur ayat mein hai jo Allah ko achha qarz de ga, use Allah Ta'ala barha charha kar zyada se zyada kar ke de ga. Farman hai ayat (Yuda'ifu liman yasha'u) (2:261).

(Al-Baqarah: 261) Woh barha deta hai jis ke liye chahey. Yahan farman hai woh jisay chahay be-hisab deta hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Mas'ood (Razi Allahu Anhu) ke paas ek martaba doodh laya gaya, aap ne apni majlis ke sathiyon mein se har ek ko pilana chaha magar sab rozay se thay. Is liye aap hi ke paas phir bartan aaya. Aap ne yahi aayat 'yakh-foon' se parhi aur pee liya. Rasool Allah (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmatay hain Qayamat ke din jab ke awwal-o-aakhir sab jama honge, Allah Ta'ala ek munadi ko hukum de ga jo ba-aawaz-e-buland nida kare ga jisay tamam ahl-e-mahshar sunenge ke aaj sab ko maloom ho jaye ga ke Allah ke haan sab se zyada buzurg kaun hai? Phir farmaye ga woh log kharay ho jayenge jinhein len-den aur tijarat zikr-e-Allah se rokta na tha, pas woh kharay ho jayenge aur woh bohat hi kam honge, sab se pehle unhein hisab se farigh kiya jaye ga. Aap farmatay hain un ki nekiyon ka ajar yani Jannat bhi unhein mile gi aur mazeed fazl-e-Ilahi yeh hoga ke jin logon ne un ke sath ehsan kiye honge aur woh mustahiq-e-shafa'at honge un sab ki shafa'at ka mansab unhein hasil ho jaye ga.)

Momin ke dil se mumasilat momin ke dil ki aur is mein jo hidayat-o-ilm hai us ki misaal oopar wali aayat mein us roshan charagh se di thi jo sheesha ki handi mein ho aur saaf zaitoon ke roshan tel se jal raha hai. Is liye yahan is ki ibadat ki jati hai aur is ki tauheed bayan ki jati hai. Jin ki nigahbani aur paak saaf rakhne ka aur behuda aqwal-o-afaal se bachane ka hukum Allah ne diya hai. Ibn Abbas (R.A) waghera farmate hain ke 'an turfa' ke ma'ani is mein behudgi na karne ke hain. Qatada (R.H) farmate hain murad is se yahi masajid hain jin ki tameer, aabadi, adab aur pakeezgi ka hukum Allah ne diya hai. Ka'ab (R.H) kaha karte the ke Taurat mein likha hua hai ke zameen par masajid mera ghar hain, jo bhi bawazu mere ghar par meri mulaqat ke liye aayega, main us ki izzat karunga. Har us shakhs par jis se milne ke liye koi us ke ghar aaye haq hai ke woh us ki takreem kare (Tafsir Ibn Abi Hatim). Masajidon ke banane aur un ka adab-o-ehtram karne, unhein khushbudar aur paak saaf rakhne ke bare mein bahut si hadeesain warid hui hain jinhein bihamdillah main ne ek mustaqil kitab mein likha hai, yahan bhi un mein se thodi bahut warid karta hoon, Allah madad kare isi par bharosa aur tawakkul hai. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain jo shakhs Allah Ta'ala ki raza hasil karne ki niyat se masjid banaye Allah Ta'ala us ke liye isi jaisa ghar jannat mein banata hai (Bukhari-o-Muslim). Farmate hain naam Allah ke zikr kiye jaane ke liye jo shakhs masjid banaye Allah us ke liye jannat mein ghar banata hai (Ibn Majah). Huzoor (ﷺ) ne hukum diya ke mohallon mein masajid banayi jayen aur paak saaf aur khushbudar rakhi jayen (Tirmidhi Sharif). Hazrat Umar (R.A) ka farman hai logon ke liye masajid banao jahan unhein jagah mile lekin surkh ya zard rang se bacho taake log fitne mein na padein (Bukhari Sharif). Ek zaeef sanad se marwi hai ke jab tak kisi qoum ne apni masajidon ko teep-taap wala, naqsh-o-nigar aur rang-o-roghan wala na banaya un ke a'maal bure nahin hue (Ibn Majah), is ki sanad zaeef hai. Aap (ﷺ) farmate hain mujhe masajidon ko buland-o-bala aur pukhta banane ka hukum nahin diya gaya. Ibn Abbas (R.A) rawi-e-hadees farmate hain ke tum yaqeenan masajidon ko muzayyan, munaqqash aur rang-dar karoge jaise ke Yahood-o-Nasara ne kiya (Abu Dawood). Farmate hain Qayamat qaim na hogi jab tak ke log masajidon ke bare mein aapas mein ek dusre par fakhr-o-ghuroor na karne lagein (Abu Dawood waghera). Ek shakhs masjid mein apne oont ko dhoondta hua aaya aur kehne laga hai koi jo mujhe mere surkh rang ke oont ka pata de. Aap (ﷺ) ne bad-dua ki ke Allah kare tujhe na mile. Masajid to jis matlab ke liye banayi gayi hain, usi kaam ke liye hain (Muslim). Huzoor (ﷺ) ne masajidon mein khareed-o-farokht, tijarat karne se aur wahan ashaar ke gaye jaane se mana farma diya hai (Ahmad waghera). Farman hai ke jise masjid mein khareed-o-farokht karte hue dekho to kaho ke Allah teri tijarat mein nafa na de aur jab kisi ko gum shuda janwar masjid mein talash karta hua pao to kaho ke Allah kare na mile.

(Tirmidhi) Bohat si baatein masjid ke laiq nahin, masjid ko rasta na banaya jaye, na teer phailaye jayen na kacha gosht laya jaye, na yahan had maari jaye, na yahan baatein aur qissay kahe jayen na isay bazaar banaya jaye (Ibn Majah). Farman hai ke hamari masjidon se apne bachon ko, deewanon ko, khareed-o-farokht ko, ladai jhagray ko aur buland aawaz se bolne ko aur had jaari karne ko aur talwaron ke nangi karne ko roko. In ke darwazon par wuzu waghera ki jagah banao aur jumma ke din inhein khushbu se mehka do (Ibn Majah). Is ki sanad zaeef hai. Baaz ulama ne bila zaroorat ke masjidon ko guzar-gah banana makrooh kaha hai. Ek asar mein hai ke jo shakhs baghair namaz parhay masjid se guzar jaye, farishtay us par ta'ajjub karte hain. Hathiyaron aur teeron se jo mana farmaya yeh is liye ke musalman wahan bakasrat jama hote hain aisa na ho ke kisi ke lag jaye. Isi liye Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka hukum hai ke teer ya neza le kar guzray to usay chahiye ke us ka phal apne hath mein rakhay taake kisi ko eza na pohanchay. Kacha gosht lana is liye mana hai ke khauf hai is mein se khoon na tapkay jaisay ke haiza aurat ko bhi isi wajah se masjid mein aanay ki mumanat kar di gayi hai. Masjid mein had lagana aur qisas lena is liye mana kiya gaya hai ke kahin aisa na ho ke woh shakhs masjid ko najis na kar de. Bazaar banana is liye mana hai ke woh khareed-o-farokht ki jagah hai aur masjid mein yeh dono baatein mana hain. Kyunke masjidein zikr-e-Allah aur namaz ki jagah hain. Jaisay ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne us a'arabi se farmaya tha, jis ne masjid ke goshay mein peshab kar diya tha ke masjidein is liye nahin banein, balkay woh Allah ke zikr aur namaz ki jagah hai. Phir us ke peshab par ek bada dol pani ka bahaane ka hukum diya. Dusri hadith mein hai apne bachon ko apni masjidon se roko is liye ke khel kood hi un ka kaam hai aur masjid mein yeh munasib nahin. Chunancha Farooq-e-Azam (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) jab kisi bachay ko masjid mein khelta hua dekh letay to usay korday se peet-tay aur Isha ki namaz ke baad masjid mein kisi ko na rehnay detay. Deewanon ko bhi masjidon se roka gaya kyunke woh be-aqal hote hain aur logon ke mazaq ka zariya hote hain aur masjid is tamashay ke laiq nahin. Aur yeh bhi hai ke un ki najasat waghera ka khauf hai. Bai-o-Shira se roka gaya kyunke woh zikr-e-Allah se mani hai. Jhagron ki musalahati majlis mun'aqid karne se is liye mana kar diya gaya ke is mein aawazein buland hoti hain aisay alfaaz bhi nikal jatay hain jo aadaab-e-masjid ke khilaf hain. Aksar ulama ka qaul hai ke faislay masjid mein na kiye jayen isi liye is jumlay ke baad buland aawaz se mana farmaya. Saib bin Yazeed Kundi (Rahimahullah / R.H) farmatay hain "Main masjid mein khada tha ke achanak mujh par kisi ne kankar phenka, main ne dekha to woh Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) thay mujh se farmanay lagay, jao in dono shakhson ko mere paas lao, jab main aap ke paas inhein laya to aap ne un se daryaft farmaya. Tum kaun ho? Ya poocha ke "Tum kahan ke ho"? Unhon ne kaha "Hum Taif ke rehnay walay hain".
