Ek qirat mein yusabbihu hai aur us qirat par aasal par poora waqf hai aur rijal se phir dusri baat shuru hai goya ke woh mufassir hai fa'il-e-mahzoof ke liye. To goya kaha gaya ke wahan tasbeeh kaun karte hain? To jawab diya gaya ke aise log aur yusabbihu ki qirat par rijal fa'il hai to waqf fa'il ke bayan ke baad chahiye. Kehte hain rijal ishara hai un ke behtareen maqasid aur un ki pak niyaton aur aala kamon ki taraf. Yeh Allah ke gharon ke abad rakhne wale hain. Is ki ibadat ki jaghein un se zeenat pati hain, tauheed aur shukr guzari karne wale hain. Jaise farman hai ayat (Minal mu'mineena rijalun sadaqu ma 'ahadullaha 'alaihi) (Surah (Al-Ahzab: 23), yani mominon mein aise bhi mard hain jinhon ne jo 'ahd Allah Ta'ala se kiye the unhein poore kar dikhaya. Haan aurton ki behtareen masjid ghar ke andar ka kona hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Hazrat Abu Humaid Sa'idi (R.A) ki biwi sahiba (R.A) Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ki khidmat mein hazir huin aur kaha huzoor (ﷺ) main aap ke sath namaz ada karna bahut pasand karti hoon. Aap ne farmaya yeh mujhe bhi maloom hai lekin masla yeh hai ke teri apne ghar ki namaz sehan ki namaz se aur hujre ki namaz ghar ki namaz se aur ghar ki kothri ki namaz hujre ki namaz se afzal hai. Aur mohalle ki masjid se afzal ghar ki namaz hai aur mohalle ki masjid ki namaz meri masjid ki namaz se afzal hai. Yeh sun kar mai sahiba ne apne ghar ke bilkul intehai hisse mein ek jagah ko bator-e-masjid ke muqarrar kar liya aur aakhri ghari tak wahin namaz parhti rahin (R.A). Haan albatta aurton ke liye bhi masjid mein mardon ke sath namaz parhna jaiz zaroor hai. Bashart-e-ke mardon par apni zeenat zahir na hone dein aur na khushbu laga kar niklein. Sahih hadith mein farman-e-Rasool (ﷺ) hai ke Allah ki bandiyon ko Allah ki masjidon se na roko (Bukhari, Muslim waghera). Abu Dawood mein hai ke aurton ke liye un ke ghar afzal hain. Aur hadith mein hai ke woh khushbu istemal kar ke na niklein. Sahih Muslim Shareef mein hai ke aap ne aurton se farmaya jab tum mein se koi masjid aana chahe to khushbu ko hath bhi na lagaye. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke musalman aurtein subh ki namaz mein aati thin phir woh apni chadaron mein lipti hui chali jati thin aur bojah raat ke andhere ki wajah se woh pehchani nahin jati thin. Siddiqa (R.A) farmati hain ke aurton ne yeh jo nayi nayi baatein nikali hain agar Rasool Allah (ﷺ) in baton ko pa lete to unhein masjidon mein aane se rok dete jaise ke Bani Israel ki aurtein rok di gayin. (Bukhari, Muslim). Aise log jinhein khareedo-farokht yaad-e-Ilahi se nahin rokti. Jaise irshad hai iman walo, maal-o-aulad tumhein zikr-e-Allah se ghafil na kar de.

Surah Jumu'ah mein hai ke Jumu'ah ki azan sun kar Zikr-e-Allah ki taraf chal paro aur tijarat chor do. Matlab yeh hai ke in nek logon ko duniya aur mata-e-akhirat aur Zikr-e-Allah se ghafil na kar sakti, unhein akhirat aur akhirat ki nematon par yaqeen-e-kamil hai aur unhein hamesha rehne wala samajhte hain aur yahan ki cheezon ko fani jante hain is liye unhein chor kar is taraf tawajjah karte hain. Allah Ta'ala ki ita'at ko, us ki mohabbat ko, us ke ahkaam ko muqaddam karte hain. Hazrat Ibn-e-Mas'ud (R.A) ne ek martaba tijarat pesha hazraat ko azan sun kar apne kaam kaaj chor kar masjid ki taraf jate hue dekh kar yahi ayat tilawat farmayi aur farmaya yeh log inhi mein se hain. Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) se bhi yahi marwi hai. Abu Darda (R.A) farmate hain ke main saudagari ya tijarat karoon agarche is mein mujhe har din teen sau ashrafiyan milti hon lekin main namazon ke waqt yeh sab chor kar zaroor chala jaunga. Mera matlab yeh hargiz nahin ke tijarat karna haram hai balkeh yeh hai ke hum mein yeh wasf hona chahiye, jo is ayat mein bayan ho raha hai. Salim bin Abdullah namaz ke liye ja rahe the. Dekha ke Madina Sharif ke saudagar apni apni dukanon par kapre dhak kar namaz ke liye gaye hue hain aur koi bhi dukan par majood nahin to yahi ayat parhi aur farmaya yeh inhi mein se hain jin ki tareef Janab-e-Bari ne farmayi hai. Is baat ka salaf mein yahan tak khayal tha ke tarazu uthaye tol rahe hain aur azan kaan mein pari to tarazu rakh di aur masjid ki taraf chal diye. Farz namaz ba-jama'at masjid mein ada karne ka unhein ishq tha. Woh namaz ke auqat ki arkaan aur adab ki hifazat ke sath namazon ke paband the. Yeh is liye ke dilon mein khauf-e-Ilahi tha, Qayamat ka aana bar-haq jante the, us din ki khaufnaki se waqif the ke sakht tar ghabrahat aur kamil pareshani aur be-had uljhan ki wajah se aankhein pathra jayengi, dil ur jayenge, kaleje dehal jayenge. Jaise farman hai ke mere nek bande meri mohabbat ki bina par maskeenon, yateemon aur qaidiyon ko khana khilate hain aur keh dete hain ke hum tumhein mehez Allah ki raza-joi ke liye khila rahe hain, hamara maqsad tum se shukriya talab karne ya badla lene ka nahin. Hamein to apne Parwardigar se us din ka dar hai jab ke log mare ranj-o-gham ke munh basore hue aur tewariyan badle hue honge. Pas Allah hi unhein us din ki museebaton se nijat de ga aur unhein taro-tazgi, bashashat, hansi khushi aur rahat-o-aram se mila de ga. Aur un ke sabr ke badle unhein jannat aur reshmi libas ata farmaye ga. Yahan bhi farmata hai ke un ki nekiyan maqbool hain, buraiyan maaf hain, un ke ek ek amal ka behtareen badla ma' ziyadati aur Allah ke fazl ke unhein zaroor milna hai. Jaise farman hai Allah Ta'ala ba-qadr-e-ek zarre ke bhi zulm nahin karta. Aur ayat mein hai neki das guna kar di jati hai. Aur ayat mein hai jo Allah ko achha qarz de ga, use Allah Ta'ala barha charha kar zyada se zyada kar ke de ga. Farman hai ayat (Yuda'ifu liman yasha'u) (2:261).

(Al-Baqarah: 261) Woh barha deta hai jis ke liye chahey. Yahan farman hai woh jisay chahay be-hisab deta hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Mas'ood (Razi Allahu Anhu) ke paas ek martaba doodh laya gaya, aap ne apni majlis ke sathiyon mein se har ek ko pilana chaha magar sab rozay se thay. Is liye aap hi ke paas phir bartan aaya. Aap ne yahi aayat 'yakh-foon' se parhi aur pee liya. Rasool Allah (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmatay hain Qayamat ke din jab ke awwal-o-aakhir sab jama honge, Allah Ta'ala ek munadi ko hukum de ga jo ba-aawaz-e-buland nida kare ga jisay tamam ahl-e-mahshar sunenge ke aaj sab ko maloom ho jaye ga ke Allah ke haan sab se zyada buzurg kaun hai? Phir farmaye ga woh log kharay ho jayenge jinhein len-den aur tijarat zikr-e-Allah se rokta na tha, pas woh kharay ho jayenge aur woh bohat hi kam honge, sab se pehle unhein hisab se farigh kiya jaye ga. Aap farmatay hain un ki nekiyon ka ajar yani Jannat bhi unhein mile gi aur mazeed fazl-e-Ilahi yeh hoga ke jin logon ne un ke sath ehsan kiye honge aur woh mustahiq-e-shafa'at honge un sab ki shafa'at ka mansab unhein hasil ho jaye ga.)

Do qisam ke kafir yeh do misalein hain aur do qisam ke kafiron ki hain. Jaise Surah Baqarah ki shuru mein do misalein do qisam ki munafiqon ki bayan hui hain. Ek aag ki ek pani ki. Aur jaise ke Surah Ra'ad mein hidayat-o-ilm ki jo insan ke dil mein jagah pakad jaye. Aisi hi do misalein ek aag ki ek pani ki bayan hui hain. Dono suraton mein in ayaton ki tafsir-e-kamil guzar chuki hai. Falhamdulillah yahan pehli misal toh un kafiron ki hai jo kufr ki taraf dusron ko bhi bulate hain. Aur apne aap ko hidayat par samajhte hain halankeh woh sakht gumrah hain. Un ki toh aisi misal hai jaise kisi pyase ko jungle mein door se ret ka chamakta hua toda dikhai deta hai aur woh use pani ka mauj-e-darya samajh baithta hai. Qee'ah jama hai qaa ki jaise jaar ki jama jeerah aur qaa wahid bhi hota hai aur jama qee'aan hoti hai jaise jaar ki jama jeeran hai. Ma'ani is ke chatyal wasee phaile hue maidan ke hain. Aise hi maidanon mein sarab nazar aaya karte hain. Dopehar ke waqt bilkul yehi maloom hota hai ke pani ka wasee darya lehrein le raha hai. Jungle mein jo pyasa ho, pani ki talash mein us ki baachein khul jati hain aur use pani samajh kar jaan tod koshish kar ke wahan tak pahunchta hai lekin hairat-o-hasrat se apna munh lapet leta hai. Dekhta hai ke wahan pani ka qatra chhod naam-o-nishan bhi nahin. Isi tarah yeh kuffar hain ke apne dil mein samjhe baithe hain ke hum ne bahut kuch a'amal kiye hain, bahut si bhalaiyan jama kar li hain lekin Qayamat ke din dekhenge ke ek neki bhi un ke paas nahin ya toh un ki badniyati se woh gharat ho chuki hai ya shar'a ke mutabiq na hone ki wajah se barbad ho gayi hai. Garz un ke yahan pahunchne se pehle un ke kaam jahannam raseed ho chuke hain, yahan yeh bilkul khali hath reh gaye hain. Hisab ke mauqa par Allah khud maujood hai aur ek ek a'amal ka hisab le raha hai aur koi a'amal un ka qabil-e-sawab nahin nikalta. Chunancha Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke Yahudiyon se Qayamat ke din sawal hoga ke tum duniya mein kis ki ibadat karte rahe? Woh jawab denge ke Allah ke bete Uzair ki. Kaha jayega ke jhoote ho Allah ka koi beta nahin. Acha batao ab kya chahte ho? Woh kahenge ae Allah hum bahut pyase ho rahe hain, hamein pani pilwaya jaye toh un se kaha jayega ke dekho woh kya nazar aa raha hai? Tum wahan kyun nahin jate? Ab unhein door se jahannam aisi nazar aayegi jaise duniya mein sarab hota hai jis par jaari pani ka dhoka hota hai yeh wahan jayenge aur dozakh mein daal diye jayenge. Yeh misal toh thi jahl-e-murakkab walon ki. Ab jahl-e-baseet walon ki misal suniye jo kore muqallid thay, apni girah ki aql mutlaq nahin rakhte thay. Mandarja bala misal wale aimma-e-kufr ki taqleed karte thay aur aankhein band kar ke un ki aawaz par lage hue thay ke un ki misal gehre samundar ki teh ke andheron jaisi hai jise upar se teh-ba-teh maujon ne dhanp rakha ho aur phir upar se abr dhanke hue hon. Ya'ni andhere par andhera ho.

Yahan tak ke hath ko hath bhi sujhai na deta ho. Yehi haal un safle jahil kafiron ka hai ke nire muqallid hain. Yahan tak ke jis ki taqleed kar rahe hain lekin maloom nahin ke woh unhein kahan le ja raha hai? Chunancha misalan kaha jata hai ke kisi jahil se poocha gaya kahan ja raha hai? Us ne kaha un ke sath ja raha hoon. Poochne wale ne phir daryaft kiya ke yeh kahan ja rahe hain? Us ne kaha mujhe toh maloom nahin. Pas jaise is samundar par maujein uth rahi hain, isi tarah kafir ke dil par, us ke kanon par, us ki ankhon par parde pade hue hain. Jaise farman hai ke Allah ne un ke dilon par aur kanon par mohar laga di hai. Ek aur ayat mein irshad hota hai ayat (AFA RA-AITA MANIT-TAKHADHA ILAAHAHOO HAWAAHU WA ADHALLAHUL-LAAHU 'ALAA 'ILMIN WA KHATAMA 'ALAA SAM'IHEE WA QALBIHEE WA JA'ALA 'ALAA BASARIHEE GHISHAAWAH) (Surah (Al-Jathiya: 23), tu ne unhein dekha? Jinhon ne khwahish parasti shuru kar rakhi hai aur Allah ne unhein ilm par behka diya hai aur un ke dilon par aur kanon par mohar laga di hai aur ankhon par parda daal diya hai. Ubayy bin Ka'ab (R.A) farmate hain aise log panch andheron mein hote hain: 001 kalam, 002 amal, 003 jana, 004 ana, 005 aur anjam sab andheron mein hain. Jise Allah apne noor ki taraf hidayat na kare woh nooraniyat se khali reh jata hai. Jahalat mein mubtala reh kar halakat mein pad jata hai. Jaise farmaya ayat (MAY YUDLILIL-LAAHU FALAA HAADIYA LAHOO WA YADHARUHUM FEE TUGH-YAANIHIM YA'MAHOON) (Surah (Al-A'raf: 186) jise Allah gumrah kare us ke liye koi hadi nahin hota. Yeh us ke muqabil hai jo mominon ki misal ke bayan mein farmaya tha ke Allah apne noor ki hidayat karta hai jise chahe. Allah Ta'ala Azeem-o-Kareem se hamari dua hai ke woh hamare dilon mein noor paida kar de aur hamare dayein bayein bhi noor ata farmaye aur hamare noor ko badha de aur ise bahut bada aur zyada kare. Ameen.))

Har ek tasbeeh khwan hai, kul ke kul insaan, jinnaat, farishtay aur haiwaan yahan tak ke jamadaat bhi Allah ki tasbeeh ke bayan mein mashghool hain. Ek aur jagah hai ke saaton aasman aur sab zameenein aur un mein jo hain sab Allah ki pakeezgi ke bayan mein mashghool hain. Apne paron se udne wale parind bhi apne Rabb ki ibadat aur pakeezgi ke bayan mein mashghool hain. In sab ko jo jo tasbeeh laiq thi Allah ne unhein sikha di hai, sab ko apni ibadat ke mukhtalif judagana tareeqay sikha diye hain aur Allah par koi kaam makhfi nahin, woh Aalim-e-Kul hai. Haakim, mutasarrif, Maalik, Mukhtar-e-Kul, Mabood-e-Haqiqi, aasman-o-zameen ka badshah sirf wohi hai. Us ke siwa koi ibadat ke laiq nahin, us ke hukumon ko koi taalne wala nahin. Qayamat ke din sab ko usi ke samne hazir hona hai, woh jo chahega apni makhlooqat mein hukum farmayega. Buray log bura badla payenge. Nek nekiyon ka phal hasil karenge. Khaaliq-o-Maalik wohi hai, duniya aur aakhirat ka haakim-e-haqiqi wohi hai aur usi ki zaat laiq-e-hamd-o-sana hai.

Badal marhala-war patle dhuen jaise badal awwal awwal toh Qudrat-e-Ilahi se uthte hain phir mil jul kar woh jasim ho jate hain aur ek dusre ke upar jam jate hain phir un mein se barish barasti hai. Hawayein chalti hain, zameen ko qabil banati hain, phir abr ko uthati hain, phir unhein milati hain, phir woh pani se bhar jate hain, phir baras padte hain. Phir aasman se olon ko barsane ka zikr hai is jumle mein pehla 'min' ibtida-e-ghayat ka hai. Dusra tab'eez ka hai. Teesra bayan-e-jins ka hai. Yeh is tafsir ki bina par hai ke aayat ke ma'ani yeh kiye jayen ke olon ke pahad aasman par hain. Aur jin ke nazdeek yahan pahad ka lafz abr ke liye bator kinaya hai un ke nazdeek 'min' saniya bhi ibtida-e-ghayat ke liye hai lekin woh pehle ka badal hai, Wallahu A'lam. Is ke baad ke jumle ka yeh matlab hai ke barish aur ole jahan Allah barsana chahe, wahan us ki rahmat se baraste hain aur jahan na chahe nahin baraste. Ya yeh matlab hai ke olon se jin ki chahe, khetiyan aur baghat kharab kar deta hai aur jin par meherbani farmaye unhein bacha leta hai. Phir bijli ki chamak ki quwwat bayan ho rahi hai ke qareeb hai woh aankhon ki roshni kho de. Din raat ka tasarruf bhi usi ke qabze mein hai, jab chahta hai din ko chota aur raat ko badi kar deta hai aur jab chahta hai raat ko badi kar ke din ko chota kar deta hai. Yeh tamam nishaniyan hain jo Qudrat-e-Qadir ko zahir karti hain, Allah ki azmat ko aashkara karti hain. Jaise farman hai ke aasman-o-zameen ki paidaish, raat din ke ikhtilaf mein aqalmandon ke liye bahut si nishaniyan hain.

Badal marhala-war patle dhuen jaise badal awwal awwal toh Qudrat-e-Ilahi se uthte hain phir mil jul kar woh jasim ho jate hain aur ek dusre ke upar jam jate hain phir un mein se barish barasti hai. Hawayein chalti hain, zameen ko qabil banati hain, phir abr ko uthati hain, phir unhein milati hain, phir woh pani se bhar jate hain, phir baras padte hain. Phir aasman se olon ko barsane ka zikr hai is jumle mein pehla 'min' ibtida-e-ghayat ka hai. Dusra tab'eez ka hai. Teesra bayan-e-jins ka hai. Yeh is tafsir ki bina par hai ke aayat ke ma'ani yeh kiye jayen ke olon ke pahad aasman par hain. Aur jin ke nazdeek yahan pahad ka lafz abr ke liye bator kinaya hai un ke nazdeek 'min' saniya bhi ibtida-e-ghayat ke liye hai lekin woh pehle ka badal hai, Wallahu A'lam. Is ke baad ke jumle ka yeh matlab hai ke barish aur ole jahan Allah barsana chahe, wahan us ki rahmat se baraste hain aur jahan na chahe nahin baraste. Ya yeh matlab hai ke olon se jin ki chahe, khetiyan aur baghat kharab kar deta hai aur jin par meherbani farmaye unhein bacha leta hai. Phir bijli ki chamak ki quwwat bayan ho rahi hai ke qareeb hai woh aankhon ki roshni kho de. Ek hi pani aur mukhtalif ajnas ki paidaish Allah Ta'ala apni kamil qudrat aur zabardast saltanat ka bayan farmata hai ke usne ek hi pani se tarah tarah ki makhlooq paida kardi hai. Saanp waghera ko dekho jo apne pet ke bal chalte hain. Insaan aur parind ko dekho unke do paon hote hain. Haiwanon aur chopayon ko dekho woh chaar paon par chalte hain, woh bada qadir hai jo chahta hai hojata hai jo nahin chahta hargiz nahin hosakta, woh Qadir-e-Kul hai.
Yeh hikmat bhare ahkaam, yeh roshan, is Quran-e-Kareem mein Allah Ta'ala hi ne bayan farmayi hain. Aqlmandon ko in ke samajhne ki taufiq di hai, Rabb jisay chahay apni seedhi raah par lagaye.

Munafiq ki zaban aur, dil munafiqon ka hal bayan ho raha hai ke zaban toh iman-o-ita'at ka iqrar karte hain lekin dil se uske khilaf hain. Amal kuch hai qaul kuch hai. Is liye ke darasal imandar nahin. Hadith mein hai ke jo shakhs badshah ke samne bulwaya jaye aur woh na jaye woh zalim hai aur na-haq par hai. Jab unhein hidayat ki taraf bulaya jata hai, Quran-o-Hadith ke manne ko kaha jata hai toh yeh munh pher lete hain aur takabbur karne lagte hain jaise ayat (Alam tara ilallazina yaz'amuna se sududa) tak ki ayaton mein bayan guzar chuka hai. Haan agar unhein shar'i faisle mein apna nafa nazar aata ho toh lambe lambe kalme padhte hue, gardan hilate hue hansi khushi chale ayenge aur jab maloom ho jaye ke shar'i faisla unki tab'i khwahish ke khilaf hai, dunyawi mufad ke khilaf hai toh haq ki taraf mud kar dekhenge bhi nahin. Pas aise log pakke kafir hain. Is liye ke teen hal se khali nahin ya toh yeh ke unke dilon mein hi be-imani ghar kar gayi hai ya unhein Allah ke deen ki haqaniyat mein shukook hain ya khauf hai ke kahin Allah aur Rasool unka haq na mar lein, un par zulm-o-sitam karenge aur yeh teeno suratein kufr ki hain. Allah in mein se har ek ko janta hai jo jaisa batin mein hai uske pas woh zahir hai. Darasal yahi log jabir hain, zalim hain, Allah aur Rasool Allah (ﷺ) is se pak hain. Huzoor (ﷺ) ke zamane mein aise kafir jo zahir mein musalman thay, bahut se thay, unhein jab apna matlab Quran-o-Hadith mein nikalta nazar aata toh khidmat-e-Nabawi mein apne jhagde pesh karte aur jab unhein dusron se matlab barari nazar aati toh Sarkar-e-Muhammad (ﷺ) mein aane se saf inkar kar jate. Pas yeh ayat utri aur Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya jin do shakhson mein koi jhagda ho aur woh islami hukm ke mutabiq faisle ki taraf bulaya jaye aur woh is se inkar kare woh zalim hai aur na-haq par hai. Yeh hadith ghareeb hai. Phir sache mominon ki shan bayan hoti hai ke woh Kitabullah aur Sunnat-e-Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ke siwa kisi teesri cheez ko dakhil-e-deen nahin samajhte. Woh toh Quran-o-Hadith sunte hi, uski dawat ki nida kaan mein padte hi saf keh dete hain ke hum ne suna aur mana yeh kamyab, ba-murad aur nijat yafta log hain. Hazrat Ubada bin Samit (R.A) jo badri sahabi hain. Ansari hain, ansaron ke ek sardar hain, unhon ne apne bhatije Janada bin Umayya se ba-waqt-e-inteqal farmaya ke aao mujh se sun lo ke tumhare zimme kya hai? Sunna aur manna sakhti mein bhi asani mein bhi, khushi mein bhi na-khushi mein bhi, us waqt bhi jab ke tera haq dusre ko diya ja raha ho, apni zaban ko adl aur sachai ke sath seedhi rakh. Kaam ke ahl logon se kaam ko na chheen, haan agar kisi khuli nafarmani ka woh hukm dein toh na manna. Kitabullah ke khilaf koi bhi kahe hargiz na manna. Kitabullah ki pairwi mein lage rehna. Abu Darda (R.A) farmate hain ke Islam baghair Allah ki ita'at ke nahin aur behtari jo kuch hai woh jama'at ki, Allah ki, uske Rasool ki, Khalifatul Muslimeen ki aur aam musalmanon ki khair-khwahi mein hai.

Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) farmate hain Islam ka mazboot kada, Allah ki wahdaniyat ki gawahi, namaz ki pabandi, zakat ki adaigi aur musalmanon ke badshah ki itaat hai. Jo ahadees-o-asar Kitabullah aur Sunnat-e-Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ki itaat ke bare mein aur musalman badshahon ki manne ke bare mein marwi hain woh is kasrat se hain ke sab yahan kisi tarah bayan ho hi nahin sakte. Jo shakhs Allah aur Rasool ka nafarman ban jaye, jo hukum mile baja laye, jis cheez se rok dein ruk jaye, jo gunah ho jaye us se khauf khata rahe, aainda ke liye us se bachta rahe, aise log tamam bhalaiyon ko sametne wale aur tamam buraiyon se bach jane wale hain. Duniya aur aakhirat mein woh nijat yafta hain.

Kaam ke ahl logon se kaam ko na chheen, haan agar kisi khuli nafarmani ka woh hukm dein toh na manna. Kitabullah ke khilaf koi bhi kahe hargiz na manna. Kitabullah ki pairwi mein lage rehna. Abu Darda (R.A) farmate hain ke Islam baghair Allah ki ita'at ke nahin aur behtari jo kuch hai woh jama'at ki, Allah ki, uske Rasool ki, Khalifatul Muslimeen ki aur aam musalmanon ki khair-khwahi mein hai.

Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) farmate hain Islam ka mazboot kada, Allah ki wahdaniyat ki gawahi, namaz ki pabandi, zakat ki adaigi aur musalmanon ke badshah ki itaat hai. Jo ahadees-o-asar Kitabullah aur Sunnat-e-Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ki itaat ke bare mein aur musalman badshahon ki manne ke bare mein marwi hain woh is kasrat se hain ke sab yahan kisi tarah bayan ho hi nahin sakte. Jo shakhs Allah aur Rasool ka nafarman ban jaye, jo hukum mile baja laye, jis cheez se rok dein ruk jaye, jo gunah ho jaye us se khauf khata rahe, aainda ke liye us se bachta rahe, aise log tamam bhalaiyon ko sametne wale aur tamam buraiyon se bach jane wale hain. Duniya aur aakhirat mein woh nijat yafta hain.

Munafiq ki zaban aur, dil munafiqon ka hal bayan ho raha hai ke zaban toh iman-o-ita'at ka iqrar karte hain lekin dil se uske khilaf hain. Amal kuch hai qaul kuch hai. Is liye ke darasal imandar nahin. Hadith mein hai ke jo shakhs badshah ke samne bulwaya jaye aur woh na jaye woh zalim hai aur na-haq par hai. Jab unhein hidayat ki taraf bulaya jata hai, Quran-o-Hadith ke manne ko kaha jata hai toh yeh munh pher lete hain aur takabbur karne lagte hain jaise ayat (Alam tara ilallazina yaz'amuna se sududa) tak ki ayaton mein bayan guzar chuka hai. Haan agar unhein shar'i faisle mein apna nafa nazar aata ho toh lambe lambe kalme padhte hue, gardan hilate hue hansi khushi chale ayenge aur jab maloom ho jaye ke shar'i faisla unki tab'i khwahish ke khilaf hai, dunyawi mufad ke khilaf hai toh haq ki taraf mud kar dekhenge bhi nahin. Pas aise log pakke kafir hain. Is liye ke teen hal se khali nahin ya toh yeh ke unke dilon mein hi be-imani ghar kar gayi hai ya unhein Allah ke deen ki haqaniyat mein shukook hain ya khauf hai ke kahin Allah aur Rasool unka haq na mar lein, un par zulm-o-sitam karenge aur yeh teeno suratein kufr ki hain. Allah in mein se har ek ko janta hai jo jaisa batin mein hai uske pas woh zahir hai. Darasal yahi log jabir hain, zalim hain, Allah aur Rasool Allah (ﷺ) is se pak hain. Huzoor (ﷺ) ke zamane mein aise kafir jo zahir mein musalman thay, bahut se thay, unhein jab apna matlab Quran-o-Hadith mein nikalta nazar aata toh khidmat-e-Nabawi mein apne jhagde pesh karte aur jab unhein dusron se matlab barari nazar aati toh Sarkar-e-Muhammad (ﷺ) mein aane se saf inkar kar jate. Pas yeh ayat utri aur Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya jin do shakhson mein koi jhagda ho aur woh islami hukm ke mutabiq faisle ki taraf bulaya jaye aur woh is se inkar kare woh zalim hai aur na-haq par hai. Yeh hadith ghareeb hai. Phir sache mominon ki shan bayan hoti hai ke woh Kitabullah aur Sunnat-e-Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ke siwa kisi teesri cheez ko dakhil-e-deen nahin samajhte. Woh toh Quran-o-Hadith sunte hi, uski dawat ki nida kaan mein padte hi saf keh dete hain ke hum ne suna aur mana yeh kamyab, ba-murad aur nijat yafta log hain. Hazrat Ubada bin Samit (R.A) jo badri sahabi hain. Ansari hain, ansaron ke ek sardar hain, unhon ne apne bhatije Janada bin Umayya se ba-waqt-e-inteqal farmaya ke aao mujh se sun lo ke tumhare zimme kya hai? Sunna aur manna sakhti mein bhi asani mein bhi, khushi mein bhi na-khushi mein bhi, us waqt bhi jab ke tera haq dusre ko diya ja raha ho, apni zaban ko adl aur sachai ke sath seedhi rakh. Kaam ke ahl logon se kaam ko na chheen, haan agar kisi khuli nafarmani ka woh hukm dein toh na manna. Kitabullah ke khilaf koi bhi kahe hargiz na manna. Kitabullah ki pairwi mein lage rehna. Abu Darda (R.A) farmate hain ke Islam baghair Allah ki ita'at ke nahin aur behtari jo kuch hai woh jama'at ki, Allah ki, uske Rasool ki, Khalifatul Muslimeen ki aur aam musalmanon ki khair-khwahi mein hai.

Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) farmate hain Islam ka mazboot kada, Allah ki wahdaniyat ki gawahi, namaz ki pabandi, zakat ki adaigi aur musalmanon ke badshah ki itaat hai. Jo ahadees-o-asar Kitabullah aur Sunnat-e-Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ki itaat ke bare mein aur musalman badshahon ki manne ke bare mein marwi hain woh is kasrat se hain ke sab yahan kisi tarah bayan ho hi nahin sakte. Jo shakhs Allah aur Rasool ka nafarman ban jaye, jo hukum mile baja laye, jis cheez se rok dein ruk jaye, jo gunah ho jaye us se khauf khata rahe, aainda ke liye us se bachta rahe, aise log tamam bhalaiyon ko sametne wale aur tamam buraiyon se bach jane wale hain. Duniya aur aakhirat mein woh nijat yafta hain.

Makkar munafiq ahl-e-nifaq ka haal bayan ho raha hai ke woh Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ke paas aakar apni imandari aur khair-khwahi jatate hue qasmein kha kha kar yaqeen dilate the ke hum jihad ke liye taiyar baithe hain balkeh be-qarar hain, aap ke hukum ki der hai farman hote hi ghar baar baal bachay chhor kar maidan-e-jang mein pahunch jayenge. Allah Ta'ala un se farmata hai un se keh do ke qasmein na khao tumhari ita'at ki haqeeqat toh roshan hai, zabani deengein bahut hain, amli hissa sifar hai. Tumhari qasmon ki haqeeqat bhi maloom hai, dil mein kuch hai, zaban par kuch hai, jitni zaban momin hai utna hi dil kafir hai. Yeh qasmein sirf musalmanon ki hamdardi hasil karne ke liye hain. In qasmon ko toh yeh log dhal banaye hue hain tum se hi nahin balkeh kafiron ke samne bhi in ki muwafiqat aur in ki imdad ki qasmein khate hain lekin itne buzdil hain ke un ka sath khak bhi nahin de sakte. Is jumle ke ek ma'ani yeh bhi ho sakte hain ke tumhein toh maqool aur pasandida ita'at ka shiwa chahiye na ke qasmein khane aur deengein marne ka. Tumhare samne musalman majood hain dekho na woh qasmein khate hain na barh barh kar batein banate hain, han kaam ke waqt sab se aage nikal aate hain aur fe'li hissa barh charh kar lete hain. Allah par kisi ka koi amal makhfi nahin woh apne bandon ke ek ek amal se ba-khabar hai. Har aasi aur muti' is par zahir hai. Har ek batin par bhi us ki nigahain waisi hi hain jaisi zahir par, go tum zahir kuch karo lekin woh batin par bhi agah hai. Allah aur us ke Rasool (ﷺ) ki yani Quran aur Hadith ki itteba karo agar tum is se munh mor lo, ise chhor do toh tumhare is gunah ka wabal mere Nabi (ﷺ) par nahin. Is ke zimme toh sirf paigham-e-Ilahi pahunchana aur ada-e-amanat kar dena hai. Tum par woh hai jis ke zimmedar tum ho yani qabool karna, amal karna waghera. Hidayat sirf ita'at-e-Rasool mein hai, is liye ke Sirat-e-Mustaqeem ka da'i wahi hai jo Sirat-e-Mustaqeem us Allah tak pahunchati hai jis ki saltanat tamam zameen aasman hai. Rasool (ﷺ) ke zimme sirf pahuncha dena hi hai. Sab ka hisab hamare zimme hai. Jaise farman hai aayat (فَذَكِّرْ ڜ اِنَّمَآ اَنْتَ مُذَكِّرٌ 21؀ۭ) (Surah (Al-Ghashiyah: 21), toh sirf nasi-h-o-wa'iz hai. Inhein nasihat kar diya kar, tu in ka wakeel ya darogha nahin. Wahb bin Munabbah (R.H) farmate hain ke Sha'iya ki taraf wahi-e-Ilahi aayi ke tu Bani Israel ke majmay mein khara ho ja. Main teri zaban se jo chahunga nikalwaunga, chunancha aap kharay hue toh aap ki zaban se ba-hukum-e-Ilahi yeh khutba bayan hua. Ae aasman sun, ae zameen khamosh reh, Allah Ta'ala ek shan poori karna aur ek amr ki tadbeer karne wala hai woh chahta hai ke janglon ko abad kar de.

Veerane ko basa de, sahraon ko sarsabz bana de, faqiron ko ghani kar de, charwahon ko sultan bana de, an-parhon mein se ek ummi ko Nabi bana kar bheje jo na bad-go ho na bad-akhlaq ho, na bazaron mein shor-o-ghul karne wala ho, itna maskeen sifat ho aur mutawaze ho ke uske daman ki hawa se chiragh bhi na bujhe, jis ke paas se woh guzra ho. Agar woh sookhe banson par pair rakh kar chale to bhi charachrahat kisi ke kaan mein na pahunche. Main use Basheer-o-Nazeer bana kar bhejunga, woh zaban ka paak hoga, andhi aankhein uski wajah se roshan ho jayengi, behre kaan uske baais sunne lagenge, ghilaf wale dil uski barkat se khul jayenge. Har ek bhale kaam se main use sanwardunga. Hikmat uski baatein hongi, sidq-o-wafa ki tabiyat hogi, afw-o-darguzar karna aur umdagi-o-bhalai chahna uski khaslat hogi. Haq uski shariat hogi, adl uski seerat hogi, hidayat uski imam hogi. Islam uski millat hoga. Ahmad uska naam hoga (ﷺ). Gumrahi ke baad uski wajah se main hidayat phailauga, jahalat ke baad ilm chamak uthega, pasti ke baad uski wajah se taraqqi hogi. Nadani uski zaat se danai mein badal jayegi. Kami ziyadati se badal jayegi, faqiri ko uski wajah se main amiri se badal dunga. Uski zaat se juda-juda logon ko main mila dunga, furqat ke baad ulfat hogi, intishar ke baad ittehad hoga, ikhtilaf ke baad ittefaq hoga, mukhtalif dil, judagana khwahishein ek ho jayengi. Beshumar bandagan-e-Rabb halakat se bach jayenge, uski ummat ko main tamam ummaton se behtar kar dunga jo logon ke nafa ke liye hogi, beshumar bandagan-e-Rabb halakat se bach jayenge, uski ummat ko main tamam ummaton se behtar kar dunga jo logon ke nafa ke liye hogi, bhalaiyon ka hukm karne wali buraiyon se rokne wali hogi, muwahid momin mukhlis honge, Allah ke jitne Rasool Allah ki taraf se jo laye hain yeh sab ko manenge, kisi ke munkir na honge.)

Urooj-e-Islam lazim hai. Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala apne Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se wada farma raha hai ke aap ki ummat ko zameen ka malik bana de ga, logon ka sardar bana de ga, mulk un ki wajah se abad hoga, bandagan-e-Rabb un se dil-shad honge. Aaj yeh logon se larzan-o-tarsan hain, kal yeh ba-aman-o-itminan honge, hukumat un ki hogi, saltanat un ke hathon mein hogi. Alhamdulillah, yahi hua bhi. Makkah, Khyber, Bahrain, Jazeerat-ul-Arab aur Yaman toh khud Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki maujoodgi mein fath ho gaya. Hajar ke majoosiyon ne jizya de kar mat-huti qabool kar li, Shaam ke ba'az hisson ka bhi yahi haal hua. Shah-e-Room Heraclius ne tohfe-tahaif rawana kiye. Misr ke wali ne bhi khidmat-e-aqdas mein tohfe bheje, Iskandariya ke badshah Muqauqis ne, Oman ke shahon ne bhi yahi kiya aur is tarah apni ita'at guzari ka suboot diya. Habsha ke badshah As-hama (R.H) toh musalman hi ho gaye aur un ke baad jo wali-e-Habsha hua, us ne bhi Sarkar-e-Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mein aqeedat mandi ke sath tahaif rawana kiye. Phir jab ke Allah Ta'ala Rabb-ul-Izzat ne apne mohtaram Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko apni mehmandari mein bula liya, aap ki khilafat Siddiq-e-Akbar (R.A) ne sambhali, Jazeerat-ul-Arab ki hukumat ko mazboot aur mustaqil banaya aur sath hi ek jarrar lashkar Saifullah Khalid bin Waleed (R.A) ki sipah-sallari mein bilad-e-Fars ki taraf bheja jis ne wahan futoohat ka silsila shuru kiya, kufr ke darakhton ko chhant diya aur Islami pauday har taraf laga diye. Hazrat Abu Ubaidah bin Jarrah (R.A) waghera umara ke mat-hat Shaam ke mulkon ki taraf lashkar-e-Islam ke jaan-bazon ko rawana farmaya. Unhon ne bhi yahan Muhammadi jhanda buland kiya aur saleebi nishan oundhay munh giraye, phir Misr ki taraf mujahideen ka lashkar Hazrat Amr bin Aas (R.A) ki sardari mein rawana farmaya. Busra, Damishq, Harran waghera ki futoohat ke baad aap bhi rahi-e-mulk-e-baqa huye aur ba-ilham-e-Ilahi Hazrat Umar (R.A) jaise Farooq ke zabardast zor-awar hathon mein saltanat-e-Islam ki baghein de gaye. Sach toh yeh hai ke aasman talay kisi Nabi ke baad aise pak khalifon ka daur nahin hua. Aap ki quwwat, tabiyat, aap ki neki, seerat, aap ke adl ka kamal, aap ki tadrees ki misaal duniya mein aap ke baad talash karna mehez be-sood aur bilkul la-hasil hai. Tamam mulk-e-Shaam, poora ilaaqa-e-Misr, aksar hissa-e-Fars aap ki khilafat ke zamane mein fath hua. Saltanat-e-Kisra ke tukray ur gaye, khud Kisra ko munh chhupane ke liye koi jagah na mili. Kamil zillat-o-ihanat ke sath bhagta phira. Qaisar ko fana kar diya, mita diya. Shaam ki saltanat se dast-bardar hona para. Qustuntuniya mein ja kar munh chhupaya. In saltanaton ki sadiyon ki daulat aur jama kiye huye beshumar khazanay in bandagan-e-Rabb ne Allah ke nek nafs aur maskeen khaslat bandon par kharch kiye aur Allah ke wade pooray huye jo us ne Habeeb-e-Akram (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki zaban se kehwaye thay. Salawat-ullah-o-Salamuhu Alaih. Phir Hazrat Usman bin Affan (R.A) ki khilafat ka daur aata hai aur mashriq-o-maghrib ki intiha tak Allah ka deen phail jata hai. Allah ka lashkar ek taraf aqsa-e-mashriq tak aur dusri taraf intiha-e-maghrib tak pahunch kar dam lete hain.

Aur Mujahideen ki aab-dar talwarein Allah ki Tauheed ko duniya ke goshe-goshe aur chappe-chappe mein pahuncha deti hain. Undulus, Qubrus, Qairwan-o-Sabta yahan tak ke Cheen tak aap ke zamane mein fatah hue. Kisra qatl kar diya gaya, us ka mulk toh ek taraf, naam-o-nishan tak khod kar phenk diya gaya aur hazarha baras ke aatish-kade bujha diye gaye aur har unche teele se sada-e-Allahu Akbar aane lagi. Dusri janib Mada'in, Iraq, Khurasan, Ahwaz sab fatah ho gaye, Turkon se jang-e-azeem hui, aakhir un ka bada badshah Khaqan khaak mein mila, zaleel-o-khwar hua aur zameen ke mashriqi aur maghribi konon ne apne khiraj bargah-e-Khilafat-e-Usmani mein pahunchwaye. Haq toh yeh hai ke Mujahideen ki in janbaziyon mein jaan dalne wali cheez Hazrat Usman R.A ki tilawat-e-Quran ki barkat thi. Aap ko Quran se kuch aisa shaghaf tha jo bayan se bahar hai. Quran ke jama karne, us ke hifz karne, us ki isha'at karne, us ke sambhalne mein jo numaya khidmat-e-Khalifa-e-Salis ne anjam dein woh yaqeenan adeem-ul-misaal hain. Aap ke zamane ko dekho aur Allah ke Rasool ﷺ ki is pesh-goi ko dekho ke aap ne farmaya tha ke mere liye zameen sameet di gayi yahan tak ke main ne mashriq-o-maghrib dekh li, anqareeb meri ummat ki saltanat wahan tak pahunch jayegi jahan tak is waqt mujhe dikhayi gayi hai. (Musalmano! Rabb ke is wade ko, Paighambar ki is pesh-goi ko dekho, phir tareekh ke auraq palto aur apni guzashta azmat-o-shan ko dekho. Aao nazrein dalo ke aaj tak Islam ka parcham bihamdillah buland hai aur Musalman in Mujahideen-e-Kiram ki maftooh zameeno mein shahana haisiyat se chal phir rahe hain. Allah aur us ke Rasool sache hain. Musalmano! Haif aur sad haif us par jo Quran-o-Hadith ke daire se bahar nikle, hasrat aur sad hasrat us par jo apne aabai zakheere ko ghair ke hawale kare. Apne aaba-o-ajdad ke khoon ke qatron se khareedi hui cheez ko apni nalaiqiyon aur bediniyon se ghair ki bhent charhawe aur sukh se baitha, leta rahe. Allah hamein apna lashkari bana le, Ameen Ameen).

Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain logon ka kaam bhalai se jaari rahega yahan tak ke un mein barah khulafa honge, phir aap ne ek jumla aahista bola jo raawi-e-hadith Hazrat Jabir bin Samurah R.A sun na sake toh unhon ne apne walid sahab se poocha ke Huzoor ﷺ ne kya farmaya? Unhon ne bayan kiya ke yeh farmaya hai yeh sab ke sab Quraishi honge (Muslim). Aap ne yeh baat us shaam ko bayan farmayi thi jis din Hazrat Ma'iz bin Malik R.A ko rajam kiya gaya tha. Pas maloom hua ke in barah khaleefon ka hona zaroori hai lekin yeh yaad rahe ke yeh woh khulafa nahin jo Shiyon ne samajh rakhe hain, kyunke Shiyon ke imamon mein bahut se woh bhi hain jinhein khilafat-o-saltanat ka koi hissa bhi poori umr mein nahin mila tha aur yeh barah khulafa honge, sab ke sab Quraishi honge, hukm mein adl karne wale honge, in ki basharat agli kitabon mein bhi hai aur yeh shart nahin hai ke yeh sab yakke-baad-deegare honge balkeh in ka hona yaqeeni hai khwah pe-dar-pe kuch hon khwah mutafarriq zamonon mein kuch hon.

Chunancha charon khalifay toh bil-tarteeb huay, awwal Abu Bakr R.A, phir Hazrat Umar R.A, phir Hazrat Usman R.A, phir Hazrat Ali R.A. In ke baad phir silsila toot gaya, phir bhi aisay khalifa huay aur mumkin hai aagay chal kar bhi hon. In ke sahih zamaano ka ilm Allah hi ko hai. Haan itna yaqeeni hai ke Imam Mahdi A.S bhi inhi barah mein se honge jin ka naam Huzoor ﷺ ke naam se, jin ki kuniyat Huzoor ﷺ ki kuniyat se mutabiq hogi, tamam zameen ko adl-o-insaf se bhar denge jaisay ke woh zulm-o-na-insafi se bhar gayi hogi. Huzoor ﷺ ka farman hai mere baad khilafat tees saal rahegi phir kaat khanay wala mulk ho jayega. Abu Aliyah is ayat ki tafseer mein farmatay hain Huzoor ﷺ aur aap ke as-haab R.A bees saal tak Makkah mein rahay, Allah ki tauheed aur us ki ibadat ki taraf duniya ko dawat detay rahay lekin yeh zamana poshidgi ka, darr khauf ka aur be-itminani ka tha, jihad ka hukum nahin aaya tha. Musalman be-had kamzor thay. Is ke baad hijrat ka hukum hua. Madinay pohanchay ab jihad ka hukum mila, jihad shuru hua, dushmanon ne charon taraf se ghera hua tha. Ahl-e-Islam bohat khaif thay. Khatray se koi waqt khali nahin jata tha, subh-o-sham sahaba hathiyaron se aarasta rehtay thay. Ek sahabi R.A ne ek martaba Huzoor ﷺ se kaha: Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ! Kya hum isi tarah khauf-zada hi rahenge? Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ! Kya hamari zindagi ki koi ghari bhi itminan se nahin guzregi? Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ! Kya hathiyar utaar kar bhi hamain kabhi aasoodgi ka saans lena mayassar aayega? Aap ﷺ ne pooray sukoon se farmaya: Kuch din aur sabr kar lo, phir toh is qadar amn-o-itminan ho jayega ke poori majlis mein, bharay darbar mein chokri bhar kar aaram se baithay huay raho ge. Ek ke paas kya kisi ke paas bhi koi hathiyar na hoga kyunke kamil amn-o-aman, poora itminan hoga. Isi waqt yeh ayat utri. Phir toh Allah ke Nabi ﷺ jazeeray Arab par ghalib aa gaye, Arab mein bhi koi kafir na raha, musalmanon ke dilon khauf se khali ho gaye aur hathiyar har waqt lagaye rehnay zaroori na rahay. Phir yahi amn-o-rahat ka daur-daura Huzoor ﷺ ke zamanay ke baad bhi teen khilafaton tak raha, yani Abu Bakr-o-Umar-o-Usman R.A ke zamanay tak. Phir musalman un jhagron mein par gaye jo ronuma huay, phir khauf-zada rehnay lagay aur pehray-dar aur chaukidar, daroghay waghera muqarrar kiye, apni halaton ko mutaghayyar kiya toh mutaghayyar ho gaye. Baaz salaf se manqool hai ke unhon ne Hazrat Abu Bakr-o-Umar R.A ki khilafat ki haqaniyat ke baray mein is ayat ko pesh kiya. Bara bin Aazib R.A kehtay hain jis waqt yeh ayat utri hai us waqt hum intehai khauf aur iztirab ki halat mein thay jaisay farman hai: Ayat (Wazkuro iz antum qaleelun mustad'afuna fil-ardi takhafuna an yatakhatafakumun-nasu fa-awakum wa ayyadakum bi-nasrihi wa razaqakum minat-tayyibati la'allakum tashkurun) (8:26).

(Al-Anfal: 26)، yani yeh woh waqt bhi tha ke tum behad kamzor aur thode thay aur qadam qadam aur dam dam par khauf-zada rehte thay. Allah Ta'ala ne tumhari tadaad badha di, tumhein quwwat-o-taqat inayat farmayi aur aman-o-aman diya. Phir farmaya ke jaise un se pehle ke logon ko us ne zameen ka maalik kar diya tha, jaise ke Kaleemullah Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne apni qaum se farmaya tha, aayat (عَسٰي رَبُّكُمْ اَنْ يُّهْلِكَ عَدُوَّكُمْ وَيَسْتَخْلِفَكُمْ فِي الْاَرْضِ فَيَنْظُرَ كَيْفَ تَعْمَلُوْنَ) (Al-A'raf: 129), bahut mumkin hai balkeh bahut hi qareeb hai ke Allah Ta'ala tumhare dushmanon ko halak kar de aur tumhein un ka ja-nasheen bana de. Aur aayat mein hai (وَنُرِيْدُ اَنْ نَّمُنَّ عَلَي الَّذِيْنَ اسْتُضْعِفُوْا فِي الْاَرْضِ وَنَجْعَلَهُمْ اَىِٕمَّةً وَّنَجْعَلَهُمُ الْوٰرِثِيْنَ) (Al-Qasas: 5), yani hum ne un par ehsaan karna chaha jo zameen bhar mein sab se zyada za'eef aur na-tawan thay. Phir farmaya ke un ke deen ko jo Allah ka pasandeeda hai jama de ga aur usay quwwat-o-taqat de ga. Hazrat Adi bin Hatim (R.A) jab bator-e-wafad aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aaye to aap ne un se farmaya, kya tu ne Hira dekha hai? Us ne jawab diya ke main Hira ko nahin jaanta, haan us ka naam suna hai. Aap ne farmaya, us ki qasam jis ke haath mein meri jaan hai, Allah Ta'ala mere is deen ko kaamil taur par phailaye ga yahan tak ke aman-o-aman qaim ho jaye ga ke Hira se ek sandni-sawar aurat tanha nikle gi aur woh Baitullah tak pahunch kar tawaaf se farigh ho kar wapas hogi, na khauf-zada hogi na hi us ke saath muhafiz hoga. Yaqeen maan ke Kisra bin Hurmuz ke khazane musalmanon ki futuhaat mein aayenge? Aap ne farmaya, haan usi Kisra bin Hurmuz ke. Suno, is qadar maal badh jaye ga ke koi qabool karne wala na mile ga. Hazrat Adi bin Hatim (R.A) farmate hain, ab tum dekh lo ke fi-al-waqay Hira se auratein baghair kisi ki panah ki aati jaati hain. Is pesh-goi ko pura hote hue hum ne dekh liya, dusri pesh-goi to meri nigahon ke samne puri hui, Kisra ke khazane fateh karne walon mein main khud maujood tha aur teesri pesh-goi yaqeenan puri ho kar reh gayi kyunke woh bhi Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai, is ummat ko taraqqi aur badhotri ki madad aur deen ki isha'at ki basharat do. Haan, jo shakhs aakhirat ka amal duniya ke hasil karne ke liye kare woh jaan le ke aakhirat mein us ka koi hissa na mile ga. Phir farmata hai ke woh meri hi ibadat karenge aur mere saath kisi ko shareek na karenge. Musnad mein hai, Hazrat Mu'az bin Jabal (R.A) farmate hain ke ek gadhe par Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke saath aap ke peeche baitha hua tha aur aap ke darmiyan sirf paalan ki lakdi thi. Aap ne mere naam se mujhe aawaz di, main ne labbaik-o-sa'daik kaha, phir thodi si der ke baad chalne ke baad isi tarah mujhe pukara aur main ne bhi isi tarah jawab diya. Aap ne farmaya, jaante ho Allah ka haq apne bandon par kya hai?

Main ne kaha Allah aur uska Rasool khoob jaanta hai. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya bandon par Allah ka haq yeh hai ke woh usi ki ibadat karein, uske saath kisi ko shareek na karein. Phir thodi si der chalne ke baad mujhe pukara aur main ne jawab diya toh aap ne farmaya jaante ho jab bande Allah ka haq ada karein toh Allah ke zimme bandon ka haq kya hai? Main ne jawab diya Allah aur uske Rasool ko hi poora ilm hai. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya yeh ke unhein azab na kare. (Bukhari o Muslim). Phir farmaya iske baad jo munkir ho jaye woh yaqeenan fasiq hai. Ya'ni iske baad bhi jo meri farmanbardari chhod de usne meri hukm-udooli ki aur yeh gunah sakht aur bahut bada hai. Shaan-e-Ilahi dekho jitna jis zamane mein Islam ka zor raha utni hi madad Allah ki hui. Sahaba (R.A) apne imaan mein badhe hue thay, futuhaat mein bhi sab se aage nikal gaye, joon joon imaan kamzor hota gaya dunyawi halat, saltanat o shaukat bhi girti gayi. Bukhari o Muslim mein hai meri ummat mein se ek jamaat hamesha bar-sar-e-haq rahegi aur woh ghalib aur nadar rahegi, un ki mukhalifat un ka kuch na bigad sakegi, Qayamat tak yeh isi tarah rahegi. Aur riwayat mein hai yahan tak Allah ka wada aa jayega. Ek aur riwayat mein hai yahan tak ke yahi jamaat sab se aakhir Dajjal se jihad karegi aur hadith mein hai ke Hazrat Isa (A.S) ke utarne tak yeh log kafiron par ghalib rahenge. Yeh sab riwayatein sahih hain aur ek hi matlab sab ka hai.

Salat aur husn-e-sulook ki hidayaat. Allah Ta'ala apne ba-imaan bandon ko sirf apni ibadat ka hukum deta hai ke usi ke liye namazein padhte raho. Aur saath hi uske bandon ke saath husn-e-sulook karte raho. Zaeefon, maskeenon, faqiron ki khabar-geeri karte raho. Maal mein se Allah ka haq yani Zakat nikalte raho. Aur har amr mein Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki itaat karte raho. Jis baat ka woh hukum farmaye lao, jis amr se woh rokein ruk jao. Yaqeen mano ke Allah ki rahmat ke hasil karne ka yahi tareeqa hai. Chunancha aur aayat mein hai (Ulaa'ika sayarhamuhumullah, innallaha Azeezun Hakeem) (Surah (At-Tawbah: 71). Allah yahi log hain jin par zaroor-ba-zaroor Allah ki rahmat nazil hoti hai. Ae Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh guman na karna ke aap ko jhutlane wale aur aap ki na manne wale hum par ghalib aa jayenge ya idhar udhar bhaag kar hamare be-panah azabon se bach jayenge. Hum to un ka asli thikana Jahannam mein muqarrar kar chuke hain jo nihayat buri jagah hai. Qaraar-gah ke aitbaar aur baaz-gasht ke aitbaar se bhi.)

Allah yahi log hain jin par zaroor-ba-zaroor Allah ki rahmat nazil hoti hai. Ae Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh guman na karna ke aap ko jhutlane wale aur aap ki na manne wale hum par ghalib aa jayenge ya idhar udhar bhaag kar hamare be-panah azabon se bach jayenge. Hum to un ka asli thikana Jahannam mein muqarrar kar chuke hain jo nihayat buri jagah hai. Qaraar-gah ke aitbaar aur baaz-gasht ke aitbaar se bhi.)

Gharon mein ijazat ke baghair dakhil na hon. Is ayat mein qareebi rishtedaron ko bhi hukm ho raha hai ke woh ijazat hasil kar ke aaya karein. Is se pehle ke is surat ki shuru ki ayat mein jo hukm tha woh ajnabiyon ke liye tha. Pas farmata hai ke teen waqton mein ghulamon ko aur nabaligh bachon ko bhi ijazat mangni chahiye. Subh ki namaz se pehle kyunke woh waqt sone ka hota hai. Aur dopahar ko jab insan do ghari rahat hasil karne ke liye umuman apne ghar mein balai kapray utaar kar sota hai aur Isha ki namaz ke baad kyunke woh bhi baal bachon ke sath sone ka waqt hai. Pas teen waqton mein na jayen, insan be-fikri se apne ghar mein kis halat mein hota hai? Is liye ghar ke laundi ghulam aur chotay bachay bhi be-ittila in waqton mein chup chap na ghus ayen. Haan in khaas waqton ke ilawa unhein aanay ki ijazat mangnay ki zaroorat nahin kyunke un ka aana jana to zaroori hai, baar baar ke aanay jaanay walay hain, har waqt ki ijazat talbi un ke liye aur neez tumhare liye bhi bari harj ki cheez hogi. Ek hadith mein hai ke billi najis nahin woh to tumhare gharon mein tumhare aas paas ghoomnay phirnay wali hai. Hukm to yahi hai aur amal is par bohat kam hai. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmatay hain teen ayaton par umuman logon ne amal chhor rakha hai. Ek to yahi ayat aur ek Surah Nisa ki ayat (Wa iza hazaral qismatu ulul qurba wal yatama wal masakeenu farzuquhum minhu wa qulu lahum qawlan ma'rufa) (An-Nisa: 8) aur ek Surah Hujurat ki ayat (Inna akramakum indallahi atqakum innallaha alimun khabir) (Al-Hujurat: 13). Shaitan logon par chha gaya aur unhein in ayaton par amal karne se ghafil kar diya, goya un par iman hi nahin. Main ne to apni is laundi se bhi keh rakha hai ke in teenon waqton mein be-ijazat hargiz na aaye. Pehli ayat mein to in teen waqton mein laundi ghulamon aur nabaligh bachon ko bhi ijazat lenay ka hukm hai, dusri ayat mein wirsay ki taqseem ke waqt jo qarabat dar aur yateem maskeen aa jayen unhein ba-naam-e-Ilahi kuch de denay aur un se narmi se baat karne ka hukm hai aur teesri ayat mein hasb-o-nasab par fakhr karne balkay qabil-e-ikram khauf-e-Ilahi ke honay ka zikr hai. Hazrat Sha'bi (R.H) se kisi ne poocha kya yeh ayat mansookh ho gayi hai? Aap ne farmaya hargiz nahin. Us ne kaha phir logon ne is par amal kyun chhor rakha hai? Farmaya Allah se taufiq talab karni chahiye. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmatay hain is ayat par amal ke tark ki wajah maaldari aur farakh dili hai. Pehlay to logon ke paas itna bhi na tha ke apne darwazon par parday latka letay ya kushada ghar kayi kayi alag alag kamron walay hotay hain to basa auqat laundi ghulam be-khabri mein chalay aatay aur miyan biwi mashghool hotay to aanay walay bhi sharma jatay aur ghar walon par bhi shaaq guzarta. Ab jab ke Allah Ta'ala ne musalmanon ko kushadagi di, kamray judagana ban gaye, darwazay ba-qaida lag gaye, darwazon par parday par gaye to mehfooz ho gaye.

Hukm-e-Ilahi ki maslahat poori ho gayi is liye ijazat ki pabandi uth gayi aur logon ne is mein susti aur ghaflat shuru kar di. Suddi (Rahimahullah) farmate hain yahi teen waqt aise hain ke insaan ko zara fursat hoti hai, ghar mein hota hai, Allah jaane kis halat mein ho, is liye londi ghulamon ko bhi ijazat ka paband kar diya hai kyunke isi waqt mein umooman log apni ghar waliyon se milte hain taake naha dho kar ba-aaram ghar se niklein aur namazon mein shamil hon. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke ek Ansari (R.A) ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke liye kuch khana pakaya, log bila-ijazat un ke ghar mein jaane lage. Hazrat Asma (R.A) ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh toh nihayat buri baat hai ke ghulam be-ijazat ghar mein aa jaye, mumkin hai miyan-biwi ek hi kapde mein hon. Pas yeh aayat utri. Is aayat ke mansookh na hone par is aayat ke khatmay ke alfaaz bhi dalalat karte hain ke isi tarah teen waqton mein jin ka bayan oopar guzra ijazat mangni zaroori hai lekin baad-e-bulughat toh har waqt ittila kar ke hi jana chahiye. Jaise ke aur bade log ijazat mang kar aate hain khwah apne hon ya paraye. Jo burhiya auratein is umr ko pahunch jayen ke na ab unhein mard ki khwahish rahe na nikah ki tawaqqa, haiz band ho jaye, umr se utar jayen toh un par parde ki woh pabandiyan nahin jo aur auraton par hain. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke aisi auraton ko ijazat hai ke woh burqa aur chadar utaar diya karein, sirf dupatte mein aur kurte pajame mein rahein. Aap ki qiraat bhi aayat (اَنْ يَّضَعْنَ ثِيَابَهُنَّ غَيْرَ مُتَبَرِّجٰتٍۢ بِزِيْنَةٍ ۭوَاَنْ يَّسْتَعْفِفْنَ خَيْرٌ لَّهُنَّ ۭ وَاللّٰهُ سَمِيْعٌ عَلِيْمٌ 60؀) (24-An-Noor: 60) hai. Murad is se dupatte ke oopar ki chadar daalna zaroori nahin. Lekin maqsood is se bhi izhaar-e-zeenat na ho. Hazrat Aisha (R.A) se jab is qisam ke sawalat auraton ne kiye toh aap ne farmaya tumhare liye banao singhar beshak halal aur tayyab hai lekin ghair mardon ki aankhein thandi karne ke liye nahin. Hazrat Huzaifa bin Yaman (R.A) ki biwi sahiba jab bilkul burhiya phoos ho gayin toh aap ne apne ghulam ke hathon apne sar ke baalon mein mehndi lagwayi, jab un se sawal kiya gaya toh farmaya main in umr-raseeda auraton mein hoon jinhein khwahish nahin rahi. Aakhir mein farmaya go chadar ka na lena in badi auraton ke liye jaiz toh hai magar taham afzal yahi hai ke chadaron aur burqon mein hi rahein. Allah Ta'ala sunne wala hai.

Ab jab ke Allah Ta'ala ne musalmanon ko kushadagi di, kamray judagana ban gaye, darwazay ba-qaida lag gaye, darwazon par parday par gaye to mehfooz ho gaye.

Hukm-e-Ilahi ki maslahat poori ho gayi is liye ijazat ki pabandi uth gayi aur logon ne is mein susti aur ghaflat shuru kar di. Suddi (Rahimahullah) farmate hain yahi teen waqt aise hain ke insaan ko zara fursat hoti hai, ghar mein hota hai, Allah jaane kis halat mein ho, is liye londi ghulamon ko bhi ijazat ka paband kar diya hai kyunke isi waqt mein umooman log apni ghar waliyon se milte hain taake naha dho kar ba-aaram ghar se niklein aur namazon mein shamil hon. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke ek Ansari (R.A) ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke liye kuch khana pakaya, log bila-ijazat un ke ghar mein jaane lage. Hazrat Asma (R.A) ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh toh nihayat buri baat hai ke ghulam be-ijazat ghar mein aa jaye, mumkin hai miyan-biwi ek hi kapde mein hon. Pas yeh aayat utri. Is aayat ke mansookh na hone par is aayat ke khatmay ke alfaaz bhi dalalat karte hain ke isi tarah teen waqton mein jin ka bayan oopar guzra ijazat mangni zaroori hai lekin baad-e-bulughat toh har waqt ittila kar ke hi jana chahiye. Jaise ke aur bade log ijazat mang kar aate hain khwah apne hon ya paraye. Jo burhiya auratein is umr ko pahunch jayen ke na ab unhein mard ki khwahish rahe na nikah ki tawaqqa, haiz band ho jaye, umr se utar jayen toh un par parde ki woh pabandiyan nahin jo aur auraton par hain. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke aisi auraton ko ijazat hai ke woh burqa aur chadar utaar diya karein, sirf dupatte mein aur kurte pajame mein rahein. Aap ki qiraat bhi aayat (اَنْ يَّضَعْنَ ثِيَابَهُنَّ غَيْرَ مُتَبَرِّجٰتٍۢ بِزِيْنَةٍ ۭوَاَنْ يَّسْتَعْفِفْنَ خَيْرٌ لَّهُنَّ ۭ وَاللّٰهُ سَمِيْعٌ عَلِيْمٌ 60؀) (24-An-Noor: 60) hai. Murad is se dupatte ke oopar ki chadar daalna zaroori nahin. Lekin maqsood is se bhi izhaar-e-zeenat na ho. Hazrat Aisha (R.A) se jab is qisam ke sawalat auraton ne kiye toh aap ne farmaya tumhare liye banao singhar beshak halal aur tayyab hai lekin ghair mardon ki aankhein thandi karne ke liye nahin. Hazrat Huzaifa bin Yaman (R.A) ki biwi sahiba jab bilkul burhiya phoos ho gayin toh aap ne apne ghulam ke hathon apne sar ke baalon mein mehndi lagwayi, jab un se sawal kiya gaya toh farmaya main in umr-raseeda auraton mein hoon jinhein khwahish nahin rahi. Aakhir mein farmaya go chadar ka na lena in badi auraton ke liye jaiz toh hai magar taham afzal yahi hai ke chadaron aur burqon mein hi rahein. Allah Ta'ala sunne wala hai.

Gharon mein ijazat ke baghair dakhil na hon. Is ayat mein qareebi rishtedaron ko bhi hukm ho raha hai ke woh ijazat hasil kar ke aaya karein. Is se pehle ke is surat ki shuru ki ayat mein jo hukm tha woh ajnabiyon ke liye tha. Pas farmata hai ke teen waqton mein ghulamon ko aur nabaligh bachon ko bhi ijazat mangni chahiye. Subh ki namaz se pehle kyunke woh waqt sone ka hota hai. Aur dopahar ko jab insan do ghari rahat hasil karne ke liye umuman apne ghar mein balai kapray utaar kar sota hai aur Isha ki namaz ke baad kyunke woh bhi baal bachon ke sath sone ka waqt hai. Pas teen waqton mein na jayen, insan be-fikri se apne ghar mein kis halat mein hota hai? Is liye ghar ke laundi ghulam aur chotay bachay bhi be-ittila in waqton mein chup chap na ghus ayen. Haan in khaas waqton ke ilawa unhein aanay ki ijazat mangnay ki zaroorat nahin kyunke un ka aana jana to zaroori hai, baar baar ke aanay jaanay walay hain, har waqt ki ijazat talbi un ke liye aur neez tumhare liye bhi bari harj ki cheez hogi. Ek hadith mein hai ke billi najis nahin woh to tumhare gharon mein tumhare aas paas ghoomnay phirnay wali hai. Hukm to yahi hai aur amal is par bohat kam hai. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmatay hain teen ayaton par umuman logon ne amal chhor rakha hai. Ek to yahi ayat aur ek Surah Nisa ki ayat (Wa iza hazaral qismatu ulul qurba wal yatama wal masakeenu farzuquhum minhu wa qulu lahum qawlan ma'rufa) (An-Nisa: 8) aur ek Surah Hujurat ki ayat (Inna akramakum indallahi atqakum innallaha alimun khabir) (Al-Hujurat: 13). Shaitan logon par chha gaya aur unhein in ayaton par amal karne se ghafil kar diya, goya un par iman hi nahin. Main ne to apni is laundi se bhi keh rakha hai ke in teenon waqton mein be-ijazat hargiz na aaye. Pehli ayat mein to in teen waqton mein laundi ghulamon aur nabaligh bachon ko bhi ijazat lenay ka hukm hai, dusri ayat mein wirsay ki taqseem ke waqt jo qarabat dar aur yateem maskeen aa jayen unhein ba-naam-e-Ilahi kuch de denay aur un se narmi se baat karne ka hukm hai aur teesri ayat mein hasb-o-nasab par fakhr karne balkay qabil-e-ikram khauf-e-Ilahi ke honay ka zikr hai. Hazrat Sha'bi (R.H) se kisi ne poocha kya yeh ayat mansookh ho gayi hai? Aap ne farmaya hargiz nahin. Us ne kaha phir logon ne is par amal kyun chhor rakha hai? Farmaya Allah se taufiq talab karni chahiye. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmatay hain is ayat par amal ke tark ki wajah maaldari aur farakh dili hai. Pehlay to logon ke paas itna bhi na tha ke apne darwazon par parday latka letay ya kushada ghar kayi kayi alag alag kamron walay hotay hain to basa auqat laundi ghulam be-khabri mein chalay aatay aur miyan biwi mashghool hotay to aanay walay bhi sharma jatay aur ghar walon par bhi shaaq guzarta. Ab jab ke Allah Ta'ala ne musalmanon ko kushadagi di, kamray judagana ban gaye, darwazay ba-qaida lag gaye, darwazon par parday par gaye to mehfooz ho gaye.

Jihad mein shamooliyat ki sharait is ayat mein jis haraj ke na hone ka zikr hai us ki babat Hazrat Atta R.H waghera toh farmate hain murad is se andhe, loole, langre ka jihad mein na aana hai. Jaise ke Surah Fatah mein hai toh yeh log agar jihad mein shamil na hon toh un par ba-wajah un ke maqool shar'i uzr ke koi haraj nahin. Surah Bara'at mein hai ayat (Laisa 'ala ad-du'afa'i wa la 'ala al-marda wa la 'ala alladhina la yajiduna ma yunfiquna harajun idha nasahu lillahi wa rasulihi ma 'ala al-muhsinina min sabilin wallahu Ghafurur Rahim) (At-Tawbah: 91). Boorhe baron par aur bimaron par aur muflison par jab ke woh teh-e-dil se deen-e-haq ke aur Rasool Allah ﷺ ke khair-khwah hon koi haraj nahin, bhale logon par koi haraj nahin hai. Bhale logon par koi sarzanish nahin, Allah Ghafoor-o-Rahim hai. Un par bhi isi tarah koi haraj nahin jo sawari nahin paate aur tere paas aate hain toh tere paas se bhi unhein sawari nahin mil sakti. Hazrat Saeed R.H waghera farmate hain log andhon, loolon, langron aur bimaron ke sath khana khane mein haraj jaante the ke aisa na ho woh kha na sakein aur hum zyada kha lein ya achha achha kha lein toh is ayat mein unhein ijazat mili ke is mein tum par koi haraj nahin. Ba'az log karahat kar ke bhi un ke sath khane ko nahin baithte the, yeh jahilana aadatein shariat ne utha dein. Mujahid R.H se marwi hai ke log aise logon ko apne baap, bhai, behan waghera qareeb rishtedaron ke han pahuncha aate the ke woh wahan kha lein, yeh log is aar se karte ke hamein auron ke ghar le jate hain, is par yeh ayat utri. Suddi R.H ka qaul hai ke insan jab apne behan bhai waghera ke ghar jata hai woh na hote aur auratein koi khana unhein pesh kartin toh yeh use nahin khate the ke mard toh hain nahin na un ki ijazat hai. Toh Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala ne is ke kha lene ki rukhsat ata farmayi. Yeh jo farmaya ke khud tum par bhi haraj nahin yeh toh zahir hi tha. Is ka bayan is liye kiya gaya ke aur cheez ka is par atf ho aur is ke baad ka bayan is hukm mein barabar ho. Beton ke gharon ka bhi yahi hukm hai go lafzon mein bayan nahin aaya lekin zimnan hai. Balkeh isi ayat se istidlal kar ke ba'az ne kaha hai ke bete ka maal ba-manzila baap ke maal ke hai. Musnad aur Sunan mein kayi sanadon se hadith hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya tu aur tera maal tere baap ka hai. Aur jin logon ke naam aaye un se istidlal kar ke ba'az ne kaha hai ke qarabat-daron ka naan-o-nafaqa ba'az ka ba'az par wajib hai jaise ke Imam Abu Hanifa R.H ka aur Imam Ahmad R.H ke mazhab ka mashhoor maqoola hai. Jis ki kunjiyan tumhari malkiyat mein hain is se murad ghulam aur daroghe hain ke woh apne aaqa ke maal se hasb-e-zarurat-o-dastoor kha-pee sakte hain. Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa R.A ka bayan hai ke jab Rasool Allah ﷺ jang mein jate toh har ek ki chahat yahi hoti ke hum bhi aap ke sath jayen.

Jaate hue apne khaas doston ko apni kunjiyan de jaate aur un se keh dete ke jis cheez ke khaane ki tumhein zaroorat ho hum tumhein rukhsat dete hain lekin taham yeh log apne aap ko ameen samajh kar aur is khayal se ke mabada un logon ne baadal-e-na-khwasta ijazat di ho, kisi khaane peene ki cheez ko na chhoote is par yeh hukm nazil hua. Phir farmaya ke tumhare doston ke gharon se bhi kha lene mein tum par koi pakad nahin jab ke tumhein ilm ho ke woh is se bura na maanege aur un par yeh shaaq na guzrega. Qatada (R.H) farmate hain to jab apne dost ke haan jaaye to bila ijazat us ke khaane ko kha lene ki rukhsat hai. Phir farmaya tum par saath baith kar khaana khaane mein aur juda juda ho kar khaane mein bhi koi gunah nahin. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke jab aayat (Yaa Ayyuhallazeena Aamanoo Laa Ta'kuloo Amwaalakum Bainakum Bil Baatili Illaa An Takoona Tijaaratan 'An Taraadin Minkum) (Surah (An-Nisa: 29) utri yani imaan walo ek dusre ke saath khayein chunancha woh is se bhi ruk gaye is par yeh aayat utri isi tarah se tanha-khori se bhi karahat karte the jab tak koi saathi na ho khaate nahin the is liye Allah Ta'ala ne is hukm mein dono baaton ki ijazat di yani dusron ke saath khaane ki aur tanha khaane ki. Qabeela Bani Kinana ke log khusoosiyat se is marz mein mubtala the bhooke hote the lekin jab tak saath khaane wala koi na ho khaate na the sawari par sawaar ho kar saath khaane wale ki talash mein nikalte the pas is aayat mein Allah Ta'ala ne tanha khaane ki rukhsat nazil farma kar jahiliyat ki is sakht rasm ko mita diya. Is aayat mein go tanha khaane ki rukhsat hai lekin yeh yaad rahe ke logon ke saath mil kar khaana afzal hai aur zyada barkat bhi isi mein hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke ek shakhs ne aakar kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) khaate to hain lekin aasoodgi hasil nahin hoti aap ne farmaya shayad tum alag alag khaate hoge? Jama ho kar ek saath baith kar Allah ka naam le kar khao to tumhein barkat di jayegi. Ibn Majah wagaira mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya mil kar khao, tanha na khao, barkat mil baithne mein hai. Phir taleem hui ke gharon mein salam kar ke jaya karo. Hazrat Jabir (R.A) ka farman hai ke jab tum ghar mein jao to Allah ka sikhaya hua ba-barkat bhala salam kaha karo. Main ne to aazmaya hai ke yeh sarasar barkat hai. Ibn Ta'oos (R.H) farmate hain tum mein se jo ghar mein dakhil ho to ghar walon ko salam kahe. Hazrat 'Ataa (R.H) se poocha gaya ke kya yeh wajib hai? Farmaya mujhe to yaad nahin ke is ke wujoob ka qail koi ho lekin haan mujhe to yeh bahut hi pasand hai ke jab bhi ghar mein jao salam kar ke jao. Main to ise kabhi nahin chhodta haan yeh aur baat hai ke main bhool jao.

Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain jab masjid mein jao toh kaho: Assalamu alaina wa ala ibadillahis salihin. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke yun kaho: Bismillah walhamdulillah, assalamu alaina min Rabbina, assalamu alaina wa ala ibadillahis salihin. Yehi hukum diya ja raha hai, aise waqton mein tumhare salam ka jawab Allah ke farishtay dete hain. Hazrat Anas (R.A) farmate hain mujhe Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne paanch baaton ki wasiyat ki hai, farmaya hai: Ae Anas! Kamil wuzu karo tumhari umr barhay gi. Jo mera ummati milay salam karo nekiyan barhein gi, ghar mein salam kar ke jaya karo ghar ki khairiyat barhay gi. Zuha ki namaz parhte raho, tum se aglay log jo Allah walay ban gaye thay un ka yehi tareeqa tha. Ae Anas! Chhoton par reham kar, baron ki izzat-o-tauqeer kar toh Qayamat ke din mera saathi hoga. Phir farmata hai yeh dua-e-khair hai jo Allah ki taraf se tumhein taleem ki gayi hai, barkat wali aur umdah hai. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain main ne toh At-Tahiyat Quran se hi seekhi hai, namaz ki At-Tahiyat yun hai: At-Tahiyatul mubarakatus salawatut taiyibatu lillah, ash-hadu an la ilaha illallah wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan abduhu wa rasuluh, assalamu alaika ayyuhan-Nabiyyu wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh, assalamu alaina wa ala ibadillahis salihin. Isay parh kar namazi ko apne liye dua karni chahiye phir salam pher de. Inhi Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) se marfoo'an Sahih Muslim Sharif mein is ke siwa bhi marwi hai, wallahu a'lam. Is surat ke ahkaam ka zikr kar ke phir farmaya ke Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ke samne apne wazeh ahkaam, mufeed farmaan khol khol kar isi tarah bayan farmaya karta hai taake woh gaur-o-fikr karein, sochein samjhein aur aql-mandi hasil karein.)

Rukhsat par bhi ijazat mango. Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ko ek adab aur bhi sikhata hai ke jaise aate hue ijazat maang kar aate ho, aise jaane ke waqt bhi mere Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se ijazat maang kar jao. Khusoosan aise waqt jab ke majma ho aur kisi zaroori amr par majlis hui ho, maslan namaz-e-jumma hai ya namaz-e-eid hai ya jamaat hai ya koi majlis-e-shura, hum to aise mauqon par jab tak Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se ijazat na le lo hargiz idhar udhar na jao, momin-e-kamil ki ek nishani yeh bhi hai. Phir apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se farmaya ke jab yeh apne kisi zaroori kaam ke liye aap se ijazat chahein to aap in mein se jise chahein ijazat de diya karein aur in ke liye talab-e-bakhshish ki duayein bhi karte rahein. Abu Dawood waghera mein hai jab tum mein se koi kisi majlis mein jaye to ahl-e-majlis ko salam kar liya kare aur jab wahan se aana chahe to bhi salam kar liya kare, aakhri dafa ka salam pehli martaba ke salam se kuch kam nahin hai. Yeh hadith Tirmidhi mein bhi hai aur Imam sahab ne ise hasan farmaya hai.

Aap ﷺ ko pukarne ke aadab: Log Huzoor ﷺ ko jab bulate to aap ke naam ya kuniyat se mamooli taur par jaise aapas mein ek dusre ko pukara karte hain aap ko bhi pukar liya karte the, to Allah Ta'ala ne is gustakhi se mana farmaya ke naam na lo balkeh Ya Nabi Allah, Ya Rasool Allah keh kar pukaro. Taake aap ki buzurgi aur izzat-o-adab ka paas rahe. Isi ke misl aayat (Yaa Ayyuhallazeena Aamanoo Laa Taqooloo Raa'inaa Wa Qoolun-Zurnaa Wasma'oo, Wa Lilkaafireena Azaabun Aleem) (Surah (Al-Baqarah: 104) hai aur isi jaisi aayat (Yaa Ayyuhallazeena Aamanoo Laa Tarfa'oo Aswatakum Fawqa Saw-tin-Nabiyyi Wa Laa Taj-haroo Lahoo Bil-Qawli Kajahri Ba'dikum Liba'din An Tahbata A'maalukum Wa Antum Laa Tash'uroon) (Surah (Al-Hujurat: 2) hai, yani imaan walo! Apni aawazein Nabi ki aawaz par buland na karo. Aap ke saamne unchi unchi aawazon se na bolo jaise ke betakallufi se aapas mein ek dusre ke saamne chalate ho, agar aisa kiya to sab a'maal ghaarat ho jayenge aur pata bhi na chale. Yahan tak ke farmaya jo log tujhe hujron ke peeche se pukarte hain un mein se aksar be-aql hain, agar woh sabr karte yahan tak ke tum khud un ke paas aa jaate to yeh un ke liye behtar tha. Pas yeh sab aadab sikhaye gaye ke aap se khitaab kis tarah karein, aap se baat-cheet kis tarah karein, aap ke saamne kis tarah bolein chalein, balkeh pehle to aap se sargoshiyan karne ke liye sadqa karne ka bhi hukm tha. Ek matlab to is aayat ka yeh hua. Dusra matlab yeh hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ki dua ko tum apni duaon ki tarah samjho, aap ki dua maqbool-o-mustajab hai. Khabardaar kabhi hamare Nabi ko takleef na dena, kahin aisa na ho ke un ke munh se koi kalma nikal jaye to tehas-nehas ho jao. Is se agle jumle ki tafseer mein Muqatil bin Hayyan R.H farmate hain, Jumma ke din khutbe mein baitha rehna munafiqon par bahut bhaari padta tha, jab kisi ko koi aisi zaroorat hoti to ishare se aap se ijazat chahta aur aap ijazat de dete, is liye ke khutbe ki halat mein bolne se Jumma baatil ho jata hai, to yeh munafiq aad hi aad mein nazrein bacha kar sarak jaate the. Suddi R.H farmate hain jamaat mein jab munafiq hote to ek dusre ki aad le kar bhaag jaate. Allah ke paighambar se aur Allah ki kitab se hat jaate, saff se nikal jaate, mukhalifat par aamada ho jaate. Jo log Amr-e-Rasool, Sunnat-e-Rasool, Farman-e-Rasool, Tareeqa-e-Rasool aur Shar'a-e-Rasool ke khilaf karein woh saza-yaab honge. Insaan ko apne aqwaal-o-af'aal Rasool Allah ﷺ ki sunnaton aur ahadees se milane chahiyein, jo muwafiq hon achhe hain, jo muwafiq na hon mardood hai. Zahir ya batin mein jo bhi hai Shariat-e-Muhammadiya ﷺ ke khilaf kare us ke dil mein kufr-o-nifaq, bid'at-o-burai ka beej bo diya jata hai ya use sakht azaab hota hai. Ya to duniya mein hi qatl, qaid, hadd waghera jaisi sazayein milti hain ya aakhirat mein azaab-e-ukhrawi milega.

Musnad Ahmad mein hadith hai Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain meri aur tumhari misal aisi hai jaise kisi shakhs ne aag jalayi jab woh roshan hui toh patangon aur parwanon ka ijtima ho gaya aur woh dharadhar us mein girne lage. Ab yeh unhein harchand rok raha hai lekin woh hain shauk se us mein gire jate hain aur us shakhs ke rokne se nahi rokte. Yahi halat meri aur tumhari hai ke tum aag mein girna chahte ho aur main tumhein apni baahon mein lapet lapet kar us se rok raha hoon ke aag mein na ghuso, aag se bacho lekin tum meri mante aur is ag mein ghuse chale ja rahe ho. Yeh hadith Bukhari Muslim mein bhi hai.))

Har ek us ke ilm mein hai, Malik-e-Zameen-o-Aasman, Aalim-e-Ghaib-o-Hazir, bandon ke chhupe khule aamaal ka jaanne wala hi hai. Qad ya'lam mein 'Qad' tahqeeq ke liye hai, jaise is se pehle ki aayat (QAD YA'LAMULLAHUL-LAZEENA YATASALLALOONA MINKUM LIWAZA) (Surah (An-Nur: 63) mein. Aur jaise aayat (QAD YA'LAMULLAHUL-MU'AWWIQEENA MINKUM WAL-QA'ILEENA LI-IKHWANIHIM HALUMMA ILAINA, WA LA YA'TOONAL-BA'SA ILLA QALEELA) (Surah (Al-Ahzab: 18) mein. Aur jaise aayat (QAD SAMI'ALLAHU) (Surah (Al-Mujadilah: 1) mein, aur jaise aayat (QAD NA'LAMU INNAHU LAYAHZUNUKAL-LAZEE YAQOOLOONA FA-INNAHUM LA YUKAZZIBOONAKA WA LAKINNAZ-ZALIMEENA BI-AYATILLAHI YAJHADOON) (Surah (Al-An'am: 33) mein, aur jaise 'Qad nara' mein. Aur jaise mu'azzin kehta hai 'Qad qamatis-salah', toh farmata hai ke jis haal par tum, jin aamaal-o-aqaid ke tum ho, Allah par khoob roshan hai. Aasman-o-zameen ka ek zarra bhi Allah par posheeda nahin. Jo amal tum karo, jo halat tumhari ho, us Allah par ayan hai. Koi zarra us se chhupa hua nahin. Har chhoti badi cheez Kitab-e-Mubeen mein mehfooz hai. Bandon ke tamam khair-o-shar ka woh aalim hai, kapdon mein dhak jao, chhup kar kuch karo, har posheeda aur har zahir us par yaksan hai. Sargoshiyan aur buland aawaz ki baatein us ke kaanon mein hain, tamam jaandaron ka rozi-rasan wahi hai, har ek jaandar ke har haal ko jaanne wala wahi hai aur sab kuch Lauh-e-Mehfooz mein pehle se darj hai. Ghaib ki kunjiyan usi ke paas hain jinhein us ke siwa koi aur nahin jaanta. Khushki-o-tari ki har har cheez ko woh jaanta hai. Kisi patte ka jhadna us ke ilm se bahar nahin, zameen ki andheriyon ke andar ka daana aur koi tar-o-khushk cheez aisi nahin jo Kitab-e-Mubeen mein na ho. Aur bhi is mazmoon ki bahut si aayatein aur hadeesein hain. Jab makhlooq Allah ki taraf lautayi jayegi, us waqt un ke saamne un ki chhoti se chhoti neki aur badi pesh kar di jayegi. Tamam agle pichle aamaal dekh lega. Aamaal-nama ko darta hua dekhega aur apni poori sawaneh-umri is mein pa kar hairat-zada ho kar kahega ke yeh kaisi kitab hai jis ne badi toh badi, koi chhoti se chhoti cheez bhi nahin chhodi, jo jis ne kiya tha woh wahan payega. Tere Rab ki zaat zulm se paak hai. Aakhir mein farmaya Allah bada hi daana hai, har cheez us ke ilm mein hai.))))
